from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from stellar.modrinth_pack import (  # noqa: E402
    ModrinthPackError,
    import_modrinth_pack,
    inspect_modrinth_pack,
    looks_like_modrinth_pack,
)

checks: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []


def check(name: str, value, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    checks.append((name, bool(value), str(detail)))
    return bool(value)


def sha1(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()


def make_pack(
    root: Path, *, deps: dict, files: list[dict], overrides: dict, tag: str = "test"
) -> Path:
    manifest = {
        "game": "minecraft",
        "formatVersion": 1,
        "versionId": "1.0.0",
        "name": "Test MR Pack",
        "summary": "A tiny test pack",
        "dependencies": deps,
        "files": files,
    }
    path = root / f"{tag}.mrpack"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr(
            "modrinth.index.json",
            json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False),
        )
        for name, data in overrides.items():
            zf.writestr(name, data)
    return path


def file_entry(path: str, data: bytes, url: str, client: str = "required") -> dict:
    entry = {
        "path": path,
        "hashes": {"sha1": sha1(data), "sha512": "x"},
        "downloads": [url],
        "fileSize": len(data),
    }
    if client != "required":
        entry["env"] = {"client": client, "server": "optional"}
    return entry


def fake_download(payloads: dict[str, bytes]):
    calls: list[str] = []

    def download(
        url,
        dest,
        *,
        sha1="",
        size=0,
        cancel_event=None,
        progress_cb=None,
        connections=4,
        probe=True,
    ):
        calls.append(url)
        data = payloads[url]
        Path(dest).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(dest).write_bytes(data)
        if progress_cb:
            progress_cb(len(data), len(data))
        return len(data)

    return download, calls


def fake_loader(calls: list[tuple]):
    def install(game_dir, mc, kind, version, **kwargs):
        calls.append((str(mc), kind, str(version)))
        loader_id = f"{kind}-loader-{version}-{mc}"
        path = Path(game_dir) / "versions" / loader_id / f"{loader_id}.json"
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(
            json.dumps({"id": loader_id, "inheritsFrom": mc, "libraries": []}),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        return loader_id

    return install


class FakeInstaller:
    def __init__(self, calls: list[str]):
        self.calls = calls

    def install(self, version_id, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append(version_id)


def main() -> int:
    temp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dkl_mrpack_"))
    try:
        root = temp / "pack"
        root.mkdir()
        mod = b"fake mod jar"
        optional = b"client mod"
        unsupported = b"server only"
        progress: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
        pack = make_pack(
            root,
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11", "fabric-loader": "0.19.5"},
            files=[
                file_entry("mods/cat.jar", mod, "https://example.test/cat.jar"),
                file_entry(
                    "mods/optional.jar",
                    optional,
                    "https://example.test/optional.jar",
                    client="optional",
                ),
                file_entry(
                    "mods/server-only.jar",
                    unsupported,
                    "https://example.test/server-only.jar",
                    client="unsupported",
                ),
            ],
            overrides={
                "overrides/config/app.json": "config",
                "overrides/options.txt": "options",
                "client-overrides/options.txt": "client-options",
                "client-overrides/config/client-only.json": "client-config",
            },
        )

        ok = True
        ok &= check("looks_like", looks_like_modrinth_pack(pack))
        info = inspect_modrinth_pack(pack)
        ok &= check("name", info.name == "Test MR Pack", info.name)
        ok &= check("mc", info.minecraft_version == "1.21.11", info.minecraft_version)
        ok &= check("loader", info.loader == "Fabric", info.loader)
        ok &= check("loader_version", info.loader_version == "0.19.5", info.loader_version)
        ok &= check("file_count", len(info.files) == 2, str([f.path for f in info.files]))
        ok &= check("skip_unsupported", all("server-only" not in f.path for f in info.files))
        options_entry = [o for o in info.overrides if o.relative == "options.txt"][0]
        ok &= check("options_identical", options_entry.size == len(b"options"))
        ok &= check("mods_count", info.counts["mods"] == 2, info.counts["mods"])
        ok &= check("config_count", info.counts["config"] == 2, info.counts["config"])

        game_dir = temp / "game"
        loader_calls: list[tuple] = []
        payloads = {
            "https://example.test/cat.jar": mod,
            "https://example.test/optional.jar": optional,
        }
        direct_urls = lambda item: item.urls  # noqa: E731
        download, calls = fake_download(payloads)
        result = import_modrinth_pack(
            pack,
            game_dir,
            "MRCat",
            isolated=True,
            progress_cb=lambda p, m: progress.append((p, m)),
            loader_installer=fake_loader(loader_calls),
            download_func=download,
            url_resolver=direct_urls,
        )
        run_dir = game_dir / "versions" / "MRCat"
        ok &= check("result_version", result.version_id == "MRCat")
        ok &= check("downloaded", result.downloaded_files == 2, result.downloaded_files)
        ok &= check("imported", result.imported_files == 6, result.imported_files)
        ok &= check("loader_called", loader_calls == [("1.21.11", "fabric", "0.19.5")], loader_calls)
        ok &= check("mod_file", (run_dir / "mods" / "cat.jar").read_bytes() == mod)
        ok &= check(
            "optional_mod",
            (run_dir / "mods" / "optional.jar").read_bytes() == optional,
        )
        ok &= check("unsupported_absent", not (run_dir / "mods" / "server-only.jar").exists())
        ok &= check(
            "override_config",
            (run_dir / "config" / "app.json").read_text() == "config",
        )
        ok &= check(
            "client_override_wins",
            (run_dir / "options.txt").read_text() == "client-options",
        )
        ok &= check("download_calls", len(calls) == 2, calls)
        wrapper = json.loads((run_dir / "MRCat.json").read_text())
        ok &= check(
            "wrapper_inherits",
            wrapper.get("inheritsFrom") == "fabric-loader-0.19.5-1.21.11",
            wrapper,
        )
        ok &= check("progress_end", progress[-1][0] == 100, progress[-1])

        # resume / overwrite
        download2, calls2 = fake_download(payloads)
        result2 = import_modrinth_pack(
            pack,
            game_dir,
            "MRCat",
            resume=True,
            overwrite=True,
            isolated=True,
            loader_installer=fake_loader([]),
            download_func=download2,
            url_resolver=direct_urls,
        )
        ok &= check("resume_downloaded", result2.downloaded_files == 0)
        ok &= check("resume_skipped", result2.skipped_files == 2, result2.skipped_files)
        ok &= check(
            "overwrite_config",
            (run_dir / "options.txt").read_text() == "client-options",
        )
        # no loader: vanilla install path
        vanilla = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="vanilla",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11"},
            files=[file_entry("mods/v.jar", b"v", "https://example.test/v.jar")],
            overrides={},
        )
        vanilla_calls: list[str] = []
        result3 = import_modrinth_pack(
            vanilla,
            game_dir,
            "VanillaCat",
            isolated=True,
            installer=FakeInstaller(vanilla_calls),
            download_func=fake_download({"https://example.test/v.jar": b"v"})[0],
            url_resolver=direct_urls,
        )
        ok &= check("vanilla_install", vanilla_calls == ["1.21.11"], vanilla_calls)
        ok &= check("vanilla_version", result3.version_id == "VanillaCat")
        wrapper3 = json.loads(
            (game_dir / "versions" / "VanillaCat" / "VanillaCat.json").read_text()
        )
        ok &= check("vanilla_inherits", wrapper3.get("inheritsFrom") == "1.21.11")

        # unsafe path
        bad = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="bad",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11"},
            files=[file_entry("../evil.jar", b"x", "https://example.test/evil.jar")],
            overrides={},
        )
        try:
            inspect_modrinth_pack(bad)
        except ModrinthPackError as exc:
            ok &= check("traversal_rejected", "越界" in str(exc), str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("traversal_rejected", False)

        # fake sha1
        bad2 = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="bad2",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11"},
            files=[
                {
                    "path": "mods/nosha.jar",
                    "hashes": {},
                    "downloads": ["https://example.test/nosha.jar"],
                    "fileSize": 1,
                }
            ],
            overrides={},
        )
        try:
            inspect_modrinth_pack(bad2)
        except ModrinthPackError as exc:
            ok &= check("sha_rejected", "SHA1" in str(exc), str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("sha_rejected", False)

        # quilt unsupported
        quilt = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="quilt",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11", "quilt-loader": "0.20.0"},
            files=[file_entry("mods/q.jar", b"q", "https://example.test/q.jar")],
            overrides={},
        )
        try:
            inspect_modrinth_pack(quilt)
        except ModrinthPackError as exc:
            ok &= check("quilt_rejected", "Quilt" in str(exc), str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("quilt_rejected", False)

        # cancel
        cancel_pack = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="cancel",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11", "fabric-loader": "0.19.5"},
            files=[file_entry("mods/c.jar", b"c", "https://example.test/c.jar")],
            overrides={},
        )
        cancel = threading.Event()
        cancel.set()
        try:
            import_modrinth_pack(
                cancel_pack,
                game_dir,
                "CancelCat",
                isolated=True,
                cancel_event=cancel,
                loader_installer=fake_loader([]),
                download_func=fake_download(payloads)[0],
                url_resolver=direct_urls,
            )
        except ModrinthPackError as exc:
            ok &= check("cancel", "取消" in str(exc), str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("cancel", False)

        for name, passed, detail in checks:
            print(f"{name}: {'OK' if passed else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail and not passed else ""))
        print("RESULT:", "PASS" if all(item[1] for item in checks) else "FAIL")
        return 0 if all(item[1] for item in checks) else 1
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(temp, ignore_errors=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QEventLoop, QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

import stellar.workers as workers
from stellar.packs import inspect_pack


def make_version(game_dir: Path, version_id: str) -> None:
    path = game_dir / "versions" / version_id / f"{version_id}.json"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "id": version_id,
                "type": "release",
                "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
                "assets": "1.21",
                "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/a.json"},
                "downloads": {
                    "client": {
                        "url": "http://example.invalid/client.jar",
                        "size": 10,
                        "sha1": "",
                    }
                },
                "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def run_worker(worker, timeout_ms: int = 15000):
    loop = QEventLoop()
    captured: list[tuple] = []

    def on_signal(*args) -> None:
        captured.append(args)
        loop.quit()

    worker.finished.connect(on_signal)
    worker.start()
    QTimer.singleShot(timeout_ms, loop.quit)
    loop.exec()
    try:
        worker.finished.disconnect(on_signal)
    except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
        pass
    return captured[0] if captured else None


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    data = b""

    def log_message(self, *args) -> None:
        pass

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path != "/pack.dklpack":
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        body = self.data
        start = 0
        end = len(body) - 1
        header = self.headers.get("Range") or ""
        if header.startswith("bytes="):
            left, _, right = header.split("=", 1)[1].partition("-")
            start = int(left or 0)
            end = min(int(right), len(body) - 1) if right else end
            self.send_response(206)
            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{len(body)}")
        else:
            self.send_response(200)
        chunk = body[start : end + 1]
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(chunk)))
        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
        self.end_headers()
        try:
            self.wfile.write(chunk)
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            pass


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    ok = True
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
        root = Path(raw)
        source = root / "game"
        make_version(source, "WorkerPack")
        run = source / "versions" / "WorkerPack"
        (run / "mods").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "mods" / "worker.jar").write_bytes(b"worker-mod")
        (run / "config").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "config" / "worker.toml").write_text("cat=1", encoding="utf-8")

        pack_path = root / "worker.dklpack"
        export = workers.PackExportWorker(
            source, "WorkerPack", pack_path, name="Worker 猫猫包"
        )
        exported = run_worker(export)
        export_ok = (
            exported is not None
            and exported[0] is True
            and pack_path.is_file()
        )
        print("pack_export_worker:", "OK" if export_ok else "FAIL", exported)
        ok &= export_ok

        info = inspect_pack(pack_path)
        print("pack_export_manifest:", "OK" if info.name == "Worker 猫猫包" else "FAIL")
        ok &= info.name == "Worker 猫猫包"

        Handler.data = pack_path.read_bytes()
        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}/pack.dklpack"
        original_app_dir = workers.APP_DIR
        workers.APP_DIR = root
        try:
            fetch = workers.PackFetchWorker(url, threads=4)
            fetched = run_worker(fetch)
            fetched_ok = (
                fetched is not None
                and fetched[1] == ""
                and Path(fetched[0]).is_file()
                and inspect_pack(Path(fetched[0])).name == "Worker 猫猫包"
            )
            print("pack_fetch_worker:", "OK" if fetched_ok else "FAIL", fetched)
            ok &= fetched_ok

            invalid = workers.PackFetchWorker("file:///tmp/x.dklpack")
            invalid_result = run_worker(invalid)
            invalid_ok = invalid_result is not None and "http" in invalid_result[1]
            print("pack_fetch_invalid_url:", "OK" if invalid_ok else "FAIL", invalid_result)
            ok &= invalid_ok
        finally:
            workers.APP_DIR = original_app_dir
            server.shutdown()

    app.processEvents()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")

from stellar.packs import (
    PackError,
    PackOptions,
    export_pack,

)
from stellar.ui.skin_preview import rotate_model_point


def make_version(game_dir: Path, version_id: str) -> Path:
    path = game_dir / "versions" / version_id / f"{version_id}.json"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "id": version_id,
                "type": "release",
                "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
                "assets": "1.21",
                "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/a.json"},
                "downloads": {
                    "client": {
                        "url": "http://example.invalid/client.jar",
                        "size": 10,
                        "sha1": "",
                    }
                },
                "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return path


class FakeInstaller:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[str] = []

    def install(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        self.calls.append(version_id)


def check(label: str, value: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if value else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail else ""))
    return value


def main() -> None:
    ok = True
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        source = root / "source-game"
        make_version(source, "TestPack")
        run = source / "versions" / "TestPack"
        (run / "mods").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "mods" / "demo.jar").write_bytes(b"jar-data")
        (run / "mods" / "disabled.jar.disabled").write_bytes(b"off")
        (run / "config").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "config" / "demo.toml").write_text("value=1", encoding="utf-8")
        (run / "defaultconfigs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "defaultconfigs" / "default.toml").write_text("x=1", encoding="utf-8")
        (run / "resourcepacks").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "resourcepacks" / "pack.zip").write_bytes(b"zip")
        (run / "saves" / "world").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "saves" / "world" / "level.dat").write_bytes(b"level")

        pack_path = root / "pack.dklpack"
        export_pack(
            source,
            "TestPack",
            pack_path,
            name="猫猫测试包",
            description="只有一只猫",
            options=PackOptions(),
            isolated=True,
        )
        ok &= check("pack_created", pack_path.is_file())
        info = inspect_pack(pack_path)
        ok &= check("pack_name", info.name == "猫猫测试包", info.name)
        ok &= check("mods_count", info.counts.get("mods") == 2, str(info.counts))
        ok &= check("config_count", info.counts.get("config") == 1, str(info.counts))
        ok &= check(
            "defaultconfigs_count",
            info.counts.get("defaultconfigs") == 1,
            str(info.counts),
        )
        ok &= check("optional_excluded", not info.counts.get("resourcepacks"), str(info.counts))
        ok &= check("saves_excluded", not info.counts.get("saves"), str(info.counts))
        ok &= check("total_files", info.total_files == 5, str(info.total_files))

        target = root / "target-game"
        installer = FakeInstaller()
        result = import_pack(
            pack_path,
            target,
            "RestoredCat",
            isolated=True,
            installer=installer,
        )
        target_run = target / "versions" / "RestoredCat"
        ok &= check("installer_called", installer.calls == ["RestoredCat"], str(installer.calls))
        ok &= check("mod_restored", (target_run / "mods" / "demo.jar").read_bytes() == b"jar-data")
        ok &= check("disabled_restored", (target_run / "mods" / "disabled.jar.disabled").is_file())
        ok &= check("config_restored", (target_run / "config" / "demo.toml").is_file())
        ok &= check("optional_not_restored", not (target_run / "resourcepacks").exists())
        ok &= check("imported_count", result.imported_files == 4, str(result.imported_files))
        restored_json = json.loads(
            (target / "versions" / "RestoredCat" / "RestoredCat.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        ok &= check("version_id_rewritten", restored_json.get("id") == "RestoredCat")

        # 重名导入 + 覆盖策略
        overwrite_installer = FakeInstaller()
        result2 = import_pack(
            pack_path,
            target,
            "RestoredCat",
            resume=True,
            overwrite=True,
            isolated=True,
            installer=overwrite_installer,
        )
        ok &= check("resume_overwrite", result2.imported_files == 4, str(result2.imported_files))

        # 路径穿越拒绝
        bad = root / "bad.dklpack"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(bad, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("manifest.json", json.dumps({"format": "dklpack", "format_version": 1}))
            zf.writestr("version/version.json", json.dumps({"id": "Bad"}))
            zf.writestr("../evil.txt", "oops")
        try:
            inspect_pack(bad)
            ok &= check("path_traversal_rejected", False)
        except PackError:
            ok &= check("path_traversal_rejected", True)

        # 版本名安全处理
        ok &= check(
            "normalize_name",
            normalize_version_id("猫猫 1.21/../x") == "猫猫 1.21-..-x",
            normalize_version_id("猫猫 1.21/../x"),
        )
        unique = unique_version_id(target, "RestoredCat")
        ok &= check("unique_name", unique != "RestoredCat" and unique.startswith("RestoredCat"))

    # 3D 预览旋转中心
    pivot = rotate_model_point((0.0, 16.0, 0.0), 37.0, 22.0)
    ok &= check("pivot_fixed", all(abs(v) < 1e-9 for v in pivot), str(pivot))
    top = rotate_model_point((0.0, 24.0, 0.0), 90.0, 0.0)
    ok &= check("pivot_yaw", abs(top[0]) < 1e-9 and abs(top[1] - 8.0) < 1e-9, str(top))
    head = rotate_model_point((0.0, 8.0, 0.0), 0.0, 90.0)
    ok &= check("pivot_pitch", abs(head[1]) < 1e-9 and abs(head[2] + 8.0) < 1e-9, str(head))

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def make_version(version_id: str, number: str, deps=None) -> dict:

def dep_buttons(dialog: ServerAddonDialog) -> list[QPushButton]:
    return [

        for button in dialog.dep_bar.findChildren(QPushButton)
        if button.text().startswith("前置：")
    ]

    return [

        for button in dialog.dep_bar.findChildren(QPushButton)
        if button.text() == "返回"
    ]

    server_addons.ModProjectWorker.start = lambda self: None
    server_addons.ModProjectsWorker.start = lambda self: None

    main_window = FakeMain(Config.load())

    )

    app.processEvents()
    ok = True

    dialog._dep_projects["arch"] = {
        "id": "arch",
        "slug": "architectury-api",
        "title": "Architectury API",
        "description": "跨加载器前置库",
        "downloads": 123456,
        "categories": ["library"],
        "icon_url": "",
    }
    dialog.dep_bar.update_projects(dialog._dep_projects)

    dep_version = make_version(
        "jei-1",

        deps=[
            {
                "project_id": "arch",
                "version_id": "arch-1",
                "dependency_type": "required",

        ],
    )
    hit = {
        "project_id": "jei",
        "slug": "jei",
        "title": "JEI",
        "description": "物品管理器",
        "author": "mezz",
        "downloads": 1000,
        "categories": ["utility"],
        "icon_url": "",
    }
    dialog._select_project("jei", hit)
    dialog._versions_ready(dialog._versions_worker, "jei", [dep_version], "")
    app.processEvents()

    combo_ok = (
        isinstance(dialog.version_combo.currentData(), dict)
        and str(dialog.version_combo.currentData().get("id")) == "jei-1"
    )
    deps_ok = not dialog.dep_bar.isHidden() and len(dep_buttons(dialog)) == 1
    name_ok = bool(dep_buttons(dialog)) and "Architectury API" in dep_buttons(dialog)[0].text()
    print("server_version_and_dep_bar:", "OK" if combo_ok and deps_ok else "FAIL")
    print("server_dep_project_name:", "OK" if name_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= combo_ok and deps_ok and name_ok

    dep_buttons(dialog)[0].click()
    app.processEvents()
    nav_ok = dialog._selected_project == "arch" and len(dialog._nav_stack) == 1
    print("server_open_dependency:", "OK" if nav_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= nav_ok

    arch_version = make_version("arch-1", "9.2.14")
    newer = make_version("arch-2", "9.3.0")

    pending_ok = (
        isinstance(dialog.version_combo.currentData(), dict)
        and str(dialog.version_combo.currentData().get("id")) == "arch-1"
    )
    back_ok = bool(back_buttons(dialog))
    print("server_pending_dep_version:", "OK" if pending_ok else "FAIL")
    print("server_back_button:", "OK" if back_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= pending_ok and back_ok

    back_buttons(dialog)[0].click()
    app.processEvents()
    return_ok = dialog._selected_project == "jei" and not dialog._nav_stack
    print("server_back_to_project:", "OK" if return_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= return_ok

    dialog._versions_ready(dialog._versions_worker, "jei", [dep_version], "")
    app.processEvents()
    restore_ok = (
        isinstance(dialog.version_combo.currentData(), dict)
        and str(dialog.version_combo.currentData().get("id")) == "jei-1"
        and not back_buttons(dialog)
        and len(dep_buttons(dialog)) == 1
    )
    print("server_restore_version_and_bar:", "OK" if restore_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= restore_ok

    dialog.close()
    main_window.close()
    app.processEvents()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1

# FILE: qa/test_shortcut.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))


def check(label: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(f"{label} failed {detail}")
    print(f"ok  {label}" + (f" · {detail}" if detail else ""))


def read_shortcut(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    import base64

    script = (
        "[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; "
        "$ws = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; "
        f"$s = $ws.CreateShortcut('{str(path).replace(chr(39), chr(39) * 2)}'); "
        "Write-Output $s.TargetPath; Write-Output $s.Arguments; "
        "Write-Output $s.WorkingDirectory; Write-Output $s.IconLocation"
    )
    encoded = base64.b64encode(script.encode("utf-16le")).decode("ascii")
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [
            "powershell.exe",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-NonInteractive",
            "-EncodedCommand",
            encoded,
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
        timeout=30,
    )
    lines = completed.stdout.lstrip("\ufeff").splitlines()
    check("shortcut readable", completed.returncode == 0 and len(lines) >= 4, str(lines))
    return {
        "target": lines[0],
        "arguments": lines[1],
        "working": lines[2],
        "icon": lines[3],
    }


def test_create_shortcut() -> None:
    import stellar.shortcut as shortcut

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        desktop = root / "Desktop"
        desktop.mkdir()
        app_dir = root / "Launcher"
        (app_dir / "assets").mkdir(parents=True)
        (app_dir / "app.py").write_text("print('hello')\n", encoding="utf-8")
        shutil.copy2(PROJECT / "assets" / "dkl.ico", app_dir / "assets" / "dkl.ico")

        original_desktop = shortcut._desktop_dir
        original_app_dir = shortcut.APP_DIR
        shortcut._desktop_dir = lambda: desktop
        shortcut.APP_DIR = app_dir
        try:
            path = shortcut.create_desktop_shortcut()
            check("shortcut created", path.is_file(), str(path))
            check("shortcut in desktop", path.parent == desktop)
            check("shortcut exists helper", shortcut.shortcut_exists())
            info = read_shortcut(path)
            check("target python", "python" in Path(info["target"]).name.lower(), info["target"])
            check("arguments app", "app.py" in info["arguments"], info["arguments"])
            check("working dir", Path(info["working"]) == app_dir, info["working"])
            check("icon set", "dkl.ico" in info["icon"], info["icon"])
        finally:
            shortcut._desktop_dir = original_desktop
            shortcut.APP_DIR = original_app_dir


def test_config_flag() -> None:
    import stellar.config as config

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        original_path = config.CONFIG_PATH
        config.CONFIG_PATH = Path(tmp) / "config.json"
        try:
            config.CONFIG_PATH.write_text(
                json.dumps({"shortcut_offered": True}), encoding="utf-8"
            )
            loaded = config.Config.load()
            check("shortcut flag loaded", loaded.shortcut_offered is True)
            config.CONFIG_PATH.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
            check("shortcut flag default", config.Config.load().shortcut_offered is False)
        finally:
            config.CONFIG_PATH = original_path


def test_settings_button() -> None:
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    import stellar.shortcut as shortcut

    original_exists = shortcut.shortcut_exists
    try:
        shortcut.shortcut_exists = lambda: False
        from stellar.config import Config
        from stellar.ui.main_window import MainWindow

        window = MainWindow(Config.load())
        check(
            "settings button initial",
            window.settings_page.shortcut_btn.text() == "创建桌面快捷方式",
            window.settings_page.shortcut_btn.text(),
        )
        shortcut.shortcut_exists = lambda: True
        window.settings_page.refresh_shortcut_state()
        check(
            "settings button exists",
            window.settings_page.shortcut_btn.text() == "重新创建快捷方式",
            window.settings_page.shortcut_btn.text(),
        )
        original_offered = bool(window.config.shortcut_offered)
        window.config.shortcut_offered = True
        window.offer_shortcut_once()
        check("offer skipped when flagged", True)

        from stellar.ui import dialogs

        original_exec = dialogs.ConfirmDialog.exec
        original_create = shortcut.create_desktop_shortcut
        try:
            target = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "qa-shortcut.lnk"
            shortcut.shortcut_exists = lambda: False
            shortcut.create_desktop_shortcut = lambda: target
            dialogs.ConfirmDialog.exec = lambda self: True
            window.config.shortcut_offered = False
            window.offer_shortcut_once()
            check("offer flag saved", window.config.shortcut_offered is True)
        finally:
            dialogs.ConfirmDialog.exec = original_exec
            shortcut.create_desktop_shortcut = original_create
            window.config.shortcut_offered = original_offered
            window.config.save()
        window.close()
        app.processEvents()
    finally:
        shortcut.shortcut_exists = original_exists

    test_create_shortcut()
    test_config_flag()
    test_settings_button()
    print("SHORTCUT TESTS PASSED")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# FILE: qa/test_startup.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer, Qt
from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

import app as entry
from stellar.ui.main_window import MainWindow


def main() -> None:
    original_exec = QApplication.exec
    snapshot: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    splash_keys = 0
    main_keys = 0

    def record() -> None:
        application = QApplication.instance()
        for widget in application.topLevelWidgets():
            snapshot.append(
                {
                    "type": type(widget).__name__,
                    "visible": widget.isVisible(),
                }
            )

    def press_splash_keys() -> None:
        nonlocal splash_keys
        application = QApplication.instance()
        for widget in application.topLevelWidgets():
            if type(widget).__name__ == "SplashScreen" and widget.isVisible():
                for key in (Qt.Key_A, Qt.Key_Space, Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Escape):
                    QTest.keyClick(widget, key)
                    splash_keys += 1
                break

    def press_main_keys() -> None:
        nonlocal main_keys
        application = QApplication.instance()
        for widget in application.topLevelWidgets():
            if type(widget).__name__ == "MainWindow" and widget.isVisible():
                for key in (Qt.Key_A, Qt.Key_B, Qt.Key_Escape):
                    QTest.keyClick(widget, key)
                    main_keys += 1
                break

    def exec_with_autoclose(*args) -> int:
        application = QApplication.instance()
        QTimer.singleShot(60, press_splash_keys)
        poll = QTimer(application)
        poll.setInterval(100)

        def poll_main_window() -> None:
            press_main_keys()
            if main_keys:
                poll.stop()

        poll.timeout.connect(poll_main_window)
        poll.start()
        QTimer.singleShot(4600, record)
        QTimer.singleShot(5400, application.quit)
        return original_exec()

    QApplication.exec = exec_with_autoclose
    try:
        code = entry.main()
    finally:
        QApplication.exec = original_exec

    main_visible = [s for s in snapshot if s["type"] == "MainWindow" and s["visible"]]
    splash_visible = [
        s for s in snapshot if s["type"] == "SplashScreen" and s["visible"]
    ]
    ok = (
        code == 0
        and len(main_visible) == 1
        and not splash_visible
        and splash_keys == 4
        and main_keys == 3
    )
    print(
        "startup:",
        "OK" if ok else "FAIL",
        f"code={code}",
        f"splash_keys={splash_keys}",
        f"main_keys={main_keys}",
        f"snapshot={snapshot}",
    )
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")

if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QPushButton

from stellar.config import Config
from stellar.mods import ModInfo
from stellar.ui.main_window import MainWindow
from stellar.ui.pages.mods import ModRow
from stellar.ui.widgets import VersionRow


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = MainWindow(Config.load())
    ok = True

    if window.versions:
        summary = window.versions[0]
        row = VersionRow(summary)
        captured: list[str] = []
        row.delete_requested.connect(captured.append)
        buttons = [b for b in row.findChildren(QPushButton) if b.toolTip() == "删除此版本"]
        row_ok = bool(buttons) and not buttons[0].testAttribute(
            Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents
        )
        if buttons:
            buttons[0].click()
        row_ok = row_ok and captured == [summary.id]
        print("version_row_delete:", "OK" if row_ok else "FAIL")
        ok &= row_ok

        exported: list[str] = []
        row.export_requested.connect(exported.append)
        export_buttons = [
            b for b in row.findChildren(QPushButton)
            if b.toolTip().startswith("打包此版本")
        ]
        export_ok = bool(export_buttons) and not export_buttons[0].testAttribute(
            Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents
        )
        if export_buttons:
            export_buttons[0].click()
        export_ok = export_ok and exported == [summary.id]
        print("version_row_export:", "OK" if export_ok else "FAIL")
        ok &= export_ok

        try:
            from stellar.ui.pack_dialog import PackExportDialog, PackImportDialog

            export_dialog = PackExportDialog(window, summary.id)
            import_dialog = PackImportDialog(window)
            dialogs_ok = (
                export_dialog.title_label.text() == "打包带走"
                and import_dialog.title_label.text() == "领养整合包"
            )
            export_dialog.deleteLater()
            import_dialog.deleteLater()
        except Exception as exc:
            print("pack_dialogs:", "FAIL", exc)
            dialogs_ok = False
        else:
            print("pack_dialogs:", "OK" if dialogs_ok else "FAIL")
        ok &= bool(dialogs_ok)

    home = window.home_page
    window.launch_active = True
    home.set_launching(True)
    launching_ok = (
        home.launch_btn.text() == "取消启动"
        and home.launch_btn.objectName() == "Danger"
        and home.launch_btn.isEnabled()
    )
    print("home_launching:", "OK" if launching_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= launching_ok

    window.launch_active = False
    window.game_running = True
    home.set_game_running(True)
    running_ok = (
        home.launch_btn.text() == "关闭游戏"
        and home.launch_btn.objectName() == "Danger"
    )
    print("home_running:", "OK" if running_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= running_ok

    home.set_game_closing()
    closing_ok = (
        home.launch_btn.text() == "正在关闭…"
        and not home.launch_btn.isEnabled()
    )
    print("home_closing:", "OK" if closing_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= closing_ok

    window.game_running = False
    home.set_game_running(False)
    idle_ok = (
        home.launch_btn.text() == "启动游戏"
        and home.launch_btn.objectName() == "Launch"
    )
    print("home_idle:", "OK" if idle_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= idle_ok

    download = window.download_page
    version_id = window.selected_version or "test"
    window.install_active = True
    window._install_cancelling = False
    download._on_install_started(version_id)
    cancel_visible = not download.cancel_btn.isHidden() and download.cancel_btn.isEnabled()
    window.install_active = False
    download._on_install_finished(False, "下载已取消", version_id)
    cancel_hidden = download.cancel_btn.isHidden()
    cancel_ok = cancel_visible and cancel_hidden
    print("download_cancel_button:", "OK" if cancel_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= cancel_ok

    settings = window.settings_page
    threads = [settings.thread_combo.itemData(i) for i in range(settings.thread_combo.count())]
    settings_ok = (
        len(threads) >= 4
        and settings.cleanup_btn.isEnabled()
        and settings.source_combo.findData("auto") >= 0
    )
    print("settings_controls:", "OK" if settings_ok else "FAIL", threads)
    ok &= settings_ok

    sample = ModInfo(
        path=window.config.game_path / "versions" / "x" / "mods" / "TestMod.jar",
        name="TestMod",
        version="1.0",
        loader="Fabric",
        enabled=True,
        size=1024,
    )
    mod_row = ModRow(sample)
    mod_captured: list[object] = []
    mod_row.delete_requested.connect(mod_captured.append)
    mod_buttons = [b for b in mod_row.findChildren(QPushButton) if b.toolTip() == "删除此 Mod"]
    mod_ok = bool(mod_buttons) and not mod_buttons[0].testAttribute(
        Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents
    )
    if mod_buttons:
        mod_buttons[0].click()
    mod_ok = mod_ok and mod_captured == [sample]
    print("mod_row_delete:", "OK" if mod_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= mod_ok

    window.close()
    app.processEvents()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

import stellar.config as config_module
from stellar.config import Config, DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL


def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL {name} {detail}")
    print(f"ok  {name} {detail}".rstrip())


def main() -> int:
    original = config_module.CONFIG_PATH
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "config.json"
            config_module.CONFIG_PATH = path
            path.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "player_name": "Steve",
                        "update_url": "http://127.0.0.1:8765/update.json",
                    }
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            cfg = Config.load()
            check("legacy_local_url_migrated", cfg.update_url == DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL, cfg.update_url)

            path.write_text(
                json.dumps({"update_url": "https://example.com/update.json"}),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            cfg = Config.load()
            check("custom_url_kept", cfg.update_url == "https://example.com/update.json", cfg.update_url)

            path.unlink()
            cfg = Config.load()
            check("default_url_used", cfg.update_url == DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL, cfg.update_url)
    finally:
        config_module.CONFIG_PATH = original
    print("RESULT: PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import os

def make_release(version: str = "1.9.12") -> ReleaseInfo:
    return ReleaseInfo(
        version=version,
        notes=[
            "新增启动器更新检测与下载",
            "新增 DKL 下载站",
            "更新时保留游戏版本、Mod、账户、好友与设置",
        ],
        download_url="http://example.invalid/DKL-update.zip",
        page_url="http://example.invalid/",
        sha256="a" * 64,
        size=1024 * 1024,
        released="2026-10-23",
        manifest_url="http://example.invalid/update.json",
    )


def main() -> int:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    app.setFont(QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 9))
    cfg = Config.load()
    theme.set_current(cfg.theme)
    app.setStyleSheet(theme.stylesheet(cfg.theme))

    ok = True

    def check(name: str, condition: bool) -> None:
        nonlocal ok
        print(f"{name}: {'OK' if condition else 'FAIL'}")
        ok &= bool(condition)

    window = MainWindow(cfg)
    window.config.save = lambda: None
    window.show()
    app.processEvents()

    page = window.settings_page
    check(
        "settings_widgets",
        hasattr(page, "update_btn")
        and hasattr(page, "update_auto_switch")
        and hasattr(page, "update_url_edit")
        and page.update_url_edit.text() == window.config.update_url,
    )
    check(
        "settings_state",
        page.update_status.text() == window.update_state_text,
    )

    release = make_release()
    window.last_update_release = release
    window.update_state_text = f"发现新版本 v{release.version}"
    window.update_state_kind = "accent"
    window.refresh_update_state()
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "settings_show_update",
        page.update_status.text() == f"发现新版本 v{release.version}",
    )

    dialog = UpdateDialog(window, release)
    dialog.show()
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "dialog_layout",
        dialog.progress_box.isHidden()
        and dialog.primary_btn.text() == "下载并更新"
        and dialog.skip_btn.text() == "跳过此版本",
    )
    check("dialog_version", dialog.version_label.text() == f"v{release.version}")

    dialog._on_finished(True, "ok", r"C:\tmp\dkl_bug_work\fake-payload")
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "download_ready",
        not dialog.progress_box.isHidden()
        and dialog.progress_bar.value() == 100
        and dialog.primary_btn.text() == "重启并更新"
        and not dialog.skip_btn.isEnabled(),
    )

    calls: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    window.apply_update = lambda payload, version: calls.append((payload, version)) or False
    dialog.primary_btn.click()
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "apply_click",
        calls == [(r"C:\tmp\dkl_bug_work\fake-payload", "1.9.12")]
        and dialog.primary_btn.isEnabled(),
    )
    dialog.reject()
    app.processEvents()

    skipped_config = window.config.update_skipped_version
    skip_dialog = UpdateDialog(window, release)
    skip_dialog._skip()
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "skip_version",
        window.config.update_skipped_version == "1.9.12"
        and skip_dialog.result() == 0,
    )
    window.config.update_skipped_version = skipped_config

    opened: list[str] = []
    window.open_update_dialog = lambda rel: opened.append(rel.version)
    window.update_state_text = "尚未检查更新"
    window.update_state_kind = "idle"
    window._update_check_ready(None, "", False)
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "up_to_date",
        window.update_state_kind == "success"
        and f"v{APP_VERSION}" in window.update_state_text
        and not opened,
    )

    window.config.update_skipped_version = "1.9.12"
    window._update_check_ready(release, "", False)
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "auto_skip",
        window.update_state_kind == "accent" and not opened,
    )
    window._update_check_ready(release, "", True)
    app.processEvents()
    check("manual_ignores_skip", opened == ["1.9.12"])

    window.game_running = True
    check("block_update_while_game_runs", window.apply_update("x", "1.9.12") is False)
    window.game_running = False

    page.update_status.setText("")
    window.update_state_text = "测试状态"
    window.update_state_kind = "error"
    window.refresh_update_state()
    app.processEvents()
    check("refresh_state_label", page.update_status.text() == "测试状态")

    window.close()
    app.processEvents()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import zipfile

from pathlib import Path

from stellar.updater import (
    UpdateError,
    apply_update_code,
    check_for_update,
    download_update,
    is_newer,
    prepare_update,
    read_version,
    sha256_file,
    write_apply_script,
)


def build_payload(root: Path, version: str) -> Path:
    package = root / f"DarkittenLauncher-{version}-source"
    (package / "stellar").mkdir(parents=True)
    (package / "assets").mkdir(parents=True)
    (package / "app.py").write_text(
        "from stellar.config import APP_VERSION\nprint(APP_VERSION)\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (package / "stellar" / "config.py").write_text(
        f'APP_VERSION = "{version}"\n', encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (package / "stellar" / "new_module.py").write_text(
        "VALUE = 'new'\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (package / "stellar" / "__pycache__").mkdir()
    (package / "stellar" / "__pycache__" / "junk.pyc").write_bytes(b"junk")
    (package / "assets" / "new.txt").write_text("new asset", encoding="utf-8")
    (package / "requirements.txt").write_text(
        "PySide6-Essentials==6.12.0\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (package / "launch.bat").write_text("@echo off\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return package


def build_install(root: Path) -> Path:
    install = root / "install"
    (install / "stellar").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "assets").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "minecraft" / "versions" / "1.21.1" / "mods").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "skins").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "servers" / "paper").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "app.py").write_text("OLD APP\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (install / "stellar" / "config.py").write_text(
        'APP_VERSION = "1.9.11"\n', encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (install / "stellar" / "old_module.py").write_text(
        "OLD = True\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (install / "stellar" / "__pycache__").mkdir()
    (install / "stellar" / "__pycache__" / "old.pyc").write_bytes(b"old")
    (install / "assets" / "old.txt").write_text("old asset", encoding="utf-8")
    (install / "config.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "account": {"name": "LFELKEEA", "token": "encrypted"},
                "player_name": "Steve",
                "update_url": "http://keep.me/update.json",
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (install / "social.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"friends": ["Mimi", "Neko"]}, ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (install / "minecraft" / "versions" / "1.21.1" / "mods" / "sodium.jar").write_bytes(
        b"MODDATA"
    )
    (install / "skins" / "custom.png").write_bytes(b"SKIN")
    (install / "servers" / "paper" / "server.properties").write_text(
        "motd=DKL\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    return install


def make_zip(package: Path, target: Path, root_name: str = "") -> Path:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for path in package.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file():
                relative = path.relative_to(package)
                arcname = (
                    f"{root_name}/{relative.as_posix()}"
                    if root_name
                    else relative.as_posix()
                )
                zf.write(path, arcname)
    return target


class QuietHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, _format, *args) -> None:
        pass


def main() -> int:
    ok = True

    def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
        nonlocal ok
        print(f"{name}: {'OK' if condition else 'FAIL'}{(' ' + detail) if detail and not condition else ''}")
        ok &= bool(condition)

    check("version_compare", is_newer("1.9.12", "1.9.11") and not is_newer("1.9.11", "1.9.12"))
    check("version_compare_minor", is_newer("1.10.0", "1.9.99") and is_newer("2.0", "1.99.99"))

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        install = build_install(root)
        payload = build_payload(root / "src", "1.9.12")
        web = root / "web"
        web.mkdir()
        archive = make_zip(
            payload, web / "DKL-1.9.12-update.zip", payload.name
        )
        digest = sha256_file(archive)
        manifest = {
            "version": "1.9.12",
            "released": "2026-10-23",
            "notes": ["启动器更新检测", "下载站", "保留游戏数据"],
            "download_url": "DKL-1.9.12-update.zip",
            "page_url": "index.html",
            "sha256": digest,
            "size": archive.stat().st_size,
        }
        (web / "update.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        (web / "index.html").write_text("<html>DKL</html>", encoding="utf-8")

        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), lambda *a, **k: QuietHandler(*a, directory=str(web), **k))
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}/"
        try:
            release = check_for_update("1.9.11", base + "update.json")
            check(
                "manifest_check",
                release is not None
                and release.version == "1.9.12"
                and release.download_url.endswith("DKL-1.9.12-update.zip")
                and release.page_url.endswith("index.html")
                and len(release.notes) == 3,
            )
            check("manifest_latest", check_for_update("1.9.12", base + "update.json") is None)

            updates = install / "updates"
            progress: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
            downloaded = download_update(
                release, updates, progress_cb=lambda p, m: progress.append((p, m))
            )
            check(
                "download_sha",
                downloaded.is_file() and sha256_file(downloaded) == digest,
            )
            check("download_progress", bool(progress) and progress[-1][0] == 100)

            prepared = prepare_update(downloaded, updates, "1.9.12")
            check(
                "prepare_payload",
                read_version(prepared) == "1.9.12"
                and (prepared / "stellar" / "new_module.py").is_file(),
            )

            backup = apply_update_code(prepared, install)
            check(
                "applied_code",
                "from stellar.config" in (install / "app.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                and (install / "stellar" / "new_module.py").is_file()
                and not (install / "stellar" / "old_module.py").exists()
                and read_version(install) == "1.9.12",
            )
            check(
                "preserved_config",
                json.loads((install / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))[
                    "account"
                ]["name"]
                == "LFELKEEA"
                and json.loads((install / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))[
                    "update_url"
                ]
                == "http://keep.me/update.json",
            )
            check(
                "preserved_social",
                json.loads((install / "social.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))[
                    "friends"
                ]
                == ["Mimi", "Neko"],
            )
            check(
                "preserved_game",
                (
                    install
                    / "minecraft"
                    / "versions"
                    / "1.21.1"
                    / "mods"
                    / "sodium.jar"
                ).read_bytes()
                == b"MODDATA"
                and (install / "skins" / "custom.png").read_bytes() == b"SKIN"
                and (
                    install / "servers" / "paper" / "server.properties"
                ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                == "motd=DKL\n",
            )
            check(
                "backup_created",
                (backup / "app.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "OLD APP\n"
                and (backup / "stellar" / "old_module.py").is_file(),
            )
            check(
                "pycache_ignored",
                not (install / "stellar" / "__pycache__" / "junk.pyc").exists(),
            )

            bad_manifest = dict(manifest)
            bad_manifest["sha256"] = "0" * 64
            (web / "bad.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(bad_manifest, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
            )
            bad_release = check_for_update(
                "1.9.11", base + "bad.json"
            )
            try:
                download_update(bad_release, root / "bad-download")
            except UpdateError:
                bad_rejected = True
            else:
                bad_rejected = False
            check("sha_rejected", bad_rejected)

            missing_sha = dict(manifest)
            missing_sha.pop("sha256")
            (web / "missing.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(missing_sha, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
            )
            missing_release = check_for_update(
                "1.9.11", base + "missing.json"
            )
            try:
                download_update(missing_release, root / "missing-download")
            except UpdateError:
                missing_rejected = True
            else:
                missing_rejected = False
            check("missing_sha_rejected", missing_rejected)

            slip_zip = root / "slip.zip"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(slip_zip, "w") as zf:
                zf.writestr("../evil.txt", "bad")
                zf.writestr("DKL/app.py", "bad")
                zf.writestr("DKL/stellar/config.py", "bad")
            try:
                prepare_update(slip_zip, root / "slip-out", "1.9.12")
            except UpdateError:
                slip_rejected = True
            else:
                slip_rejected = False
            check("zip_slip_rejected", slip_rejected)
            check(
                "zip_slip_no_file",
                not (root / "evil.txt").exists()
                and not (root / "slip-out" / "evil.txt").exists(),
            )

            script = write_apply_script(root / "script-out")
            check(
                "apply_script",
                script.is_file()
                and "apply_update_code" in script.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
            )
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# FILE: qa/test_version_zip.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from stellar.version_zip import (
    VersionZipError,
    import_version_zip,
    inspect_version_zip,
)


def version_json(version_id: str, inherits: str = "") -> str:
    data = {
        "id": version_id,
        "type": "release",
        "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
        "assets": "1.21",
        "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/index.json"},
        "downloads": {"client": {"url": "", "size": 0, "sha1": ""}},
        "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
        "libraries": [],
    }
    if inherits:
        data["inheritsFrom"] = inherits
    return json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)


class FakeInstaller:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[str] = []

    def install(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        self.calls.append(version_id)


def check(label: str, value: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if value else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail else ""))
    return value


def build_game_dir_zip(path: Path) -> None:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        zf.writestr("versions/TestZip/TestZip.json", version_json("TestZip"))
        zf.writestr("versions/TestZip/TestZip.jar", b"jar-data")
        zf.writestr("versions/TestZip/mods/demo.jar", b"mod-data")
        zf.writestr("versions/TestZip/config/demo.toml", "value=1")
        zf.writestr("libraries/foo/bar/1.0/bar-1.0.jar", b"lib-data")
        zf.writestr("assets/indexes/1.21.json", b"{}")
        zf.writestr("mods/shared.jar", b"shared-mod")


def main() -> None:
    ok = True
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        archive = root / "game-dir.zip"
        build_game_dir_zip(archive)

        info = inspect_version_zip(archive)
        candidate = info.primary
        ok &= check("candidate_id", candidate.version_id == "TestZip", candidate.version_id)
        ok &= check("layout", candidate.layout == "game_dir", candidate.layout)
        ok &= check("has_jar", candidate.has_jar, candidate.jar_rel)
        ok &= check("jar_rel", candidate.jar_rel == "TestZip.jar", candidate.jar_rel)
        ok &= check("mods_count", candidate.mods == 2, str(candidate.mods))
        ok &= check("config_count", candidate.config == 1, str(candidate.config))
        ok &= check("libraries_count", candidate.libraries == 1, str(candidate.libraries))
        ok &= check("assets_count", candidate.assets == 1, str(candidate.assets))
        ok &= check("total_files", candidate.total_files == 7, str(candidate.total_files))

        target = root / "target-game"
        installer = FakeInstaller()
        result = import_version_zip(
            archive,
            target,
            "ZipCat",
            isolated=True,
            installer=installer,
        )
        run = target / "versions" / "ZipCat"
        ok &= check("installer_called", installer.calls == ["ZipCat"], str(installer.calls))
        ok &= check("json_written", (run / "ZipCat.json").is_file())
        ok &= check("jar_renamed", (run / "ZipCat.jar").read_bytes() == b"jar-data")
        ok &= check("version_mod", (run / "mods" / "demo.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check("shared_mod", (run / "mods" / "shared.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check("config_imported", (run / "config" / "demo.toml").is_file())
        ok &= check("library_imported", (target / "libraries/foo/bar/1.0/bar-1.0.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check("asset_imported", (target / "assets/indexes/1.21.json").is_file())
        restored = json.loads((run / "ZipCat.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        ok &= check("id_rewritten", restored.get("id") == "ZipCat", str(restored.get("id")))
        ok &= check("imported_count", result.imported_files == 7, str(result.imported_files))
        ok &= check("old_folder_absent", not (target / "versions" / "TestZip").exists())

        try:
            import_version_zip(archive, target, "ZipCat", isolated=True, installer=FakeInstaller())
            ok &= check("existing_rejected", False)
        except VersionZipError:
            ok &= check("existing_rejected", True)

        resume_installer = FakeInstaller()
        result2 = import_version_zip(
            archive,
            target,
            "ZipCat",
            resume=True,
            overwrite=True,
            isolated=True,
            installer=resume_installer,
        )
        ok &= check("resume_import", result2.imported_files == 7, str(result2.imported_files))
        ok &= check("resume_installer", resume_installer.calls == ["ZipCat"])

        flat = root / "flat.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(flat, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("FlatCat.json", version_json("FlatCat"))
            zf.writestr("FlatCat.jar", b"flat-jar")
            zf.writestr("mods/flat.jar", b"flat-mod")
        flat_info = inspect_version_zip(flat)
        ok &= check("flat_layout", flat_info.primary.layout == "flat", flat_info.primary.layout)
        flat_target = root / "flat-game"
        import_version_zip(
            flat,
            flat_target,
            "FlatRestored",
            isolated=True,
            complete=False,
        )
        flat_run = flat_target / "versions" / "FlatRestored"
        ok &= check("flat_json", (flat_run / "FlatRestored.json").is_file())
        ok &= check("flat_jar", (flat_run / "FlatRestored.jar").read_bytes() == b"flat-jar")
        ok &= check("flat_mod", (flat_run / "mods" / "flat.jar").is_file())

        folder = root / "folder.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(folder, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("MyCat/MyCat.json", version_json("MyCat", inherits="1.21.1"))
            zf.writestr("MyCat/MyCat.jar", b"mycat-jar")
            zf.writestr("MyCat/resourcepacks/rp.zip", b"rp")
            zf.writestr("MyCat/libraries/game/lib.jar", b"lib")
        folder_info = inspect_version_zip(folder)
        ok &= check("folder_layout", folder_info.primary.layout == "folder", folder_info.primary.layout)
        ok &= check(
            "inherits_display",
            folder_info.primary.minecraft_version == "1.21.1",
            folder_info.primary.minecraft_version,
        )
        folder_target = root / "folder-game"
        import_version_zip(
            folder,
            folder_target,
            "FolderRestored",
            isolated=True,
            complete=False,
        )
        ok &= check(
            "folder_library_at_root",
            (folder_target / "libraries/game/lib.jar").is_file(),
        )
        ok &= check(
            "folder_resourcepack",
            (
                folder_target
                / "versions/FolderRestored/resourcepacks/rp.zip"
            ).is_file(),
        )

        dotmc = root / "dotmc.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(dotmc, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr(".minecraft/versions/McDir/McDir.json", version_json("McDir"))
            zf.writestr(".minecraft/versions/McDir/McDir.jar", b"mc-jar")
            zf.writestr(".minecraft/libraries/lib/a.jar", b"lib")
            zf.writestr(".minecraft/assets/indexes/a.json", b"{}")
            zf.writestr(".minecraft/options.txt", "fov:70")
        mc_info = inspect_version_zip(dotmc)
        mc_c = mc_info.primary
        ok &= check("dotmc_prefix", mc_c.game_prefix == ".minecraft/", mc_c.game_prefix)
        mc_target = root / "dotmc-game"
        import_version_zip(
            dotmc,
            mc_target,
            "McRestored",
            isolated=True,
            complete=False,
        )
        ok &= check("dotmc_json", (mc_target / "versions/McRestored/McRestored.json").is_file())
        ok &= check("dotmc_jar", (mc_target / "versions/McRestored/McRestored.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check("dotmc_lib", (mc_target / "libraries/lib/a.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check("dotmc_asset", (mc_target / "assets/indexes/a.json").is_file())
        ok &= check("dotmc_options_ignored", not (mc_target / "options.txt").exists())

        multi = root / "multi.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(multi, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("versions/A/A.json", version_json("A"))
            zf.writestr("versions/A/A.jar", b"a")
            zf.writestr("versions/B/B.json", version_json("B"))
        multi_info = inspect_version_zip(multi)
        ok &= check("multi_count", len(multi_info.candidates) == 2, str(len(multi_info.candidates)))
        ok &= check("multi_primary", multi_info.primary.version_id == "A", multi_info.primary.version_id)
        multi_target = root / "multi-game"
        selected = multi_info.find(version_id="B")
        import_version_zip(
            multi,
            multi_target,
            "RenamedB",
            candidate_json=selected.json_member,
            isolated=True,
            complete=False,
        )
        b_json = json.loads(
            (multi_target / "versions/RenamedB/RenamedB.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        )
        ok &= check("multi_rename", b_json.get("id") == "RenamedB", str(b_json.get("id")))

        bad = root / "bad.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(bad, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("versions/Bad/Bad.json", version_json("Bad"))
            zf.writestr("../evil.txt", "oops")
        try:
            inspect_version_zip(bad)
            ok &= check("traversal_rejected", False)
        except VersionZipError:
            ok &= check("traversal_rejected", True)

        empty = root / "empty.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(empty, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("mods/only.jar", b"mod")
        try:
            inspect_version_zip(empty)
            ok &= check("no_json_rejected", False)
        except VersionZipError:
            ok &= check("no_json_rejected", True)

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
