from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import html
import http.server
import json
import re
import secrets
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import webbrowser
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Callable

from .accounts import Account
from .config import APP_VERSION

DEVICE_CODE_URL = (
    "https://login.microsoftonline.com/consumers/oauth2/v2.0/devicecode"
)
AUTHORIZE_URL = "https://login.microsoftonline.com/consumers/oauth2/v2.0/authorize"
TOKEN_URL = "https://login.microsoftonline.com/consumers/oauth2/v2.0/token"
XBOX_USER_URL = "https://user.auth.xboxlive.com/user/authenticate"
XSTS_URL = "https://xsts.auth.xboxlive.com/xsts/authorize"
MC_LOGIN_URL = "https://api.minecraftservices.com/authentication/login_with_xbox"
MC_PROFILE_URL = "https://api.minecraftservices.com/minecraft/profile"
SCOPE = "XboxLive.signin offline_access"
USER_AGENT = f"DarkittenLauncher/{APP_VERSION} (Minecraft Launcher)"

CLIENT_ID_RE = re.compile(
    r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-"
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$"
)

XSTS_MESSAGES = {
    2148916233: "该 Microsoft 账户还没有 Xbox 账户，请先在 xbox.com 创建。",
    2148916235: "该账户所在地区无法使用 Xbox Live。",
    2148916236: "该账户需要先在 Xbox 页面完成年龄验证。",
    2148916237: "该账户需要先在 Xbox 页面完成年龄验证。",
    2148916238: "该账户是儿童账户，需要由家庭组中的成年人授权。",
}


class MicrosoftAuthError(Exception):
    pass


class MicrosoftAuthCancelled(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class DeviceCode:
    device_code: str
    user_code: str
    verification_uri: str
    verification_uri_complete: str
    expires_in: int
    interval: int
    message: str


@dataclass
class TokenResult:
    access_token: str
    refresh_token: str
    expires_in: int


class _HttpFailure(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status: int, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.status = status
        self.payload = payload
        super().__init__(str(payload.get("error") or status))


def normalize_client_id(value: str) -> str:
    client_id = (value or "").strip()
    if not client_id:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            "还没有填写 Azure 客户端 ID。请先在设置中填写应用注册的客户端 ID。"
        )
    if not CLIENT_ID_RE.fullmatch(client_id):
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            "客户端 ID 格式不正确，应为类似 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 的 GUID。"
        )
    return client_id


def _decode(raw: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return {}
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def _request(
    url: str,
    *,
    data: bytes | None = None,
    headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    timeout: int = 30,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    merged = {
        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        "Accept": "application/json",
    }
    if headers:
        merged.update(headers)
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=merged, method="POST" if data else "GET")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
            raw = response.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        payload = _decode(exc.read())
        raise _HttpFailure(exc.code, payload) from None
    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(f"无法连接 Microsoft 服务：{exc.reason}") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(f"网络请求失败：{exc}") from exc
    payload = _decode(raw)
    if not payload:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Microsoft 服务返回了无法识别的数据。")
    return payload


def _post_form(url: str, fields: dict[str, str], timeout: int = 30) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(fields).encode("utf-8")
    return _request(
        url,
        data=body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
        timeout=timeout,
    )


def _post_json(
    url: str, payload: dict[str, Any], timeout: int = 30
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return _request(
        url,
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "x-xbl-contract-version": "1",
        },
        timeout=timeout,
    )


def _oauth_message(failure: _HttpFailure) -> str:
    code = str(failure.payload.get("error") or "")
    description = str(failure.payload.get("error_description") or "").strip()
    friendly = {
        "invalid_client": "Azure 客户端 ID 无效，或应用没有启用公共客户端流程。",
        "unauthorized_client": (
            "该 Azure 应用不允许当前登录方式，请启用公共客户端流，"
            "并确认已注册 http://localhost 重定向 URI。"
        ),
        "invalid_grant": "登录授权已失效或被拒绝，请重新登录 Microsoft 账户。",
        "invalid_request": "登录请求无效，请检查客户端 ID、重定向 URI 与网络环境。",
        "unsupported_response_type": "登录方式不受支持，请检查 Azure 应用配置。",
        "temporarily_unavailable": "Microsoft 登录服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。",
    }
    if code in friendly:
        return friendly[code]
    if description:
        return description.splitlines()[0][:240]
    return f"Microsoft 登录失败（HTTP {failure.status}）。"


def request_device_code(client_id: str) -> DeviceCode:
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    try:
        payload = _post_form(
            DEVICE_CODE_URL, {"client_id": client_id, "scope": SCOPE}
        )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(_oauth_message(exc)) from None
    device_code = str(payload.get("device_code") or "")
    user_code = str(payload.get("user_code") or "")
    if not device_code or not user_code:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            str(payload.get("error_description") or "无法获取 Microsoft 登录验证码。")
        )
    uri = str(payload.get("verification_uri") or "https://microsoft.com/devicelogin")
    complete = str(payload.get("verification_uri_complete") or "")
    try:
        expires_in = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 900)
    except Exception:
        expires_in = 900
    try:
        interval = max(1, int(payload.get("interval") or 5))
    except Exception:
        interval = 5
    return DeviceCode(
        device_code=device_code,
        user_code=user_code,
        verification_uri=uri,
        verification_uri_complete=complete,
        expires_in=expires_in,
        interval=interval,
        message=str(payload.get("message") or ""),
    )


def poll_device_code(
    client_id: str,
    device_code: str,
    *,
    interval: int = 5,
    expires_in: int = 900,
    cancel_event=None,
    on_status: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
) -> TokenResult:
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + max(30, expires_in)
    delay = max(1, interval)
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if cancel_event is not None:
            if cancel_event.wait(delay):
                raise MicrosoftAuthCancelled()
        else:
            time.sleep(delay)
        try:
            payload = _post_form(
                TOKEN_URL,
                {
                    "grant_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code",
                    "client_id": client_id,
                    "device_code": device_code,
                },
            )
        except _HttpFailure as exc:
            error = str(exc.payload.get("error") or "")
            if error == "authorization_pending":
                if on_status:
                    on_status("等待在浏览器中完成登录…")
                continue
            if error == "slow_down":
                delay += 5
                if on_status:
                    on_status("登录服务要求降低轮询频率，继续等待…")
                continue
            if error == "authorization_declined":
                raise MicrosoftAuthError("你取消了 Microsoft 登录授权。") from None
            if error == "expired_token":
                raise MicrosoftAuthError("登录验证码已过期，请重新登录。") from None
            if error == "bad_verification_code":
                raise MicrosoftAuthError("验证码无效，请重新登录。") from None
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(_oauth_message(exc)) from None
        token = str(payload.get("access_token") or "")
        if not token:
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(
                str(payload.get("error_description") or "Microsoft 没有返回访问令牌。")
            )
        try:
            expires = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 3600)
        except Exception:
            expires = 3600
        return TokenResult(
            access_token=token,
            refresh_token=str(payload.get("refresh_token") or ""),
            expires_in=expires,
        )
    raise MicrosoftAuthError("登录验证码已过期，请重新登录。")


class _OAuthCallbackServer(http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, address: tuple[str, int]) -> None:
        super().__init__(address, _OAuthCallbackHandler)
        self.result: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.done = threading.Event()


class _OAuthCallbackHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server: _OAuthCallbackServer

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - BaseHTTPRequestHandler API
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        params = {
            key: values[0]
            for key, values in urllib.parse.parse_qs(
                parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True
            ).items()
        }
        if parsed.path not in ("", "/"):
            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        if not any(key in params for key in ("code", "error")):
            self._respond(
                400,
                "等待登录结果",
                "没有收到 Microsoft 登录结果，请回到启动器重新发起登录。",
            )
            return

        self.server.result = params
        self.server.done.set()
        error = params.get("error")
        if error:
            message = (
                params.get("error_description")
                or "Microsoft 登录没有完成，请回到启动器重试。"
            )
            self._respond(200, "登录未完成", message)
        else:
            self._respond(
                200,
                "登录完成",
                "已完成 Microsoft 授权，可以关闭此页面并返回启动器。",
            )

    def _respond(self, status: int, title: str, message: str) -> None:
        safe_title = html.escape(title)
        safe_message = html.escape(message[:500])
        body = f"""<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>{safe_title} · Darkitten Launcher</title>
<style>
  body {{ margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center;
         background: #f4f6fa; color: #1b2433;
         font-family: "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }}
  .card {{ width: min(460px, calc(100% - 40px)); padding: 36px 32px;
          background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; text-align: center;
          box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(20, 35, 60, .10); }}
  h1 {{ margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 22px; }}
  p {{ margin: 0; color: #5c6b80; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; }}
</style>
</head>
<body><div class="card"><h1>{safe_title}</h1><p>{safe_message}</p></div></body>
</html>"""
        raw = body.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.end_headers()
        try:
            self.wfile.write(raw)
        except OSError:
            pass

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        return


def _base64url(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")


def _pkce_pair() -> tuple[str, str]:
    verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
    challenge = _base64url(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
    return verifier, challenge


def _browser_error_message(error: str, description: str) -> str:
    if error in ("access_denied", "consent_required", "interaction_required"):
        return "你取消了 Microsoft 授权，或需要重新确认登录。"
    friendly = {
        "invalid_request": "Microsoft 登录请求无效，请检查 Azure 重定向 URI 是否为 http://localhost。",
        "unauthorized_client": (
            "该 Azure 应用不允许浏览器登录，请启用公共客户端流，"
            "并添加 http://localhost 重定向 URI。"
        ),
        "invalid_client": "Azure 客户端 ID 无效，或应用没有启用公共客户端流程。",
        "server_error": "Microsoft 登录服务出错，请稍后重试。",
        "temporarily_unavailable": "Microsoft 登录服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。",
    }
    if error in friendly:
        return friendly[error]
    if description:
        return description.splitlines()[0][:240]
    return f"Microsoft 登录没有完成（{error}）。"


def login_with_browser(
    client_id: str,
    *,
    login_hint: str = "",
    on_url: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
    on_status: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    timeout: int = 300,
) -> Account:
    """通过系统浏览器 + PKCE + 本地回调完成 Microsoft 登录。

    Microsoft 不允许第三方应用直接收集账户密码；这里会把邮箱作为 login_hint
    预填到 Microsoft 官方登录页，授权完成后由本机回环地址自动接收授权码。
    """
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    login_hint = (login_hint or "").strip()

    try:
        server = _OAuthCallbackServer(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    except OSError as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(f"无法启动本地登录回调服务：{exc}") from None

    port = int(server.server_address[1])
    redirect_uri = f"http://localhost:{port}"
    verifier, challenge = _pkce_pair()
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    query = {
        "client_id": client_id,
        "response_type": "code",
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "response_mode": "query",
        "scope": SCOPE,
        "state": state,
        "code_challenge": challenge,
        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
    }
    if login_hint:
        query["login_hint"] = login_hint
    url = AUTHORIZE_URL + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(query)

    thread = threading.Thread(
        target=server.serve_forever, kwargs={"poll_interval": 0.1}, daemon=True
    )
    thread.start()
    try:
        if on_url:
            on_url(url)
        try:
            opened = bool(webbrowser.open(url))
        except Exception:
            opened = False
        if on_status:
            on_status(
                "已打开系统浏览器，请在 Microsoft 页面完成登录…"
                if opened
                else "无法自动打开浏览器，请点击“重新打开登录页”。"
            )

        deadline = time.monotonic() + max(60, int(timeout))
        while not server.done.is_set():
            if cancel_event is not None:
                if cancel_event.wait(0.25):
                    raise MicrosoftAuthCancelled()
            else:
                time.sleep(0.25)
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise MicrosoftAuthError(
                    "等待 Microsoft 登录超时。请重试，并确认浏览器已完成授权。"
                )
        result = dict(server.result)
    finally:
        try:
            server.shutdown()
        except Exception:
            pass
        server.server_close()
        thread.join(timeout=1)

    if str(result.get("state") or "") != state:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("登录回调校验失败，请重新登录 Microsoft 账户。")
    error = str(result.get("error") or "")
    if error:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            _browser_error_message(
                error, str(result.get("error_description") or "").strip()
            )
        )
    code = str(result.get("code") or "")
    if not code:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Microsoft 登录没有返回授权码，请重试。")

    if on_status:
        on_status("正在完成 Microsoft 与 Minecraft 账户验证…")
    try:
        payload = _post_form(
            TOKEN_URL,
            {
                "grant_type": "authorization_code",
                "client_id": client_id,
                "code": code,
                "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
                "code_verifier": verifier,
                "scope": SCOPE,
            },
        )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(_oauth_message(exc)) from None

    access_token = str(payload.get("access_token") or "")
    if not access_token:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Microsoft 没有返回访问令牌，请重新登录。")
    try:
        expires_in = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 3600)
    except Exception:
        expires_in = 3600
    account = Account(
        kind="msa",
        access_token=access_token,
        refresh_token=str(payload.get("refresh_token") or ""),
        expires_at=time.time() + expires_in,
    )
    return _complete_chain(account)


def refresh_microsoft_token(client_id: str, refresh_token: str) -> TokenResult:
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    if not refresh_token:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("登录状态已失效，请重新登录 Microsoft 账户。")
    try:
        payload = _post_form(
            TOKEN_URL,
            {
                "grant_type": "refresh_token",
                "client_id": client_id,
                "refresh_token": refresh_token,
                "scope": SCOPE,
            },
        )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(_oauth_message(exc)) from None
    token = str(payload.get("access_token") or "")
    if not token:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("无法刷新 Microsoft 登录状态，请重新登录。")
    try:
        expires = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 3600)
    except Exception:
        expires = 3600
    return TokenResult(
        access_token=token,
        refresh_token=str(payload.get("refresh_token") or refresh_token),
        expires_in=expires,
    )


def _xbox_user_token(ms_access_token: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    last: _HttpFailure | None = None
    for ticket in (f"d={ms_access_token}", ms_access_token):
        try:
            payload = _post_json(
                XBOX_USER_URL,
                {
                    "Properties": {
                        "AuthMethod": "RPS",
                        "SiteName": "user.auth.xboxlive.com",
                        "RpsTicket": ticket,
                    },
                    "RelyingParty": "http://auth.xboxlive.com",
                    "TokenType": "JWT",
                },
            )
            break
        except _HttpFailure as exc:
            last = exc
    else:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            f"Xbox Live 身份验证失败（HTTP {last.status if last else '?'}）。"
        )
    token = str(payload.get("Token") or "")
    claims = (payload.get("DisplayClaims") or {}).get("xui") or []
    uhs = str((claims[0] if claims else {}).get("uhs") or "")
    xuid = str((claims[0] if claims else {}).get("xid") or "")
    if not token or not uhs:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Xbox Live 没有返回有效的用户令牌。")
    return token, uhs, xuid


def _xsts_token(user_token: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    try:
        payload = _post_json(
            XSTS_URL,
            {
                "Properties": {
                    "SandboxId": "RETAIL",
                    "UserTokens": [user_token],
                },
                "RelyingParty": "rp://api.minecraftservices.com/",
                "TokenType": "JWT",
            },
        )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        try:
            xerr = int(exc.payload.get("XErr") or 0)
        except Exception:
            xerr = 0
        message = XSTS_MESSAGES.get(xerr)
        if message:
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(message) from None
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            f"Xbox 安全令牌验证失败（HTTP {exc.status}"
            + (f"，XErr {xerr}" if xerr else "")
            + "）。"
        ) from None
    token = str(payload.get("Token") or "")
    claims = (payload.get("DisplayClaims") or {}).get("xui") or []
    uhs = str((claims[0] if claims else {}).get("uhs") or "")
    xuid = str((claims[0] if claims else {}).get("xid") or "")
    if not token or not uhs:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Xbox 安全令牌响应不完整。")
    return token, uhs, xuid


def minecraft_login(xsts_token: str, uhs: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    try:
        payload = _post_json(
            MC_LOGIN_URL,
            {"identityToken": f"XBL3.0 x={uhs};{xsts_token}"},
        )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        if exc.status in (400, 401, 403):
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(
                "Minecraft 登录被拒绝，请确认该账户已购买 Minecraft Java Edition。"
            ) from None
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            f"Minecraft 登录失败（HTTP {exc.status}）。"
        ) from None
    token = str(payload.get("access_token") or "")
    if not token:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Minecraft 服务没有返回访问令牌。")
    try:
        expires_in = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 86400)
    except Exception:
        expires_in = 86400
    return token, expires_in


def fetch_profile(mc_access_token: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        MC_PROFILE_URL,
        headers={
            "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
            "Accept": "application/json",
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {mc_access_token}",
        },
        method="GET",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
            raw = response.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        if exc.status == 404:
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(
                "该 Microsoft 账户没有 Minecraft Java Edition，或还没有创建游戏档案。"
            ) from None
        if exc.status == 401:
            raise MicrosoftAuthError("Minecraft 登录已失效，请重新登录。") from None
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            f"获取 Minecraft 档案失败（HTTP {exc.status}）。"
        ) from None
    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(f"无法连接 Minecraft 服务：{exc.reason}") from None
    payload = _decode(raw)
    if not payload.get("id") or not payload.get("name"):
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Minecraft 档案数据不完整。")
    return payload


def _complete_chain(account: Account) -> Account:
    user_token, uhs, xuid = _xbox_user_token(account.access_token)
    xsts_token, xsts_uhs, xsts_xuid = _xsts_token(user_token)
    mc_token, expires_in = minecraft_login(xsts_token, xsts_uhs or uhs)
    profile = fetch_profile(mc_token)
    account.mc_access_token = mc_token
    account.mc_expires_at = time.time() + max(0, expires_in - 120)
    account.uuid = str(profile.get("id") or "")
    account.name = str(profile.get("name") or "")
    account.xuid = xsts_xuid or xuid
    if not account.uuid or not account.name:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("无法读取 Minecraft 账户名称。")
    return account


def login_with_device_code(
    client_id: str,
    *,
    on_code: Callable[[DeviceCode], None] | None = None,
    on_status: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
    cancel_event=None,
) -> Account:
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    device = request_device_code(client_id)
    if on_code:
        on_code(device)
    token = poll_device_code(
        client_id,
        device.device_code,
        interval=device.interval,
        expires_in=device.expires_in,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
        on_status=on_status,
    )
    account = Account(
        kind="msa",
        access_token=token.access_token,
        refresh_token=token.refresh_token,
        expires_at=time.time() + token.expires_in,
    )
    if on_status:
        on_status("正在验证 Xbox 与 Minecraft 账户…")
    return _complete_chain(account)


def ensure_minecraft_token(account: Account, client_id: str) -> Account:
    """确保正版账户拥有可用的 Minecraft 访问令牌。"""
    if not account.is_msa:
        return account
    if (
        account.mc_access_token
        and account.mc_expires_at > time.time() + 60
        and account.name
        and account.uuid
    ):
        return account
    if not client_id:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            "缺少 Azure 客户端 ID，无法刷新正版登录状态。请到设置中填写后重试。"
        )
    token = refresh_microsoft_token(client_id, account.refresh_token)
    account.access_token = token.access_token
    account.refresh_token = token.refresh_token or account.refresh_token
    account.expires_at = time.time() + token.expires_in
    return _complete_chain(account)

# FILE: stellar/migration.py

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import shutil
import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable

from .modrinth import (
    ModrinthError,
    download_mod_file,
    fetch_mod_versions,
    lookup_version_by_hash,
    version_supports,
)
from .paths import version_game_dir
from .versions import ResolvedVersion, resolve_version

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
LogCallback = Callable[[str], None]

CATEGORY_DIRS: dict[str, str] = {
    "saves": "saves",
    "config": "config",
    "resourcepacks": "resourcepacks",
    "shaderpacks": "shaderpacks",
}

CATEGORY_NAMES: dict[str, str] = {
    "saves": "存档",
    "config": "配置",
    "resourcepacks": "资源包",
    "shaderpacks": "光影",
    "mods": "模组",
    "options": "选项与服务器列表",
}

OPTION_FILES = ("options.txt", "optionsof.txt", "servers.dat")

DEFAULT_CATEGORIES = (
    "saves",
    "config",
    "resourcepacks",
    "shaderpacks",
    "mods",
    "options",
)


class MigrationError(Exception):
    pass


class MigrationCancelled(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class ModCandidate:
    path: Path
    filename: str
    disabled: bool
    size: int = 0
    sha1: str = ""

    @property
    def base_name(self) -> str:
        return self.filename[: -len(".disabled")] if self.disabled else self.filename

    @property
    def target_name(self) -> str:
        return self.base_name + (".disabled" if self.disabled else "")


@dataclass
class MigrationPlan:
    game_dir: Path
    source_id: str
    target_id: str
    source_mc: str
    target_mc: str
    source_loader: str
    target_loader: str
    source_dir: Path
    target_dir: Path
    categories: list[str]
    mods: list[ModCandidate] = field(default_factory=list)
    file_counts: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    total_files: int = 0
    total_bytes: int = 0
    conflicts: int = 0
    same_dir: bool = False


@dataclass
class MigrationReport:
    source_id: str
    target_id: str
    copied_files: int = 0
    skipped_files: int = 0
    matched_mods: int = 0
    copied_mods: int = 0
    skipped_mods: int = 0
    copied_bytes: int = 0
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def summary(self) -> str:
        parts = [f"迁移 {self.copied_files} 个文件"]
        if self.matched_mods:
            parts.append(f"匹配 {self.matched_mods} 个 Mod")
        if self.copied_mods:
            parts.append(f"迁移 {self.copied_mods} 个 Mod")
        if self.skipped_files or self.skipped_mods:
            parts.append(f"跳过 {self.skipped_files + self.skipped_mods} 项")
        if self.warnings:
            parts.append(f"{len(self.warnings)} 条提醒")
        return "，".join(parts)


def _check_cancel(cancel_event: threading.Event | None) -> None:
    if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
        raise MigrationCancelled()


def _mc_version(resolved: ResolvedVersion) -> str:
    return str(resolved.chain[0] if resolved.chain else resolved.id)


def _iter_files(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    if not root.is_dir():
        return []
    result: list[Path] = []
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        try:
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                continue
        except OSError:
            continue
        result.append(path)
    return result


def _mod_candidates(source_dir: Path) -> list[ModCandidate]:
    mods_dir = source_dir / "mods"
    if not mods_dir.is_dir():
        return []
    result: list[ModCandidate] = []
    for path in sorted(mods_dir.iterdir(), key=lambda item: item.name.lower()):
        try:
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                continue
        except OSError:
            continue
        name = path.name
        disabled = name.lower().endswith(".jar.disabled")
        if not disabled and not name.lower().endswith(".jar"):
            continue
        try:
            size = path.stat().st_size
        except OSError:
            size = 0
        result.append(
            ModCandidate(
                path=path,
                filename=name,
                disabled=disabled,
                size=size,
            )
        )
    return result


def collect_migration_plan(
    game_dir: Path,
    source_id: str,
    target_id: str = "",
    categories: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
    isolated: bool = True,
) -> MigrationPlan:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    selected = [
        key
        for key in (categories or DEFAULT_CATEGORIES)
        if key in CATEGORY_DIRS or key in ("mods", "options")
    ]
    try:
        source_resolved = resolve_version(game_dir, source_id)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise MigrationError(f"无法读取源版本 {source_id}：{exc}") from exc

    target_resolved: ResolvedVersion | None = None
    if target_id:
        try:
            target_resolved = resolve_version(game_dir, target_id)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise MigrationError(f"无法读取目标版本 {target_id}：{exc}") from exc

    source_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, source_id, isolated)
    target_dir = (
        version_game_dir(game_dir, target_id, isolated)
        if target_id
        else source_dir
    )
    same_dir = bool(target_id) and source_dir.resolve() == target_dir.resolve()

    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    total_bytes = 0
    total_files = 0
    conflicts = 0

    for key in selected:
        if key in CATEGORY_DIRS:
            files = _iter_files(source_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key])
            counts[key] = len(files)
            for path in files:
                try:
                    total_bytes += path.stat().st_size
                except OSError:
                    pass
                if target_id and not same_dir:
                    rel = path.relative_to(source_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key])
                    if (target_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key] / rel).exists():
                        conflicts += 1
            total_files += len(files)
        elif key == "options":
            files = [
                source_dir / name
                for name in OPTION_FILES
                if (source_dir / name).is_file()
            ]
            counts[key] = len(files)
            for path in files:
                try:
                    total_bytes += path.stat().st_size
                except OSError:
                    pass
                if target_id and not same_dir and (target_dir / path.name).exists():
                    conflicts += 1
            total_files += len(files)

    mods = _mod_candidates(source_dir) if "mods" in selected else []
    counts["mods"] = len(mods)
    total_files += len(mods)
    total_bytes += sum(mod.size for mod in mods)
    if target_id and not same_dir:
        target_mods = target_dir / "mods"
        conflicts += sum(1 for mod in mods if (target_mods / mod.target_name).exists())

    return MigrationPlan(
        game_dir=game_dir,
        source_id=source_id,
        target_id=target_id,
        source_mc=_mc_version(source_resolved),
        target_mc=_mc_version(target_resolved) if target_resolved else "",
        source_loader=source_resolved.loader,
        target_loader=target_resolved.loader if target_resolved else "",
        source_dir=source_dir,
        target_dir=target_dir,
        categories=selected,
        mods=mods,
        file_counts=counts,
        total_files=total_files,
        total_bytes=total_bytes,
        conflicts=conflicts,
        same_dir=same_dir,
    )


def _sha1_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    with path.open("rb") as fp:
        while True:
            chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _copy_file(source: Path, target: Path) -> int:
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(source, target)
    try:
        return target.stat().st_size
    except OSError:
        return 0


def _copy_mod(mod: ModCandidate, target: Path) -> int:
    if target.exists():
        return 0
    return _copy_file(mod.path, target)


def _find_compatible_mod(
    mod: ModCandidate,
    loader: str,
    mc_version: str,
    log: LogCallback,
) -> dict | None:
    if not loader or not mc_version:
        return None
    try:
        if not mod.sha1:
            mod.sha1 = _sha1_file(mod.path)
        cached = lookup_version_by_hash(mod.sha1)
    except Exception as exc:
        log(f"{mod.base_name}: 查询 Modrinth 失败（{exc}）")
        return None
    if isinstance(cached, dict) and version_supports(cached, loader, mc_version):
        return cached
    project_id = ""
    if isinstance(cached, dict):
        project_id = str(cached.get("project_id") or "")
        if not project_id:
            project_id = str(cached.get("projectId") or "")
    if not project_id:
        return None
    try:
        versions = fetch_mod_versions(project_id, loader, mc_version)
    except ModrinthError as exc:
        log(f"{mod.base_name}: 获取目标版本失败（{exc}）")
        return None
    if not versions:
        return None
    preferred = [version for version in versions if version_supports(version, loader, mc_version)]
    return preferred[0] if preferred else None


def run_migration(
    plan: MigrationPlan,
    *,
    match_mods: bool = True,
    copy_unmatched: bool = True,
    overwrite: bool = False,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    threads: int = 8,
) -> MigrationReport:
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda m: None)
    report = MigrationReport(source_id=plan.source_id, target_id=plan.target_id)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 复制目录
    tasks: list[tuple[Path, Path, str]] = []
    if not plan.same_dir:
        for key in plan.categories:
            if key in CATEGORY_DIRS:
                root = plan.source_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key]
                for source in _iter_files(root):
                    rel = source.relative_to(root)
                    tasks.append(
                        (source, plan.target_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key] / rel, key)
                    )
            elif key == "options":
                for name in OPTION_FILES:
                    source = plan.source_dir / name
                    if source.is_file():
                        tasks.append((source, plan.target_dir / name, key))

    log(
        f"迁移计划：{plan.source_id} → {plan.target_id or '（安装中）'}"
        f" · {plan.total_files} 个文件 · {plan.total_bytes / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
    )
    if plan.same_dir:
        log("源版本与目标版本共用同一个游戏目录，跳过内容复制，只处理 Mod 匹配。")
    if plan.total_files == 0:
        log("没有找到可迁移的内容。")

    total_tasks = max(1, len(tasks))
    for index, (source, target, category) in enumerate(tasks):
        _check_cancel(cancel_event)
        progress(
            int(index * 60 / total_tasks),
            f"正在迁移{CATEGORY_NAMES.get(category, category)} "
            f"{index + 1}/{len(tasks)}",
        )
        try:
            if target.exists() and not overwrite:
                report.skipped_files += 1
                continue
            report.copied_bytes += _copy_file(source, target)
            report.copied_files += 1
        except Exception as exc:
            report.warnings.append(f"{source.name}: 复制失败（{exc}）")
            log(f"复制失败：{source}（{exc}）")

    progress(60, "内容复制完成，正在处理 Mod…")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 迁移 Mod
    target_mods = plan.target_dir / "mods"
    mod_total = max(1, len(plan.mods))
    loader_key = str(plan.target_loader or "").strip().lower()
    for index, mod in enumerate(plan.mods):
        _check_cancel(cancel_event)
        percent = 60 + int(index * 36 / mod_total)
        progress(percent, f"正在处理 Mod {index + 1}/{len(plan.mods)} · {mod.base_name}")
        target = target_mods / mod.target_name
        base_target = target_mods / mod.base_name
        if target.exists() and not overwrite:
            report.skipped_mods += 1
            continue
        if mod.disabled and base_target.exists() and not target.exists():
            # 目标里已有同名启用文件，不再额外放一个禁用副本。
            report.skipped_mods += 1
            log(f"{mod.base_name}: 目标已有启用版本，跳过禁用副本")
            continue

        matched: dict | None = None
        if match_mods:
            matched = _find_compatible_mod(mod, loader_key, plan.target_mc, log)

        if matched is not None:
            try:
                log(f"{mod.base_name}: 匹配到 Modrinth 目标版本")
                downloaded = download_mod_file(
                    matched,
                    target_mods,
                    progress_cb=lambda p, m, i=index: progress(
                        60 + int((i + p / 100.0) * 36 / mod_total), m
                    ),
                    cancel_event=cancel_event,
                    threads=threads,
                )
                final = target
                if mod.disabled:
                    final = target_mods / (downloaded.name + ".disabled")
                if downloaded != final:
                    if final.exists() and not overwrite:
                        report.skipped_mods += 1
                    else:
                        downloaded.replace(final)
                report.matched_mods += 1
                report.copied_mods += 1
                continue
            except MigrationCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                message = f"{mod.base_name}: 下载匹配版本失败（{exc}）"
                report.warnings.append(message)
                log(message)

        if copy_unmatched:
            try:
                size = _copy_mod(mod, target)
                report.copied_mods += 1
                report.copied_bytes += size
                reason = (
                    "未匹配到目标加载器/MC 版本"
                    if match_mods
                    else "未开启 Mod 匹配"
                )
                message = f"{mod.base_name}: {reason}，已保留原文件（可能不兼容）"
                report.warnings.append(message)
                log(message)
            except Exception as exc:
                report.warnings.append(f"{mod.base_name}: 复制失败（{exc}）")
                log(f"Mod 复制失败：{mod.base_name}（{exc}）")
        else:
            report.skipped_mods += 1
            message = f"{mod.base_name}: 未匹配到目标版本，已跳过"
            report.warnings.append(message)
            log(message)

    progress(100, "迁移完成")
    log(report.summary())
    return report

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
import urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from .downloader import DownloadCancelled, download_to_file, http_open as _http_open

MODRINTH_API = "https://api.modrinth.com/v2"
ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]

LOADER_KEYS = {"Fabric": "fabric", "Forge": "forge", "NeoForge": "neoforge"}


class ModrinthError(Exception):
    pass


def _get_json(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> Any:
    try:
        with _http_open(url, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            raw = resp.read()
        return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModrinthError(f"无法连接 Modrinth：{exc}") from exc


def _loader_key(loader: str) -> str:
    if not loader:
        return ""
    if loader in LOADER_KEYS:
        return LOADER_KEYS[loader]
    return loader.strip().lower()


def search_mods(
    query: str,
    *,
    loader: str = "",
    game_version: str = "",
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    facets: list[list[str]] = [["project_type:mod"]]
    key = _loader_key(loader)
    if key:
        facets.append([f"categories:{key}"])
    if game_version:
        facets.append([f"versions:{game_version}"])
    params = {
        "query": query.strip(),
        "limit": max(1, min(50, int(limit))),
        "offset": max(0, int(offset)),
        "index": "relevance" if query.strip() else "downloads",
        "facets": json.dumps(facets, separators=(",", ":")),
    }
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/search?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 返回了无法识别的数据")
    return data


def search_server_addons(
    query: str,
    *,
    server_type: str,
    game_version: str = "",
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """搜索服务端插件（Paper/Spigot）或服务端 Mod。"""
    server = str(server_type or "").lower()
    if server in ("paper", "spigot"):
        facets: list[list[str]] = [
            ["project_type:plugin"],
            ["categories:paper", "categories:spigot", "categories:bukkit"],
        ]
    elif server in ("fabric", "forge", "neoforge"):
        facets = [
            ["project_type:mod"],
            [f"categories:{server}"],
            ["server_side:required", "server_side:optional"],
        ]
    else:
        raise ModrinthError("未知的服务端类型")
    if game_version:
        facets.append([f"versions:{game_version}"])
    params = {
        "query": query.strip(),
        "limit": max(1, min(50, int(limit))),
        "offset": max(0, int(offset)),
        "index": "relevance" if query.strip() else "downloads",
        "facets": json.dumps(facets, separators=(",", ":")),
    }
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/search?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 返回了无法识别的数据")
    return data


def fetch_server_addon_versions(
    project_id: str,
    server_type: str,
    game_version: str = "",
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    server = str(server_type or "").lower()
    if server in ("paper", "spigot"):
        loaders = ["paper", "spigot", "bukkit"]
    elif server in ("fabric", "forge", "neoforge"):
        loaders = [server]
    else:
        raise ModrinthError("未知的服务端类型")
    params: dict[str, str] = {"loaders": json.dumps(loaders)}
    if game_version:
        params["game_versions"] = json.dumps([game_version])
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/project/{project_id}/version?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(
        params
    )
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 版本列表格式不正确")
    result = []
    for entry in data:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        files = entry.get("files") or []
        if not isinstance(files, list) or not files:
            continue
        if not any(isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("url") for f in files):
            continue
        result.append(entry)
    return result


def fetch_projects(project_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """批量读取项目摘要，用于前置 Mod 按钮显示名称和图标。"""
    ids = list(dict.fromkeys(str(item).strip() for item in project_ids if str(item).strip()))
    if not ids:
        return {}
    params = {"ids": json.dumps(ids, separators=(",", ":"))}
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/projects?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 返回的项目列表无法识别")
    result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for item in data:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        for key in (item.get("id"), item.get("slug")):
            if key:
                result[str(key)] = item
    return result


def fetch_project(project_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """读取 Modrinth 项目详情（图标、画廊、统计、链接和正文）。"""
    project_id = (project_id or "").strip()
    if not project_id:
        raise ModrinthError("缺少 Mod 项目 ID")
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/project/{urllib.parse.quote(project_id, safe='')}"
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get("id"):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 返回的项目详情无法识别")
    gallery = []
    for item in data.get("gallery") or []:
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("url"):
            gallery.append(item)
        elif isinstance(item, str) and item:
            gallery.append({"url": item})
    gallery.sort(key=lambda item: 0 if item.get("featured") else 1)
    data["gallery"] = gallery
    return data


def fetch_mod_versions(
    project_id: str, loader: str = "", game_version: str = ""
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    params: dict[str, str] = {}
    key = _loader_key(loader)
    if key:
        params["loaders"] = json.dumps([key])
    if game_version:
        params["game_versions"] = json.dumps([game_version])
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/project/{project_id}/version"
    if params:
        url += "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 版本列表格式不正确")
    result = []
    for entry in data:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        files = entry.get("files") or []
        if not isinstance(files, list) or not files:
            continue
        if not any(isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("url") for f in files):
            continue
        result.append(entry)
    return result


def lookup_version_by_hash(sha1: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """按文件 SHA-1 反查 Modrinth 版本；未收录时返回 None。"""
    digest = str(sha1 or "").strip().lower()
    if not digest:
        return None
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/version_file/{digest}?algorithm=sha1"
    try:
        data = _get_json(url)
    except ModrinthError:
        return None
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("id") else None


def version_supports(
    version: dict[str, Any], loader: str = "", game_version: str = ""
) -> bool:
    """判断 Modrinth 版本是否支持目标加载器与 MC 版本。"""
    if not isinstance(version, dict):
        return False
    key = _loader_key(loader)
    loaders = {str(item).lower() for item in version.get("loaders") or []}
    games = {str(item) for item in version.get("game_versions") or []}
    if key and key not in loaders:
        return False
    if game_version and game_version not in games:
        return False
    return True


def primary_file(version: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    files = [f for f in version.get("files") or [] if isinstance(f, dict)]
    for item in files:
        if item.get("primary") and item.get("url"):
            return item
    for item in files:
        if item.get("url"):
            return item
    return None


def required_dependencies(version: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [
        dep
        for dep in version.get("dependencies") or []
        if isinstance(dep, dict) and dep.get("dependency_type") == "required"
    ]


def download_mod_file(
    version: dict[str, Any],
    mods_dir: Path,
    *,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    threads: int = 8,
) -> Path:
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    file = primary_file(version)
    if not file:
        raise ModrinthError("这个版本没有可下载的文件")
    filename = Path(str(file.get("filename") or "")).name
    if not filename:
        filename = f"{version.get('id', 'mod')}.jar"
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    mods_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = mods_dir / filename
    hashes = file.get("hashes") or {}
    sha1 = str(hashes.get("sha1") or "")
    size = int(file.get("size") or 0)

    if dest.exists():
        if size and dest.stat().st_size == size:
            progress(100, f"{filename} 已存在")
            return dest
        if not size:
            progress(100, f"{filename} 已存在")
            return dest

    progress(1, f"正在下载 {filename}")

    def on_bytes(done: int, total: int) -> None:
        if total:
            percent = max(1, min(99, int(done * 100 / total)))
            progress(
                percent,
                f"{filename} · {done / 1024 / 1024:.1f}/{total / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB",
            )
        else:
            progress(50, f"正在下载 {filename}")

    try:
        download_to_file(
            str(file["url"]),
            dest,
            sha1=sha1,
            size=size,
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
            progress_cb=on_bytes,
            connections=min(4, max(2, int(threads) // 2)),
        )
    except DownloadCancelled:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModrinthError(str(exc)) from exc
    progress(100, "下载完成")
    return dest

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil
import threading
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
from typing import Any, Callable

from urllib.parse import urlparse

from .downloader import DownloadCancelled, download_to_file, http_open
from .installer import Installer
from .loaders import install_loader
from .paths import version_game_dir
from .packs import normalize_version_id
from .versions import version_json_path

MODRINTH_MANIFEST = "modrinth.index.json"
MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_TOTAL_FILES = 100_000
MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 64 * 1024**3
MODRINTH_API = "https://api.modrinth.com/v2"

CONTENT_DIRS = (
    "mods",
    "config",
    "defaultconfigs",
    "resourcepacks",
    "shaderpacks",
    "saves",
)
_RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS = {"versions", "libraries", "assets", "logs", "crash-reports"}
_RESERVED_DOWNLOAD_DIRS = {"versions", "libraries", "assets"}
_WINDOWS_RESERVED = {
    "CON",
    "PRN",
    "AUX",
    "NUL",
    *(f"COM{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
    *(f"LPT{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
}
_LOADER_KEYS = {
    "fabric-loader": ("fabric", "Fabric"),
    "forge": ("forge", "Forge"),
    "neoforge": ("neoforge", "NeoForge"),
    "quilt-loader": ("quilt", "Quilt"),
}

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
LogCallback = Callable[[str], None]


class ModrinthPackError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class ModrinthFile:
    path: str
    sha1: str
    size: int
    urls: list[str]
    client: str = "required"


@dataclass
class ModrinthOverride:
    member: str
    relative: str
    size: int
    client_only: bool = False


@dataclass
class ModrinthPackInfo:
    path: Path
    manifest: dict[str, Any]
    files: list[ModrinthFile]
    overrides: list[ModrinthOverride]
    counts: dict[str, int]
    total_files: int
    total_bytes: int
    archive_bytes: int

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("name") or self.path.stem or "Modrinth 整合包")

    @property
    def description(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("summary") or "")

    @property
    def version_id(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("versionId") or "")

    @property
    def created_at(self) -> str:
        return ""

    @property
    def created_with(self) -> str:
        return "Modrinth"

    @property
    def minecraft_version(self) -> str:
        dependencies = self.manifest.get("dependencies") or {}
        return str(dependencies.get("minecraft") or "")

    @property
    def loader_key(self) -> str:
        dependencies = self.manifest.get("dependencies") or {}
        for key in _LOADER_KEYS:
            if dependencies.get(key):
                return key
        return ""

    @property
    def loader(self) -> str:
        key = self.loader_key
        return _LOADER_KEYS.get(key, ("", ""))[1]

    @property
    def loader_version(self) -> str:
        key = self.loader_key
        if not key:
            return ""
        dependencies = self.manifest.get("dependencies") or {}
        return str(dependencies.get(key) or "")

    @property
    def loader_kind(self) -> str:
        return _LOADER_KEYS.get(self.loader_key, ("", ""))[0]


@dataclass
class ModrinthImportResult:
    version_id: str
    imported_files: int
    skipped_files: int
    imported_bytes: int
    downloaded_files: int


def looks_like_modrinth_pack(path: Path | str) -> bool:
    archive = Path(path)
    if not archive.is_file():
        return False
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            return any(
                name.replace("\\", "/").lower() == MODRINTH_MANIFEST
                for name in zf.namelist()
            )
    except Exception:
        return False


def _safe_path(name: str, label: str = "整合包") -> str:
    value = str(name or "").replace("\\", "/")
    if not value or value.startswith("/") or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", value):
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"{label}内包含非法路径：{name}")
    parts = PurePosixPath(value).parts
    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"{label}内包含越界路径：{name}")
    for part in parts:
        if (
            re.search(r'[<>:"|?*\x00-\x1f]', part)
            or part.endswith((" ", "."))
            or part.split(".", 1)[0].upper() in _WINDOWS_RESERVED
        ):
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"{label}内包含 Windows 无法使用的路径：{name}")
    return "/".join(parts)


def _read_manifest(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, info: zipfile.ZipInfo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
        raise ModrinthPackError("modrinth.index.json 过大，已拒绝读取")
    if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
        raise ModrinthPackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法读取")
    try:
        raw = zf.read(info)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"读取 Modrinth 清单失败：{exc}") from exc
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError("modrinth.index.json 不是有效的 JSON") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ModrinthPackError("modrinth.index.json 格式不正确")
    return data


def _parse_files(manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> list[ModrinthFile]:
    raw_files = manifest.get("files")
    if not isinstance(raw_files, list):
        raise ModrinthPackError("Modrinth 清单缺少 files 列表")
    result: list[ModrinthFile] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for item in raw_files:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ModrinthPackError("Modrinth 清单里的文件条目格式不正确")
        path = _safe_path(str(item.get("path") or ""), "整合包")
        if path.lower() == MODRINTH_MANIFEST or path.startswith(
            ("overrides/", "client-overrides/")
        ):
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"下载文件路径占用了保留目录：{path}")
        if path.split("/", 1)[0].lower() in _RESERVED_DOWNLOAD_DIRS:
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"下载文件路径写入了保留目录：{path}")
        key = path.lower()
        if key in seen:
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"整合包内存在重复文件：{path}")
        seen.add(key)

        env = item.get("env") or {}
        client = str(env.get("client") or "required").lower()
        if client == "unsupported":
            continue

        hashes = item.get("hashes") or {}
        sha1 = str(hashes.get("sha1") or "").strip().lower()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", sha1):
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"文件 {path} 缺少有效的 SHA1 校验值")
        try:
            size = int(item.get("fileSize") or 0)
        except Exception:
            size = 0
        if size < 0:
            size = 0
        downloads: list[str] = []
        for url in item.get("downloads") or []:
            text = str(url or "").strip()
            if text.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
                downloads.append(text)
        if not downloads:
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"文件 {path} 没有可用的下载地址")
        result.append(
            ModrinthFile(
                path=path,
                sha1=sha1,
                size=size,
                urls=downloads,
                client=client,
            )
        )
    return result


def inspect_modrinth_pack(path: Path | str) -> ModrinthPackInfo:
    archive = Path(path)
    if not archive.is_file():
        raise ModrinthPackError("整合包文件不存在")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            infos = zf.infolist()
            if len(infos) > MAX_TOTAL_FILES:
                raise ModrinthPackError("整合包内文件数量过多，已拒绝读取")
            seen: set[str] = set()
            total = 0
            manifest_info: zipfile.ZipInfo | None = None
            overrides: list[ModrinthOverride] = []
            for info in infos:
                name = _safe_path(info.filename, "整合包")
                key = name.lower()
                if key in seen:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(f"整合包内存在重复文件：{name}")
                seen.add(key)
                mode = (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
                if mode == 0o120000:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(f"整合包内不允许符号链接：{name}")
                if info.is_dir():
                    continue
                if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
                    raise ModrinthPackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法导入")
                total += max(0, int(info.file_size))
                if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
                    raise ModrinthPackError("整合包解压后体积超过 64 GB，已拒绝导入")
                if name.lower() == MODRINTH_MANIFEST:
                    manifest_info = info
                    continue
                if name.startswith("overrides/"):
                    relative = name[len("overrides/") :]
                    overrides.append(
                        ModrinthOverride(
                            member=info.filename,
                            relative=_safe_path(relative, "整合包"),
                            size=max(0, int(info.file_size)),
                        )
                    )
                elif name.startswith("client-overrides/"):
                    relative = name[len("client-overrides/") :]
                    overrides.append(
                        ModrinthOverride(
                            member=info.filename,
                            relative=_safe_path(relative, "整合包"),
                            size=max(0, int(info.file_size)),
                            client_only=True,
                        )
                    )
            for item in overrides:
                if item.relative.split("/", 1)[0].lower() in _RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(
                        f"整合包覆盖文件写入了保留目录：{item.relative}"
                    )
            if manifest_info is None:
                raise ModrinthPackError(
                    "这不是 Modrinth 整合包：缺少 modrinth.index.json"
                )
            manifest = _read_manifest(zf, manifest_info)
    except ModrinthPackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError("文件不是有效的 ZIP / mrpack 压缩包") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"无法打开整合包：{exc}") from exc

    if str(manifest.get("game") or "") != "minecraft":
        raise ModrinthPackError("这个 Modrinth 包不是 Minecraft 整合包")
    try:
        format_version = int(manifest.get("formatVersion") or 0)
    except Exception:
        format_version = 0
    if format_version != 1:
        raise ModrinthPackError(
            f"Modrinth 整合包格式版本 {format_version or '未知'} 不受支持"
        )
    dependencies = manifest.get("dependencies") or {}
    if not isinstance(dependencies, dict) or not dependencies.get("minecraft"):
        raise ModrinthPackError("Modrinth 清单没有指定 Minecraft 版本")
    mc_version = str(dependencies.get("minecraft") or "").strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z._-]{1,40}", mc_version):
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"Minecraft 版本号不正确：{mc_version}")
    loader_key = ""
    for key in _LOADER_KEYS:
        if dependencies.get(key):
            loader_key = key
            break
    if loader_key:
        loader_version = str(dependencies.get(loader_key) or "").strip()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z._+-]{1,80}", loader_version):
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"加载器版本号不正确：{loader_version}")
        if loader_key == "quilt-loader":
            raise ModrinthPackError(
                "这个整合包使用 Quilt 加载器，当前启动器还不支持 Quilt。"
                "可以尝试让整合包作者导出 Fabric 版本，或使用 Prism 等启动器。"
            )

    files = _parse_files(manifest)
    if not files and not overrides:
        raise ModrinthPackError("整合包里没有任何需要导入的内容")
    counts = {name: 0 for name in CONTENT_DIRS}
    for item in files:
        first = item.path.split("/", 1)[0]
        if first in counts:
            counts[first] += 1
    for item in overrides:
        first = item.relative.split("/", 1)[0]
        if first in counts:
            counts[first] += 1

    return ModrinthPackInfo(
        path=archive,
        manifest=manifest,
        files=files,
        overrides=overrides,
        counts=counts,
        total_files=len(files) + len(overrides),
        total_bytes=sum(item.size for item in files)
        + sum(item.size for item in overrides),
        archive_bytes=archive.stat().st_size,
    )


def _sha1_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    with path.open("rb") as fp:
        while True:
            chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _file_matches(path: Path, sha1: str, size: int) -> bool:
    try:
        if not path.is_file():
            return False
        if size and path.stat().st_size != size:
            return False
        return _sha1_file(path) == sha1
    except OSError:
        return False


def _modrinth_fallback_urls(sha1: str) -> list[str]:
    """用 SHA1 向 Modrinth 查询同一个文件的 CDN 地址。"""
    try:
        with http_open(
            f"{MODRINTH_API}/version_file/{sha1}?algorithm=sha1",
            timeout=12,
        ) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return []
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return []
    result: list[str] = []
    for item in data.get("files") or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        item_sha1 = str((item.get("hashes") or {}).get("sha1") or "").lower()
        if item_sha1 and item_sha1 != sha1:
            continue
        url = str(item.get("url") or "").strip()
        if url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            result.append(url)
    return list(dict.fromkeys(result))


def _preferred_urls(item: ModrinthFile) -> list[str]:
    """ForgeCDN 在部分网络下不可达时，优先换成 Modrinth CDN。"""
    cdn = [
        url
        for url in item.urls
        if (urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower() == "cdn.modrinth.com"
    ]
    if cdn:
        return list(dict.fromkeys(cdn + item.urls))
    return list(dict.fromkeys(_modrinth_fallback_urls(item.sha1) + item.urls))


def _inside(root: Path, path: Path) -> Path:
    try:
        path.resolve().relative_to(root.resolve())
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"整合包路径越界：{path}") from exc
    return path


def _write_version_wrapper(
    game_dir: Path, version_id: str, inherits_from: str
) -> Path:
    path = version_json_path(game_dir, version_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = {
        "id": version_id,
        "inheritsFrom": inherits_from,
        "type": "release",
        "name": version_id,
    }
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def import_modrinth_pack(
    pack_path: Path | str,
    game_dir: Path | str,
    version_id: str,
    *,
    java_path: str = "",
    overwrite: bool = False,
    resume: bool = False,
    isolated: bool = True,
    source: str = "official",
    threads: int = 8,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    loader_installer: Callable[..., str] | None = None,
    download_func: Callable[..., int] | None = None,
    installer: Any | None = None,
    url_resolver: Callable[[ModrinthFile], list[str]] | None = None,
) -> ModrinthImportResult:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    info = inspect_modrinth_pack(pack_path)
    version_id = normalize_version_id(version_id)
    version_dir = game_dir / "versions" / version_id
    if version_dir.exists() and not resume:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"版本 {version_id} 已经存在，请换一个导入名称")
    if resume and not version_json_path(game_dir, version_id).is_file():
        raise ModrinthPackError("上次导入的版本骨架不存在，请换一个导入名称重新开始")

    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    loader_installer = loader_installer or install_loader
    download_func = download_func or download_to_file
    connections = min(6, max(2, max(1, int(threads)) // 2))

    def check_cancel() -> None:
        if cancel.is_set():
            raise ModrinthPackError("导入已取消")

    def loader_progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        check_cancel()
        progress(3 + int(max(0, min(100, percent)) * 0.42 / 100), message)

    mc_version = info.minecraft_version
    loader_kind = info.loader_kind
    log(
        f"Modrinth 整合包：{info.name} · Minecraft {mc_version} · "
        f"{info.loader or '原版'}"
        + (f" {info.loader_version}" if info.loader_version else "")
    )
    progress(2, "检查整合包与加载器…")
    check_cancel()

    inherits_from = ""
    if loader_kind:
        if loader_kind in ("forge", "neoforge") and not java_path:
            raise ModrinthPackError(
                f"安装 {info.loader} 需要 Java，请先在设置里选择 Java。"
            )
        progress(3, f"安装 Minecraft {mc_version} + {info.loader}…")
        inherits_from = loader_installer(
            game_dir,
            mc_version,
            loader_kind,
            info.loader_version,
            java_path=java_path,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=loader_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
        )
        check_cancel()
    else:
        progress(3, f"安装 Minecraft {mc_version}…")
        target_installer = installer or Installer(
            game_dir,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=loader_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            threads=threads,
        )
        target_installer.install(mc_version)
        check_cancel()
        inherits_from = mc_version

    if inherits_from == version_id:
        raise ModrinthPackError("导入名称不能和加载器版本名称相同，请换一个名称")
    progress(46, "写入版本骨架…")
    _write_version_wrapper(game_dir, version_id, inherits_from)
    log(f"已创建版本 {version_id}，继承 {inherits_from}")

    run_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, version_id, isolated)
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    imported = 0
    skipped = 0
    imported_bytes = 0
    downloaded = 0
    total_files = max(1, len(info.files))

    for index, item in enumerate(info.files, 1):
        check_cancel()
        destination = _inside(run_dir, run_dir / item.path)
        start = 48 + int(44 * (index - 1) / total_files)
        end = 48 + int(44 * index / total_files)
        if _file_matches(destination, item.sha1, item.size):
            skipped += 1
            progress(end, f"已有 {item.path}")
            continue
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        last = [0]

        def on_bytes(done: int, total: int, start=start, end=end) -> None:
            percent = start + int((end - start) * min(1.0, done / total)) if total else start
            if percent != last[0]:
                last[0] = percent
                progress(percent, f"下载 {item.path}")

        if url_resolver is not None:
            candidates = list(url_resolver(item) or item.urls)
        else:
            candidates = _preferred_urls(item)
        candidates = list(dict.fromkeys(candidates + item.urls))
        errors: list[str] = []
        for url in candidates:
            check_cancel()
            try:
                download_func(
                    url,
                    destination,
                    sha1=item.sha1,
                    size=item.size,
                    cancel_event=cancel,
                    progress_cb=on_bytes,
                    connections=connections,
                )
                break
            except DownloadCancelled:
                raise ModrinthPackError("导入已取消") from None
            except Exception as exc:
                check_cancel()
                errors.append(str(exc))
        else:
            if url_resolver is None and not any(
                (urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower() == "cdn.modrinth.com"
                for url in candidates
            ):
                for url in _modrinth_fallback_urls(item.sha1):
                    check_cancel()
                    try:
                        download_func(
                            url,
                            destination,
                            sha1=item.sha1,
                            size=item.size,
                            cancel_event=cancel,
                            progress_cb=on_bytes,
                            connections=connections,
                        )
                        break
                    except DownloadCancelled:
                        raise ModrinthPackError("导入已取消") from None
                    except Exception as exc:
                        check_cancel()
                        errors.append(str(exc))
                else:
                    detail = errors[-1] if errors else "没有可用的下载地址"
                    raise ModrinthPackError(f"下载 {item.path} 失败：{detail}")
            else:
                detail = errors[-1] if errors else "没有可用的下载地址"
                raise ModrinthPackError(f"下载 {item.path} 失败：{detail}")
        imported += 1
        downloaded += 1
        imported_bytes += max(0, int(item.size))
        progress(end, f"已下载 {item.path}")
        log(f"下载完成：{item.path}")

    override_total = sum(max(0, item.size) for item in info.overrides) or 1
    override_done = 0
    written: set[str] = set()
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(info.path) as zf:
            ordered = sorted(info.overrides, key=lambda item: item.client_only)
            for item in ordered:
                check_cancel()
                destination = _inside(run_dir, run_dir / item.relative)
                reserved = item.relative.split("/", 1)[0].lower()
                if reserved in _RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(
                        f"整合包覆盖文件写入了保留目录：{item.relative}"
                    )
                if item.relative.lower() == f"{version_id}.json".lower():
                    raise ModrinthPackError(
                        "整合包覆盖文件试图替换版本 JSON，已拒绝导入"
                    )
                key = item.relative.lower()
                if destination.exists() and not overwrite and key not in written:
                    skipped += 1
                    override_done += max(0, item.size)
                    progress(
                        min(99, 92 + int(7 * override_done / override_total)),
                        f"跳过已有文件 {item.relative}",
                    )
                    continue
                destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                try:
                    with zf.open(item.member) as src, destination.open("wb") as out:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(src, out, 1024 * 1024)
                except Exception as exc:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(
                        f"解压覆盖文件 {item.relative} 失败：{exc}"
                    ) from exc
                written.add(key)
                imported += 1
                imported_bytes += max(0, item.size)
                override_done += max(0, item.size)
                progress(
                    min(99, 92 + int(7 * override_done / override_total)),
                    f"放入 {item.relative}",
                )
    except ModrinthPackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError("整合包在导入过程中损坏") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"写入整合包文件失败：{exc}") from exc

    check_cancel()
    progress(100, "猫猫已经把 Modrinth 整合包搬进猫窝")
    log(
        f"导入完成：{version_id} · 下载 {downloaded} 个文件 · "
        f"新增 {imported} 个文件"
        + (f" · 跳过 {skipped} 个已存在文件" if skipped else "")
    )
    return ModrinthImportResult(
        version_id=version_id,
        imported_files=imported,
        skipped_files=skipped,
        imported_bytes=imported_bytes,
        downloaded_files=downloaded,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import tomllib
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path


@dataclass
class ModInfo:
    path: Path
    name: str
    version: str = ""
    loader: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    enabled: bool = True
    size: int = 0

    @property
    def filename(self) -> str:
        return self.path.name

    @property
    def size_text(self) -> str:
        size = self.size
        if size >= 1024 * 1024:
            return f"{size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
        if size >= 1024:
            return f"{size / 1024:.0f} KB"
        return f"{size} B"


def _clean(value: object, fallback: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return fallback
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text:
        return fallback
    if text.startswith("${") or text.startswith("%"):
        return fallback
    return text


def _fabric_meta(zf: zipfile.ZipFile) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
    for meta_name in ("fabric.mod.json", "quilt.mod.json"):
        try:
            raw = zf.read(meta_name)
        except KeyError:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            continue
        if meta_name == "quilt.mod.json":
            data = data.get("quilt_loader") or {}
        name = _clean(data.get("name") or data.get("id"))
        version = _clean(data.get("version"))
        description = data.get("description", "")
        if isinstance(description, dict):
            description = description.get("text", "")
        description = _clean(description)
        return name, version, description
    return None


def _forge_meta(zf: zipfile.ZipFile) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
    for meta_name in ("META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml", "META-INF/mods.toml"):
        try:
            raw = zf.read(meta_name)
        except KeyError:
            continue
        try:
            data = tomllib.loads(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
        except Exception:
            continue
        mods = data.get("mods") or []
        if not isinstance(mods, list) or not mods:
            continue
        mod = mods[0] if isinstance(mods[0], dict) else {}
        name = _clean(
            mod.get("displayName") or mod.get("modId") or data.get("modId")
        )
        version = _clean(mod.get("version") or data.get("version"))
        description = _clean(mod.get("description") or data.get("description"))
        return name, version, description
    return None


def read_mod(path: Path) -> ModInfo:
    enabled = path.name.lower().endswith(".jar")
    size = 0
    try:
        size = path.stat().st_size
    except OSError:
        pass

    name = path.name
    if name.lower().endswith(".disabled"):
        name = name[: -len(".disabled")]
    if name.lower().endswith(".jar"):
        name = name[:-4]
    version = ""
    description = ""
    loader = ""

    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
            fabric = _fabric_meta(zf)
            if fabric:
                loader = "Fabric"
                name = fabric[0] or name
                version = fabric[1]
                description = fabric[2]
            else:
                forge = _forge_meta(zf)
                if forge:
                    loader = "Forge"
                    name = forge[0] or name
                    version = forge[1]
                    description = forge[2]
    except (zipfile.BadZipFile, OSError):
        pass

    return ModInfo(
        path=path,
        name=name,
        version=version,
        loader=loader,
        description=description,
        enabled=enabled,
        size=size,
    )


def list_mods(mods_dir: Path) -> list[ModInfo]:
    """读取指定 mods 文件夹中的 Mod。"""
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    if not mods_dir.exists():
        return []
    result: list[ModInfo] = []
    try:
        entries = list(mods_dir.iterdir())
    except OSError:
        return result
    for path in entries:
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        lower = path.name.lower()
        if lower.endswith(".jar") or lower.endswith(".jar.disabled"):
            result.append(read_mod(path))
    result.sort(key=lambda m: (not m.enabled, m.name.lower()))
    return result


def toggle_mod(mod: ModInfo) -> Path:
    path = mod.path
    if path.name.lower().endswith(".jar.disabled"):
        new_path = path.with_name(path.name[: -len(".disabled")])
    elif path.name.lower().endswith(".jar"):
        new_path = path.with_name(path.name + ".disabled")
    else:
        raise ValueError("不支持的文件类型")
    if new_path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"目标文件已存在：{new_path.name}")
    path.rename(new_path)
    return new_path

    def enabled_dirs(self) -> list[str]:
