@dataclass
class PackImportResult:
    version_id: str
    imported_files: int
    skipped_files: int
    imported_bytes: int


def human_size(value: int) -> str:
    size = float(max(0, int(value)))
    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"):
        if size < 1024 or unit == "TB":
            if unit == "B":
                return f"{int(size)} B"
            return f"{size:.1f} {unit}"
        size /= 1024
    return f"{size:.1f} TB"


def normalize_version_id(value: str) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    text = re.sub(r'[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]', "-", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip(" .")
    if not text or text in (".", ".."):
        text = "DKL-Pack"
    return text[:64].rstrip(" .") or "DKL-Pack"


def unique_version_id(game_dir: Path | str, base: str) -> str:
    versions = Path(game_dir) / "versions"
    candidate = normalize_version_id(base)
    if not (versions / candidate).exists() and not version_json_path(
        Path(game_dir), candidate
    ).exists():
        return candidate
    index = 2
    while True:
        suffix = f"-{index}"
        trimmed = candidate[: 64 - len(suffix)].rstrip(" .") or "DKL-Pack"
        value = trimmed + suffix
        if not (versions / value).exists() and not version_json_path(
            Path(game_dir), value
        ).exists():
            return value
        index += 1
        if index > 9999:
            raise PackError("无法生成不重复的版本名称")


def _loader_version(version_id: str, loader: str) -> str:
    text = str(version_id)
    lowered = text.lower()
    if loader == "NeoForge":
        for marker in ("-neoforge-", "-forge-"):
            if marker in lowered:
                return text[lowered.index(marker) + len(marker):]
    if loader == "Forge" and "-forge-" in lowered:
        return text[lowered.index("-forge-") + len("-forge-"):]
    if loader in ("Fabric", "Quilt"):
        match = re.search(r"(?:fabric|quilt)-loader-([^/]+)", text, re.I)
        if match:
            value = match.group(1)
            return re.sub(r"-\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?$", "", value) or value
    return ""


def _skip_name(name: str) -> bool:
    lowered = name.lower()
    return (
        lowered in _SKIP_NAMES
        or lowered.endswith(_SKIP_SUFFIXES)
        or lowered.startswith("~")
    )


def _iter_tree(root: Path, relative: str) -> list[tuple[Path, str]]:
    base = root / relative
    if not base.is_dir():
        return []
    files: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(base):
        dirnames[:] = sorted(
            name for name in dirnames if not (Path(dirpath) / name).is_symlink()
        )
        for filename in sorted(filenames):
            if _skip_name(filename):
                continue
            path = Path(dirpath) / filename
            try:
                if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                    continue
                resolved = path.resolve()
                resolved.relative_to(base.resolve())
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                continue
            files.append((path, path.relative_to(root).as_posix()))
    return files


def _read_json_member(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, name: str, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        info = zf.getinfo(name)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise PackError(f"整合包缺少 {label}") from exc
    if info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
        raise PackError(f"{label} 过大，已拒绝读取")
    if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
        raise PackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法读取")
    try:
        raw = zf.read(info)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise PackError(f"读取 {label} 失败：{exc}") from exc
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise PackError(f"{label} 不是有效的 JSON") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise PackError(f"{label} 格式不正确")
    return data


def _safe_archive_name(name: str) -> str:
    value = str(name or "").replace("\\", "/")
    if not value or value.startswith("/") or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", value):
        raise PackError(f"整合包内包含非法路径：{name}")
    parts = PurePosixPath(value).parts
    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
        raise PackError(f"整合包内包含越界路径：{name}")
    return "/".join(parts)


def _allowed_content_name(name: str) -> bool:
    parts = PurePosixPath(name).parts
    return bool(parts) and parts[0] in CONTENT_DIRS and len(parts) >= 2


def _validate_archive(zf: zipfile.ZipFile) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if zf.infolist() and len(zf.infolist()) > MAX_TOTAL_FILES + 16:
        raise PackError("整合包内文件数量过多，已拒绝读取")
    seen: set[str] = set()
    total = 0
    counts = {name: 0 for name in CONTENT_DIRS}
    for info in zf.infolist():
        name = _safe_archive_name(info.filename)
        if name in seen:
            raise PackError(f"整合包内存在重复文件：{name}")
        seen.add(name)
        mode = (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
        if mode == 0o120000:
            raise PackError(f"整合包内不允许符号链接：{name}")
        if info.is_dir():
            continue
        if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
            raise PackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法导入")
        total += max(0, int(info.file_size))
        if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
            raise PackError("整合包解压后体积超过 64 GB，已拒绝导入")
        if _allowed_content_name(name):
            counts[name.split("/", 1)[0]] += 1
    if "manifest.json" not in seen:
        raise PackError("这不是 DKL 整合包：缺少 manifest.json")
    if "version/version.json" not in seen:
        raise PackError("整合包缺少版本信息 version/version.json")
    return {"counts": counts, "total": total}


def inspect_pack(path: Path | str) -> PackInfo:
    pack_path = Path(path)
    if not pack_path.is_file():
        raise PackError("整合包文件不存在")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(pack_path) as zf:
            validation = _validate_archive(zf)
            manifest = _read_json_member(zf, "manifest.json", "manifest.json")
            version_json = _read_json_member(
                zf, "version/version.json", "version/version.json"
            )
    except PackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise PackError("文件不是有效的 DKL 整合包（ZIP 结构损坏）") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise PackError(f"无法打开整合包：{exc}") from exc

    if str(manifest.get("format") or "") != PACK_FORMAT:
        raise PackError(
            "这不是 Darkitten Launcher 整合包。请选择由 DKL 导出的 .dklpack 文件。"
        )
    try:
        format_version = int(manifest.get("format_version") or 0)
    except Exception:
        format_version = 0
    if format_version <= 0 or format_version > PACK_FORMAT_VERSION:
        raise PackError(
            f"整合包格式版本 {format_version or '未知'} 不受支持，请更新启动器。"
        )

    version_id = str(manifest.get("version_id") or "").strip()
    if not version_id:
        raise PackError("整合包没有记录原版本名称")
    if "id" not in version_json:
        version_json["id"] = version_id
    return PackInfo(
        path=pack_path,
        manifest=manifest,
        version_json=version_json,
        counts=validation["counts"],
        total_files=int(manifest.get("total_files") or 0)
        or sum(validation["counts"].values()) + 1,
        total_bytes=int(manifest.get("total_bytes") or 0) or validation["total"],
        archive_bytes=pack_path.stat().st_size,
    )


def export_pack(
    game_dir: Path | str,
    version_id: str,
    output_path: Path | str,
    *,
    name: str = "",
    description: str = "",
    options: PackOptions | None = None,
    isolated: bool = True,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> Path:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    output_path = Path(output_path)
    if output_path.suffix.lower() != PACK_EXTENSION:
        output_path = output_path.with_suffix(PACK_EXTENSION)
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    options = options or PackOptions()

    json_path = version_json_path(game_dir, version_id)
    if not json_path.is_file():
        raise PackError(f"找不到版本 {version_id} 的 JSON 文件")
    try:
        version_json = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise PackError(f"版本 JSON 无法读取：{exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(version_json, dict):
        raise PackError("版本 JSON 格式不正确")

    try:
        resolved = resolve_version(game_dir, version_id)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise PackError(f"版本无法解析：{exc}") from exc

    run_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, version_id, isolated)
    enabled = options.enabled_dirs()
    collected: list[tuple[str, list[tuple[Path, str]]]] = []
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    total_bytes = 0
    for content in enabled:
        files = _iter_tree(run_dir, content)
        collected.append((content, files))
        counts[content] = len(files)
        total_bytes += sum(path.stat().st_size for path, _arc in files)
        if files:
            log(f"{content}：{len(files)} 个文件")

    json_bytes = json.dumps(version_json, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode("utf-8")
    total_files = sum(counts.values()) + 1
    total_bytes += len(json_bytes)

    manifest = {
        "format": PACK_FORMAT,
        "format_version": PACK_FORMAT_VERSION,
        "name": str(name or f"{version_id} 的猫猫整合包").strip()[:80],
        "description": str(description or "").strip()[:500],
        "version_id": version_id,
        "minecraft_version": resolved.jar_id,
        "loader": resolved.loader,
        "loader_version": _loader_version(version_id, resolved.loader),
        "created_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "created_with": f"{APP_NAME} {APP_VERSION}",
        "contents": enabled,
        "counts": counts,
        "total_files": total_files,
        "total_bytes": total_bytes,
    }

    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp_path = output_path.with_name(
        f".{output_path.name}.{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}.part"
    )
    done = 1
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(
            temp_path, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6
        ) as zf:
            progress(1, "写入整合包清单…")
            zf.writestr(
                "manifest.json",
                json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
            )
            zf.writestr(
                "version/version.json",
                json_bytes,
                compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
            )
            for content, files in collected:
                for path, arcname in files:
                    if cancel.is_set():
                        raise PackError("打包已取消")
                    progress(
                        min(99, int(2 + 97 * done / max(1, total_files))),
                        f"打包 {arcname}",
                    )
                    compress = (
                        zipfile.ZIP_STORED
                        if path.suffix.lower() in _STORE_SUFFIXES
                        else zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                    )
                    zf.write(path, arcname, compress_type=compress)
                    done += 1
        if cancel.is_set():
            raise PackError("打包已取消")
        os.replace(temp_path, output_path)
    except Exception:
        try:
            temp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    progress(100, f"整合包已保存（{human_size(output_path.stat().st_size)}）")
    log(
        f"整合包已保存：{output_path} · {total_files} 个文件 · "
        f"{human_size(total_bytes)}"
    )
    return output_path


def _write_version_json(
    game_dir: Path, version_id: str, version_json: dict[str, Any]
) -> Path:
    path = version_json_path(game_dir, version_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = dict(version_json)
    data["id"] = version_id
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    return path


def import_pack(
    pack_path: Path | str,
    game_dir: Path | str,
    version_id: str,
    *,
    overwrite: bool = False,
    resume: bool = False,
    isolated: bool = True,
    source: str = "official",
    threads: int = 8,
    installer: Any | None = None,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> PackImportResult:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    info = inspect_pack(pack_path)
    version_id = normalize_version_id(version_id)
    version_dir = game_dir / "versions" / version_id
    if version_dir.exists() and not resume:
        raise PackError(f"版本 {version_id} 已经存在，请换一个导入名称")
    if resume and not version_json_path(game_dir, version_id).is_file():
        raise PackError("上次导入的版本骨架不存在，请换一个导入名称重新开始")
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()

    progress(2, "解包版本信息…")
    _write_version_json(game_dir, version_id, info.version_json)
    log(f"已写入版本骨架：{version_id}")

    def mapped_progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        if cancel.is_set():
            raise PackError("导入已取消")
        progress(8 + int(max(0, min(100, percent)) * 0.80), message)

    if installer is None:
        installer = Installer(
            game_dir,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=mapped_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            threads=threads,
        )
    progress(8, "补齐原版、依赖库与资源文件…")
    installer.install(version_id)
    if cancel.is_set():
        raise PackError("导入已取消")

    run_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, version_id, isolated)
    imported = 0
    skipped = 0
    imported_bytes = 0

    with zipfile.ZipFile(Path(pack_path)) as zf:
        entries = [
            entry
            for entry in zf.infolist()
            if not entry.is_dir()
            and _allowed_content_name(entry.filename.replace("\\", "/"))
        ]
        total = sum(max(0, int(entry.file_size)) for entry in entries) or 1
        done_bytes = 0
        for entry in entries:
            if cancel.is_set():
                raise PackError("导入已取消")
            name = _safe_archive_name(entry.filename)
            destination = run_dir / name
            try:
                destination.resolve().relative_to(run_dir.resolve())
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise PackError(f"整合包路径越界：{name}") from exc
            if destination.exists() and not overwrite:
                skipped += 1
                done_bytes += max(0, int(entry.file_size))
                progress(
                    min(99, 88 + int(11 * done_bytes / total)),
                    f"跳过已有文件 {name}",
                )
                continue
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            try:
                with zf.open(entry) as src, destination.open("wb") as out:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(src, out, 1024 * 1024)
            except Exception as exc:
                raise PackError(f"解压 {name} 失败：{exc}") from exc
            imported += 1
            imported_bytes += max(0, int(entry.file_size))
            done_bytes += max(0, int(entry.file_size))
            progress(
                min(99, 88 + int(11 * done_bytes / total)),
                f"放入 {name}",
            )

    progress(100, "猫猫已经把整合包搬进猫窝")
    log(
        f"导入完成：{version_id} · 新增 {imported} 个文件"
        + (f" · 跳过 {skipped} 个已存在文件" if skipped else "")
    )
    return PackImportResult(
        version_id=version_id,
        imported_files=imported,
        skipped_files=skipped,
        imported_bytes=imported_bytes,
    )


################################################################################
# FILE: stellar/paths.py

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path


def version_game_dir(
    game_dir: Path | str, version_id: str, isolated: bool = True
) -> Path:
    """返回某个游戏版本实际使用的游戏目录。

    开启版本隔离后，每个版本以 versions/<版本名> 作为游戏工作目录，
    这样 mods、saves、config 等都会随版本分开存放。
    """
    root = Path(game_dir)
    if isolated and version_id:
        return root / "versions" / version_id
    return root


def version_mods_dir(
    game_dir: Path | str, version_id: str, isolated: bool = True
) -> Path:
    return version_game_dir(game_dir, version_id, isolated) / "mods"

"""樱花穿透（SakuraFrp）内置联机支持。

只使用官方 v4 OpenAPI，不在启动器里保存明文访问密钥：
配置文件中通过 Windows DPAPI 加密，frpc 配置只写入临时房间目录。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import configparser
import hashlib
import ipaddress
import json
import os
import re
import socket
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal

from .config import APP_DIR, APP_VERSION, Config

SAKURA_API = "https://api.natfrp.com/v4"
SAKURA_PANEL = "https://www.natfrp.com/"
SAKURA_MC_DOCS = "https://doc.natfrp.com/game/mc/"
SAKURA_TUNNEL_DOCS = "https://doc.natfrp.com/natfrp/tunnel.html"
ROOM_TUNNEL_NAME = "StellarRoom"
USER_AGENT = f"DarkittenLauncher/{APP_VERSION}"

_CREATE_NO_WINDOW = 0x08000000 if sys.platform == "win32" else 0


class SakuraError(Exception):
    pass


def _friendly_api_error(code: int, message: str) -> str:
    text = str(message or "").strip()
    if code == 401 or "访问密钥" in text or "token" in text.lower():
        return "樱花穿透访问密钥无效，请在管理面板重新复制访问密钥。"
    if code == 403 or "实名" in text or "认证" in text:
        return f"樱花穿透账户认证未完成：{text or '请先在管理面板完成实名认证。'}"
    if code == 429 or "频繁" in text:
        return "请求过于频繁，请稍后再试。"
    if "隧道" in text and ("上限" in text or "数量" in text or "限制" in text):
        return "隧道数量已达上限，请先在樱花穿透面板删除不用的隧道。"
    if "节点" in text and ("不可用" in text or "满载" in text or "离线" in text):
        return f"节点当前不可用：{text}"
    return f"樱花穿透接口返回错误：{text or f'HTTP {code}'}"


class SakuraClient:
    """极简的樱花穿透 v4 API 客户端。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        token: str,
        base_url: str = SAKURA_API,
        timeout: int = 25,
    ) -> None:
        self.token = str(token or "").strip()
        if not self.token:
            raise SakuraError("请先填写樱花穿透访问密钥。")
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.timeout = timeout

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _request(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        timeout: int | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        url = self.base_url + path
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}",
            "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
            "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
        }
        body: bytes | None = None
        if data is not None:
            body = urllib.parse.urlencode(
                {k: v for k, v in data.items() if v is not None}
            ).encode("utf-8")
            headers["Content-Type"] = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            url, data=body, headers=headers, method=method
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(
                request, timeout=timeout or self.timeout
            ) as response:
                raw = response.read()
                content_type = response.headers.get("Content-Type", "")
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            raw = exc.read()
            code, message = _error_from_body(raw, exc.code)
            raise SakuraError(_friendly_api_error(code, message)) from exc
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
            raise SakuraError(
                "无法连接樱花穿透服务器，请检查网络连接或系统代理设置。"
            ) from exc

        text = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        stripped = text.lstrip()
        # INI 配置也以 "[" 开头（如 [common]），不能仅凭方括号判断 JSON。
        looks_json = stripped.startswith("{") or bool(
            re.match(r"\[\s*[\{\[\]\"\d-]", stripped)
        )
        wants_json = "json" in content_type.lower() or looks_json
        if wants_json:
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(text)
            except ValueError as exc:
                if "json" in content_type.lower():
                    raise SakuraError(
                        "樱花穿透接口返回了无法解析的数据。"
                    ) from exc
                return text
            if isinstance(parsed, dict) and "code" in parsed:
                code = _as_int(parsed.get("code"), 0)
                if code not in (0, 1, 200):
                    raise SakuraError(
                        _friendly_api_error(code, str(parsed.get("msg") or ""))
                    )
            return parsed
        return text

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def user_info(self) -> "SakuraUser":
        data = self._request("GET", "/user/info")
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise SakuraError("樱花穿透用户信息格式异常。")
        ban = data.get("ban")
        if isinstance(ban, dict) and ban:
            title = str(ban.get("title") or "账户已被冻结")
            reason = str(ban.get("reason") or "").strip()
            raise SakuraError(
                f"{title}{('：' + reason) if reason else '，请到管理面板查看。'}"
            )
        return SakuraUser.from_dict(data)

    def nodes(self) -> dict[int, "SakuraNode"]:
        data = self._request("GET", "/nodes")
        result: dict[int, SakuraNode] = {}
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise SakuraError("樱花穿透节点列表格式异常。")
        for key, value in data.items():
            if not isinstance(value, dict):
                continue
            try:
                node_id = int(key)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                continue
            result[node_id] = SakuraNode.from_dict(node_id, value)
        return result

    def tunnels(self) -> list["SakuraTunnel"]:
        data = self._request("GET", "/tunnels")
        if not isinstance(data, list):
            raise SakuraError("樱花穿透隧道列表格式异常。")
        return [
            SakuraTunnel.from_dict(item)
            for item in data
            if isinstance(item, dict)
        ]

    def create_tunnel(
        self,
        name: str,
        node_id: int,
        local_port: int,
        local_ip: str = "127.0.0.1",
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        data = self._request(
            "POST",
            "/tunnels",
            {
                "name": name,
                "type": "tcp",
                "node": int(node_id),
                "local_ip": local_ip,
                "local_port": int(local_port),
            },
        )
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get("id"):
            raise SakuraError("樱花穿透没有返回新隧道的 ID。")
        return data

    def edit_tunnel(
        self,
        tunnel_id: int,
        local_port: int,
        local_ip: str = "127.0.0.1",
    ) -> None:
        self._request(
            "POST",
            "/tunnel/edit",
            {
                "id": int(tunnel_id),
                "local_ip": local_ip,
                "local_port": int(local_port),
            },
        )

    def tunnel_config(self, tunnel_id: int, frpc_version: str) -> str:
        text = self._request(
            "POST",
            "/tunnel/config",
            {"query": str(int(tunnel_id)), "frpc": str(frpc_version)},
        )
        if not isinstance(text, str) or "server" not in text.lower():
            raise SakuraError("樱花穿透没有返回有效的 frpc 配置。")
        return text


@dataclass
class SakuraUser:
    id: int = 0
    name: str = ""
    avatar: str = ""
    speed: str = ""
    tunnel_limit: int = 0
    realname: int = 0
    group_name: str = ""
    group_level: int = 0
    traffic_used: int = 0
    traffic_left: int = 0

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> "SakuraUser":
        group = data.get("group") if isinstance(data.get("group"), dict) else {}
        traffic = data.get("traffic") if isinstance(data.get("traffic"), list) else []
        used = _as_int(traffic[0], 0) if len(traffic) > 0 else 0
        left = _as_int(traffic[1], 0) if len(traffic) > 1 else 0
        return cls(
            id=_as_int(data.get("id"), 0),
            name=str(data.get("name") or ""),
            avatar=str(data.get("avatar") or ""),
            speed=str(data.get("speed") or ""),
            tunnel_limit=_as_int(data.get("tunnels"), 0),
            realname=_as_int(data.get("realname"), 0),
            group_name=str(group.get("name") or ""),
            group_level=_as_int(group.get("level"), 0),
            traffic_used=used,
            traffic_left=left,
        )

    @property
    def realname_text(self) -> str:
        return "已实名" if self.realname else "未实名"

    @property
    def traffic_text(self) -> str:
        if not self.traffic_left and not self.traffic_used:
            return "流量信息不可用"
        return (
            f"今日 {format_size(self.traffic_used)}"
            f" · 剩余 {format_size(self.traffic_left)}"
        )


@dataclass
class SakuraNode:
    id: int = 0
    name: str = ""
    host: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    vip: int = 0
    flag: int = 0

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, node_id: int, data: dict[str, Any]) -> "SakuraNode":
        return cls(
            id=node_id,
            name=str(data.get("name") or f"节点 {node_id}"),
            host=str(data.get("host") or ""),
            description=str(data.get("description") or ""),
            vip=_as_int(data.get("vip"), 0),
            flag=_as_int(data.get("flag"), 0),
        )

    @property
    def online(self) -> bool:
        return not bool(self.flag & (1 << 9))

    @property
    def can_create(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.flag & (1 << 2))

    @property
    def mainland(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.flag & (1 << 3))

    @property
    def udp(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.flag & (1 << 5))

    @property
    def public_game(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.flag & (1 << 11)) or "多线" in self.name

    @property
    def selectable(self) -> bool:
        return self.online and self.can_create and bool(self.host)

    @property
    def label(self) -> str:
        tags: list[str] = []
        if self.public_game:
            tags.append("多线")
        if self.vip:
            tags.append(f"VIP{self.vip}")
        if self.mainland:
            tags.append("内地")
        suffix = f" · {' · '.join(tags)}" if tags else ""
        return f"{self.name}{suffix}"


@dataclass
class SakuraTunnel:
    id: int = 0
    name: str = ""
    type: str = ""
    node: int = 0
    status: int = 0
    online: bool = False
    note: str = ""
    local_ip: str = ""
    local_port: int = 0
    remote: str = ""

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> "SakuraTunnel":
        return cls(
            id=_as_int(data.get("id"), 0),
            name=str(data.get("name") or ""),
            type=str(data.get("type") or ""),
            node=_as_int(data.get("node"), 0),
            status=_as_int(data.get("status"), 0),
            online=bool(data.get("online")),
            note=str(data.get("note") or ""),
            local_ip=str(data.get("local_ip") or ""),
            local_port=_as_int(data.get("local_port"), 0),
            remote=str(data.get("remote") or ""),
        )

    @property
    def remote_port(self) -> int:
        if self.remote.isdigit():
            return int(self.remote)
        return 0


@dataclass
class FrpcClient:
    path: Path
    version: str
    downloaded: bool = False


def _as_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _error_from_body(raw: bytes, fallback_code: int) -> tuple[int, str]:
    text = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    try:
        data = json.loads(text)
    except ValueError:
        return fallback_code, text
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        return _as_int(data.get("code"), fallback_code), str(data.get("msg") or "")
    return fallback_code, text


def format_size(value: int) -> str:
    size = float(max(0, value))
    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"):
        if size < 1024 or unit == "TB":
            return f"{size:.0f} {unit}" if unit == "B" else f"{size:.1f} {unit}"
        size /= 1024
    return f"{size:.1f} TB"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 房间号编解码：版本(1B) + IPv4(4B) + 端口(2B) + CRC8(1B)
# 使用 Crockford Base32，去掉容易混淆的 I/L/O/U。

_CROCKFORD = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
_ROOM_VERSION = 1


def _crc8(data: bytes) -> int:
    crc = 0
    for byte in data:
        crc ^= byte
        for _ in range(8):
            crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x07) & 0xFF if crc & 0x80 else (crc << 1) & 0xFF
    return crc


def parse_server_address(address: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    text = str(address or "").strip()
    if not text:
        raise SakuraError("服务器地址为空。")
    if text.startswith("["):
        end = text.find("]")
        if end < 0:
            raise SakuraError("IPv6 地址格式不正确。")
        host = text[1:end].strip()
        rest = text[end + 1 :].strip()
        if rest.startswith(":"):
            port_text = rest[1:]
        elif rest:
            raise SakuraError("服务器地址格式不正确。")
        else:
            port_text = "25565"
    elif text.count(":") == 1:
        host, port_text = text.rsplit(":", 1)
        host = host.strip()
    elif text.count(":") > 1:
        host = text
        port_text = "25565"
    else:
        host = text
        port_text = "25565"
    if not host:
        raise SakuraError("服务器地址缺少主机名。")
    try:
        port = int(port_text)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise SakuraError("服务器端口必须是数字。") from exc
    if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
        raise SakuraError("服务器端口需在 1-65535 之间。")
    return host, port


def resolve_ipv4(host: str, port: int = 25565) -> str:
    try:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(host))
    except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
        pass
    try:
        infos = socket.getaddrinfo(
            host, port, family=socket.AF_INET, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM
        )
    except (socket.gaierror, OSError) as exc:
        raise SakuraError(
            f"无法把节点地址 {host} 解析为 IPv4，房间号暂时不可用，可以直接分享服务器地址。"
        ) from exc
    for info in infos:
        address = info[4][0]
        try:
            return str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(address))
        except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
            continue
    raise SakuraError("节点没有可用的 IPv4 地址，房间号暂时不可用。")


def normalize_room_code(code: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"[\s\-_]", "", str(code or "")).upper()
    text = text.replace("I", "1").replace("L", "1").replace("O", "0")
    if len(text) != 13:
        raise SakuraError("房间号应为 13 位，例如 XXXXX-XXXX-XXXXX。")
    if any(char not in _CROCKFORD for char in text):
        raise SakuraError("房间号包含无效字符，请检查是否输入正确。")
    return text


def encode_room_code(address: str) -> str:
    host, port = parse_server_address(address)
    ip_text = resolve_ipv4(host, port)
    payload = (
        bytes([_ROOM_VERSION])
        + ipaddress.IPv4Address(ip_text).packed
        + port.to_bytes(2, "big")
    )
    payload += bytes([_crc8(payload)])

    buffer = 0
    bits = 0
    chars: list[str] = []
    for byte in payload:
        buffer = (buffer << 8) | byte
        bits += 8
        while bits >= 5:
            bits -= 5
            chars.append(_CROCKFORD[(buffer >> bits) & 0x1F])
    if bits:
        chars.append(_CROCKFORD[(buffer << (5 - bits)) & 0x1F])
    raw = "".join(chars)
    return f"{raw[:5]}-{raw[5:9]}-{raw[9:]}"


def decode_room_code(code: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    raw = normalize_room_code(code)
    value = 0
    for char in raw:
        value = (value << 5) | _CROCKFORD.index(char)
    payload = (value >> 1).to_bytes(8, "big")
    if payload[0] != _ROOM_VERSION:
        raise SakuraError("房间号版本不受支持，请把启动器升级到最新版本。")
    if _crc8(payload[:7]) != payload[7]:
        raise SakuraError("房间号校验失败，请检查是否输入完整。")
    host = str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(payload[1:5]))
    port = int.from_bytes(payload[5:7], "big")
    if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
        raise SakuraError("房间号中的端口无效。")
    return host, port


def room_code_for_address(address: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    host, port = parse_server_address(address)
    ip_text = resolve_ipv4(host, port)
    return encode_room_code(f"{ip_text}:{port}"), f"{ip_text}:{port}"


def decode_room_input(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """允许输入房间号或直接的 host:port 地址。"""
    value = str(text or "").strip()
    if not value:
        raise SakuraError("请先输入房间号。")
    compact = re.sub(r"[\s\-_]", "", value)
    if ":" not in value and len(compact) == 13:
        return decode_room_code(value)
    if ":" in value or re.fullmatch(r"[\d.]+", value):
        return parse_server_address(value)
    return decode_room_code(value)


def config_server_addr(config_text: str) -> str:
    text = str(config_text or "")
    parser = configparser.ConfigParser(strict=False, interpolation=None)
    try:
        parser.read_string(text)
        for section in parser.sections():
            if section.strip().lower() in ("common", "common_config"):
                value = parser.get(section, "server_addr", fallback="")
                if not value:
                    value = parser.get(section, "serverAddr", fallback="")
                if value:
                    return value.strip().strip('"')
    except (configparser.Error, ValueError):
        pass
    match = re.search(
        r"(?:server_addr|serverAddr)\s*=\s*[\"']?([^\"'\s#]+)", text
    )
    return match.group(1) if match else ""


def tunnel_public_address(node: SakuraNode, tunnel: SakuraTunnel) -> str:
    host = node.host.strip()
    if not host:
        raise SakuraError("节点没有可用的公网地址。")
    port = tunnel.remote_port
    if not port:
        raise SakuraError("隧道还没有分配远程端口，请稍后重试。")
    return f"{host}:{port}"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# frpc 客户端下载与运行


def _platform_arch() -> str:
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        raise SakuraError("内置樱花穿透目前只支持 Windows。")
    machine = (os.environ.get("PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE") or "").lower()
    if "arm64" in machine or "aarch64" in machine:
        return "windows_arm64"
    return "windows_amd64" if struct.calcsize("P") * 8 >= 64 else "windows_386"


def _fetch_client_meta() -> dict[str, Any]:
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        SAKURA_API + "/system/clients?download=true",
        headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT, "Accept": "application/json"},
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
            data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise SakuraError("无法获取樱花穿透客户端信息，请检查网络。") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise SakuraError("樱花穿透客户端信息格式异常。")
    return data


def _detect_frpc_version(path: Path) -> str:
    if not path or not path.exists():
        return ""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [str(path), "-v"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=10,
            creationflags=_CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
        )
    except Exception:
        return ""
    output = (result.stdout or "") + " " + (result.stderr or "")
    match = re.search(r"(\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-sakura-\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?)", output)
    return match.group(1) if match else ""


def _file_hash(path: Path, algorithm: str) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.new(algorithm)
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def ensure_frpc(
    cfg: Config,
    progress_cb: Callable[[int, str], None] | None = None,
    log_cb: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
) -> FrpcClient:
    """返回可执行的 frpc；缺失时从樱花穿透官方源下载并校验哈希。"""
    override = str(getattr(cfg, "sakura_frpc_path", "") or "").strip()
    if override:
        path = Path(os.path.expandvars(override)).expanduser()
        version = _detect_frpc_version(path)
        if not version:
            raise SakuraError(f"无法运行指定的 frpc：{path}")
        return FrpcClient(path=path, version=version)

    target = APP_DIR / "tools" / "frpc" / "frpc.exe"
    if target.exists():
        version = _detect_frpc_version(target)
        if version:
            if log_cb:
                log_cb(f"使用内置 frpc {version}")
            return FrpcClient(path=target, version=version)
        try:
            target.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass

    meta = _fetch_client_meta()
    entry = meta.get("frpc") if isinstance(meta.get("frpc"), dict) else {}
    archs = entry.get("archs") if isinstance(entry.get("archs"), dict) else {}
    info = archs.get(_platform_arch())
    if not isinstance(info, dict):
        info = archs.get("windows_amd64")
    if not isinstance(info, dict) or not info.get("url"):
        raise SakuraError("樱花穿透没有提供适用于当前系统的 frpc 下载。")

    url = str(info.get("url") or "")
    expected_hash = str(info.get("hash") or "").lower()
    expected_size = _as_int(info.get("size"), 0)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    partial = target.with_name(target.name + ".part")
    if log_cb:
        log_cb("正在下载内置 frpc…")

    request = urllib.request.Request(
        url, headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT}
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=180) as response:
            total = _as_int(response.headers.get("Content-Length"), 0) or expected_size
            done = 0
            with partial.open("wb") as handle:
                while True:
                    chunk = response.read(256 * 1024)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    handle.write(chunk)
                    done += len(chunk)
                    if progress_cb and total > 0:
                        progress_cb(
                            min(99, int(done * 100 / total)),
                            f"下载内置 frpc… {done // 1048576}/{max(1, total // 1048576)} MB",
                        )
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
        try:
            partial.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise SakuraError(f"内置 frpc 下载失败：{exc}") from exc

    if expected_hash:
        algorithm = "md5" if len(expected_hash) == 32 else "sha256"
        actual = _file_hash(partial, algorithm)
        if actual.lower() != expected_hash:
            try:
                partial.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            except OSError:
                pass
            raise SakuraError("内置 frpc 校验失败，文件可能不完整，请重试。")
    if expected_size and partial.stat().st_size != expected_size:
        try:
            partial.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise SakuraError("内置 frpc 大小不正确，请重试。")

    os.replace(partial, target)
    version = _detect_frpc_version(target) or str(entry.get("ver") or "")
    if not version:
        raise SakuraError("内置 frpc 无法运行，请检查杀毒软件是否拦截。")
    if progress_cb:
        progress_cb(100, "内置 frpc 已就绪")
    if log_cb:
        log_cb(f"内置 frpc {version} 已就绪")
    return FrpcClient(path=target, version=version, downloaded=True)


def write_tunnel_config(config_text: str, tunnel_id: int) -> Path:
    directory = APP_DIR / "rooms"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = directory / f"room-{int(tunnel_id)}.ini"
    path.write_text(config_text, encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        os.chmod(path, 0o600)
    except OSError:
        pass
    return path


def remove_tunnel_config(path: Path | str | None) -> None:
    if not path:
        return
    try:
        Path(path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    except OSError:
        pass


def cleanup_room_configs(max_age_hours: int = 24) -> None:
    """清理崩溃后遗留的 frpc 配置，避免访问令牌长期留在磁盘上。"""
    directory = APP_DIR / "rooms"
    if not directory.exists():
        return
    cutoff = time.time() - max(1, int(max_age_hours)) * 3600
    try:
        candidates = list(directory.glob("room-*.ini"))
    except OSError:
        return
    for path in candidates:
        try:
            if path.stat().st_mtime < cutoff:
                path.unlink()
        except OSError:
            continue


def detect_game_lan_ports(pid: int) -> list[int]:
    """从 netstat 中找出指定游戏进程监听的 TCP 端口。"""
    if not pid or sys.platform != "win32":
        return []
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["netstat", "-ano", "-p", "tcp"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=12,
            creationflags=_CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
        )
    except Exception:
        return []
    ports: list[int] = []
    for line in (result.stdout or "").splitlines():
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) < 5:
            continue
        if parts[0].upper() != "TCP" or "LISTEN" not in parts[3].upper():
            continue
        if parts[-1] != str(pid):
            continue
        local = parts[1]
        if ":" not in local:
            continue
        port_text = local.rsplit(":", 1)[1]
        try:
            port = int(port_text)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if 1 <= port <= 65535 and port not in ports:
            ports.append(port)
    return ports


def preferred_lan_port(ports: list[int]) -> int:
    for port in ports:
        if port == 25565:
            return port
    for port in ports:
        if port >= 1024:
            return port
    return 25565


class SakuraTunnelProcess(QObject):
    """在本进程之外运行 frpc，并读取它的连接日志。"""

    log_line = Signal(str)
    ready = Signal(str)
    failed = Signal(str)
    finished = Signal(int)

    _READY_MARKERS = (
        "启动成功",
        "start proxy success",
        "login to server success",
        "隧道已启动",
        "successfully started",
    )
    _FAILURE_MARKERS = (
        "登录节点失败",
        "login to server failed",
        "连接节点失败",
        "隧道启动失败",
        "start proxy error",
        "访问密钥无效",
        "authentication failed",
        "token is invalid",
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        frpc_path: Path | str,
        config_path: Path | str,
        parent: QObject | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.frpc_path = Path(frpc_path)
        self.config_path = Path(config_path)
        self._process: subprocess.Popen[str] | None = None
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._stop_requested = False
        self._ready_sent = False
        self._failure_sent = False
        self._last_lines: list[str] = []
        self._started_at = 0.0

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self._process and self._process.poll() is None)

    @property
    def pid(self) -> int:
        return self._process.pid if self._process else 0

    def start(self) -> None:
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()

    def _run(self) -> None:
        startupinfo = None
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
            startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
            startupinfo.wShowWindow = subprocess.SW_HIDE
        command = [str(self.frpc_path), "-c", str(self.config_path)]
        self.log_line.emit("正在启动内置 frpc…")
        try:
            self._process = subprocess.Popen(
                command,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
                bufsize=1,
                creationflags=_CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
                startupinfo=startupinfo,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.failed.emit(f"无法启动内置 frpc：{exc}")
            self.finished.emit(-1)
            return

        self._started_at = time.time()
        threading.Thread(target=self._watchdog, daemon=True).start()
        assert self._process.stdout is not None
        try:
            for line in self._process.stdout:
                text = line.rstrip("\r\n")
                if not text:
                    continue
                self.log_line.emit(text)
                self._last_lines.append(text)
                if len(self._last_lines) > 30:
                    self._last_lines.pop(0)
                self._maybe_ready(text)
            code = self._process.wait()
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_line.emit(f"[frpc 输出错误] {exc}")
            try:
                code = self._process.wait(timeout=5)
            except Exception:
                code = -1
        if (
            not self._ready_sent
            and not self._failure_sent
            and not self._stop_requested
        ):
            detail = " | ".join(self._last_lines[-4:])
            self.failed.emit(
                f"frpc 已退出（代码 {code}）。"
                + (f" {detail}" if detail else "请查看运行日志。")
            )
        self.finished.emit(code)

    def _maybe_ready(self, text: str) -> None:
        if self._ready_sent or self._failure_sent:
            return
        low = text.lower()
        if any(marker.lower() in low for marker in self._FAILURE_MARKERS):
            self._failure_sent = True
            message = "内置 frpc 连接节点失败，请检查网络或更换节点后重试。"
            if "refused" in low or "拒绝" in text:
                message += "（节点拒绝了连接）"
            elif "token" in low or "密钥" in text:
                message = "樱花穿透隧道凭证无效，请重新创建房间。"
            self.failed.emit(message)
            try:
                self.stop()
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
        if any(marker.lower() in low for marker in self._READY_MARKERS):
            self._ready_sent = True
            self.ready.emit("隧道已连接")

    def _watchdog(self) -> None:
        deadline = self._started_at + 45
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if self._stop_requested or self._failure_sent or not self.running:
                return
            if self._ready_sent:
                return
            time.sleep(0.5)
        if (
            self.running
            and not self._ready_sent
            and not self._failure_sent
            and not self._stop_requested
        ):
            self._ready_sent = True
            self.ready.emit("frpc 已启动，未检测到明确成功日志")

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop_requested = True
        process = self._process
        if not process or process.poll() is not None:
            return
        try:
            process.terminate()
            process.wait(timeout=4)
        except Exception:
            try:
                process.kill()
            except Exception:
                pass


def start_timeout_seconds() -> int:
    return 45


def elapsed_text(started_at: float) -> str:
    seconds = max(0, int(time.time() - started_at))
    if seconds < 60:
        return f"{seconds} 秒"
    return f"{seconds // 60} 分 {seconds % 60} 秒"

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import ctypes
import sys
from ctypes import wintypes


class _DataBlob(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("cbData", wintypes.DWORD),
        ("pbData", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_byte)),
    ]


def _blob(data: bytes) -> tuple[_DataBlob, ctypes.Array]:
    buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(data, len(data))
    value = _DataBlob(
        len(data), ctypes.cast(buffer, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_byte))
    )
    return value, buffer


def _dpapi(data: bytes, decrypt: bool) -> bytes:
    crypt32 = ctypes.windll.crypt32
    crypt32.CryptProtectData.argtypes = [
        ctypes.POINTER(_DataBlob),
        wintypes.LPCWSTR,
        ctypes.POINTER(_DataBlob),
        ctypes.c_void_p,
        ctypes.c_void_p,
        wintypes.DWORD,
        ctypes.POINTER(_DataBlob),
    ]
    crypt32.CryptProtectData.restype = wintypes.BOOL
    crypt32.CryptUnprotectData.argtypes = [
        ctypes.POINTER(_DataBlob),
        ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.LPWSTR),
        ctypes.POINTER(_DataBlob),
        ctypes.c_void_p,
        ctypes.c_void_p,
        wintypes.DWORD,
        ctypes.POINTER(_DataBlob),
    ]
    crypt32.CryptUnprotectData.restype = wintypes.BOOL
    kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
    kernel32.LocalFree.argtypes = [wintypes.HLOCAL]
    kernel32.LocalFree.restype = wintypes.HLOCAL

    source, _source_buffer = _blob(data)
    output = _DataBlob()
    flags = 0x1  # CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN
    if decrypt:
        description = wintypes.LPWSTR()
        ok = crypt32.CryptUnprotectData(
            ctypes.byref(source),
            ctypes.byref(description),
            None,
            None,
            None,
            flags,
            ctypes.byref(output),
        )
        if description.value:
            kernel32.LocalFree(description)
    else:
        ok = crypt32.CryptProtectData(
            ctypes.byref(source),
            "DarkittenLauncher",
            None,
            None,
            None,
            flags,
            ctypes.byref(output),
        )
    if not ok:
        raise OSError("Windows DPAPI 调用失败")
    try:
        return ctypes.string_at(output.pbData, output.cbData)
    finally:
        kernel32.LocalFree(output.pbData)


def protect(text: str) -> str:
    """用 Windows DPAPI 加密敏感字符串；非 Windows 平台退化为 Base64。"""
    if not text:
        return ""
    raw = text.encode("utf-8")
    try:
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            return "dpapi:" + base64.b64encode(_dpapi(raw, False)).decode("ascii")
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "b64:" + base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")


def unprotect(value: str) -> str:
    if not value:
        return ""
    if value.startswith("dpapi:"):
        try:
            raw = base64.b64decode(value[6:])
            return _dpapi(raw, True).decode("utf-8")
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if value.startswith("b64:"):
        try:
            return base64.b64decode(value[4:]).decode("utf-8")
        except Exception:
            return ""
    return value

@dataclass
class ServerInfo:
    folder: str
    name: str
    kind: str
    mc_version: str
    loader_version: str = ""
    java_path: str = ""
    memory_mb: int = 4096
    port: int = 25565
    online_mode: bool = False
    eula: bool = False
    installed: bool = False
    install_error: str = ""
    launch_kind: str = ""
    launch_target: str = ""
    launch_classpath: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    paper_build: int = 0
    created_at: str = ""
    installed_at: str = ""
    last_started: str = ""

    @property
    def type_name(self) -> str:
        return SERVER_NAMES.get(self.kind, self.kind or "未知")

    @property
    def is_plugin_server(self) -> bool:
        return self.kind in PLUGIN_SERVERS

    @property
    def addon_dir_name(self) -> str:
        return "plugins" if self.is_plugin_server else "mods"

    @property

        return "插件" if self.is_plugin_server else "Mod"

    @property
    def path(self) -> Path:
        return SERVERS_DIR / self.folder

    @property
    def display_version(self) -> str:
        if self.kind == "paper" and self.paper_build:
            return f"{self.mc_version} · #{self.paper_build}"
        if self.loader_version:
            return f"{self.mc_version} · {self.loader_version}"
        return self.mc_version


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def _safe_folder(name: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r'[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]', "", str(name or "")).strip()
    text = text.rstrip(". ")
    reserved = {
        "CON",
        "PRN",
        "AUX",
        "NUL",
        *(f"COM{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
        *(f"LPT{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
    }
    if not text or text.upper() in reserved:
        text = "server"
    return text[:48]


def new_server_folder(name: str, kind: str, mc_version: str) -> str:
    SERVERS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    base = _safe_folder(name) or _safe_folder(f"{kind}-{mc_version}")
    folder = base
    index = 2
    while (SERVERS_DIR / folder).exists():
        folder = f"{base}-{index}"
        index += 1
    return folder


def server_json_path(info: ServerInfo) -> Path:
    return info.path / "server.json"


def save_server(info: ServerInfo) -> None:
    path = server_json_path(info)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = asdict(info)
    data["kind"] = info.kind
    tmp = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def load_server(folder: str) -> ServerInfo | None:
    folder = str(folder or "")
    if not folder or Path(folder).name != folder:
        return None
    path = SERVERS_DIR / folder / "server.json"
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return None
    data["folder"] = folder
    known = set(ServerInfo.__dataclass_fields__)
    clean = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in known}
    try:
        info = ServerInfo(**clean)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if info.kind not in SERVER_NAMES:
        return None
    try:
        info.memory_mb = max(512, min(65536, int(info.memory_mb or 4096)))
    except Exception:
        info.memory_mb = 4096
    try:
        info.port = max(1, min(65535, int(info.port or 25565)))
    except Exception:
        info.port = 25565
    if not isinstance(info.launch_classpath, list):
        info.launch_classpath = []
    info.launch_classpath = [str(item) for item in info.launch_classpath if item]
    info.eula = bool(info.eula) or eula_path(info).exists()
    return info


def scan_servers() -> list[ServerInfo]:
    if not SERVERS_DIR.exists():
        return []
    result: list[ServerInfo] = []
    try:
        folders = [p for p in SERVERS_DIR.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
    except OSError:
        return []
    for folder in folders:
        info = load_server(folder.name)
        if info is not None:
            result.append(info)
    result.sort(key=lambda item: (item.installed, item.created_at), reverse=True)
    return result

    return info.path / "eula.txt"

    info.path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    eula_path(info).write_text("eula=true\n", encoding="utf-8")
    info.eula = True

def _properties_escape(value: str) -> str:
    text = str(value or "")
    text = text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "\\r")
    text = text.replace("=", "\\=").replace(":", "\\:")
    out: list[str] = []
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if code < 32 or code > 126:
            if code <= 0xFFFF:
                out.append(f"\\u{code:04x}")
            else:
                out.append("?")
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


def _properties_unescape(value: str) -> str:
    text = str(value or "")
    result: list[str] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(text):
        ch = text[index]
        if ch != "\\" or index + 1 >= len(text):
            result.append(ch)
            index += 1
            continue
        nxt = text[index + 1]
        if nxt == "u" and index + 5 < len(text):
            try:
                result.append(chr(int(text[index + 2 : index + 6], 16)))
                index += 6
                continue
            except ValueError:
                pass
        mapping = {"n": "\n", "r": "\r", "t": "\t", "\\": "\\", "=": "=", ":": ":", " ": " "}
        result.append(mapping.get(nxt, nxt))
        index += 2
    return "".join(result)


def read_server_properties(info: ServerInfo) -> dict[str, str]:
    path = info.path / "server.properties"
    data: dict[str, str] = {}
    if not path.exists():
        return data
    try:
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
            raw = line.strip()
            if not raw or raw.startswith("#") or raw.startswith("!"):
                continue
            if "=" not in raw:
                continue
            key, value = raw.split("=", 1)
            data[key.strip()] = _properties_unescape(value.strip())
    except OSError:
        pass
    return data


def update_server_properties(
    info: ServerInfo, updates: dict[str, Any] | None = None
) -> None:
    path = info.path / "server.properties"
    info.path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    values = {k: str(v) for k, v in DEFAULT_PROPERTIES.items()}
    values.update(
        {
            "server-port": str(info.port),
            "online-mode": "true" if info.online_mode else "false",
        }
    )
    for key, value in (updates or {}).items():
        values[str(key)] = str(value)

    lines: list[str] = []
    if path.exists():
        try:
            lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
        except OSError:
            lines = []
    existing: dict[str, int] = {}
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        raw = line.strip()
        if not raw or raw.startswith("#") or raw.startswith("!") or "=" not in raw:
            continue
        key = raw.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
        existing[key] = index
    for key, value in values.items():
        encoded = f"{key}={_properties_escape(value)}"
        if key in existing:
            lines[existing[key]] = encoded
        else:
            lines.append(encoded)
    if not lines:
        lines = ["#Minecraft server properties"]
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def check_port(port: int, host: str = "") -> bool:
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    try:
        sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        sock.bind((host, int(port)))
        return True
    except OSError:
        return False
    finally:
        try:
            sock.close()
        except OSError:
            pass


def required_java_major(mc_version: str) -> int:
    pieces = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+", str(mc_version))[:3]]
    if len(pieces) < 2:
        return 21
    major, minor = pieces[0], pieces[1]
    patch = pieces[2] if len(pieces) > 2 else 0
    if major > 1 or (major == 1 and minor >= 21):
        return 21
    if (major, minor, patch) >= (1, 20, 5):
        return 21
    if (major, minor) >= (1, 18):
        return 17
    if (major, minor) == (1, 17):
        return 16
    return 8


def send_to_recycle_bin(path: Path) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """优先移动到 Windows 回收站，失败时移入启动器内 .trash 目录。"""
    target = Path(path)
    if not target.exists():
        return False, "文件夹不存在"
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        try:
            import ctypes
            from ctypes import wintypes

            class _SHFileOpStructW(ctypes.Structure):
                _fields_ = [
                    ("hwnd", wintypes.HWND),
                    ("wFunc", wintypes.UINT),
                    ("pFrom", ctypes.c_wchar_p),
                    ("pTo", ctypes.c_wchar_p),
                    ("fFlags", wintypes.USHORT),
                    ("fAnyOperationsAborted", wintypes.BOOL),
                    ("hNameMappings", ctypes.c_void_p),
                    ("lpszProgressTitle", ctypes.c_wchar_p),
                ]

            buffer = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(str(target.resolve()) + "\0")
            op = _SHFileOpStructW()
            op.hwnd = None
            op.wFunc = 3  # FO_DELETE
            op.pFrom = ctypes.cast(buffer, ctypes.c_wchar_p)
            op.pTo = None
            op.fFlags = 0x0040 | 0x0010 | 0x0004 | 0x0400  # ALLOWUNDO | NOCONFIRM | SILENT | NOERRORUI
            op.fAnyOperationsAborted = False
            op.hNameMappings = None
            op.lpszProgressTitle = None
            shell = ctypes.windll.shell32
            shell.SHFileOperationW.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(_SHFileOpStructW)]
            shell.SHFileOperationW.restype = ctypes.c_int
            code = shell.SHFileOperationW(ctypes.byref(op))
            if code == 0 and not op.fAnyOperationsAborted:
                return True, "已移动到回收站"
        except Exception:
            pass
    try:
        trash = APP_DIR / ".trash" / "servers"
        trash.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
        destination = trash / f"{stamp}-{target.name}"
        index = 2
        while destination.exists():
            destination = trash / f"{stamp}-{target.name}-{index}"
            index += 1
        shutil.move(str(target), str(destination))
        return True, f"已移入启动器回收目录：{destination}"
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, str(exc)
