    def _apply_adaptive_height(self) -> None:
        screen = QApplication.primaryScreen()
        available = screen.availableGeometry().height() if screen else 900
        height = max(320, min(470, int(available) - 360))
        self.results_panel.setFixedHeight(height)
        self.detail_panel.setFixedHeight(height)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 版本上下文 / 下载目标

    def _installed_versions(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
        items: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
        for summary in self.main.versions:
            base = summary.id
            loader = summary.loader
            try:
                chain = resolve_version(
                    self.main.config.game_path, summary.id
                ).chain
                if chain:
                    base = chain[0]
            except Exception:
                pass
            key = (base, loader, summary.id)
            if key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                items.append(key)
        return items

    def _reload_bases(self) -> None:
        current = self.mc_combo.currentText().strip()
        bases: list[str] = []
        preferred = ""
        selected = next(
            (v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == self.main.selected_version),
            None,
        )
        if selected:
            try:
                chain = resolve_version(
                    self.main.config.game_path, selected.id
                ).chain
                if chain:
                    preferred = chain[0]
            except Exception:
                preferred = selected.id
        for base, _loader, _version_id in self._installed_versions():
            if base not in bases:
                bases.append(base)
        for version in COMMON_VERSIONS:
            if version not in bases:
                bases.append(version)

        self.mc_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.mc_combo.clear()
        self.mc_combo.addItems(bases)
        target = preferred or current or (bases[0] if bases else "")
        if target:
            index = self.mc_combo.findText(target)
            if index >= 0:
                self.mc_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
            else:
                self.mc_combo.setEditText(target)
        self.mc_combo.blockSignals(False)

        loader = (selected.loader if selected else "").lower()
        loader = {"neoforge": "neoforge", "forge": "forge", "fabric": "fabric"}.get(
            loader, "fabric"
        )
        self.loader_tabs.set_value(loader)
        self._update_context()

    def _update_context(self) -> None:
        mc = self.mc_combo.currentText().strip()
        loader = self.loader_tabs.current()
        loader_name = LOADER_LABELS.get(loader, loader)
        matches = [
            version_id
            for base, name, version_id in self._installed_versions()
            if base == mc and name == loader_name
        ]
        if matches:
            target = (
                self.main.selected_version
                if self.main.selected_version in matches
                else matches[0]
            )
            self._target_version_id = target
            if self.main.config.version_isolation:
                self.context_label.setText(
                    f"将下载到版本 {target} 的独立 mods 文件夹：versions/{target}/mods"
                )
            else:
                self.context_label.setText(
                    f"本地已有 Minecraft {mc} · {loader_name}。"
                    "版本隔离已关闭，Mod 会放入公共 mods 文件夹。"
                )
            self.context_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['green']};")
        else:
            self._target_version_id = ""
            if self.main.config.version_isolation:
                self.context_label.setText(
                    f"本地还没有 Minecraft {mc} 的 {loader_name} 版本，"
                    "无法确定独立 mods 目录。请先点击“安装加载器”。"
                )
            else:
                self.context_label.setText(
                    f"本地还没有 Minecraft {mc} 的 {loader_name} 版本。"
                    "可以先安装加载器，否则下载的 Mod 不会被加载。"
                )
            self.context_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['orange']};")
        if hasattr(self, "download_btn"):
            self._sync_download_button()

    def _on_context_changed(self) -> None:
        self._update_context()
        self._page = 0
        self._selected_project = ""
        self._project = None
        self._hit = None
        self._gallery = []
        self._hits = []
        self._nav_stack.clear()
        self._pending_project_id = ""
        self._pending_version_id = ""
        self.dep_bar.clear()
        self._render_results(loading=True)
        self._clear_detail()
        self._search(0)

    def _open_loader_dialog(self) -> None:
        dialog = LoaderDialog(self.main)
        dialog.exec()
        self._reload_bases()

    def _can_download(self) -> bool:
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            return False
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if not isinstance(version, dict):
            return False
        if not primary_file(version):
            return False
        if self.main.config.version_isolation and not self._target_version_id:
            return False
        return True

    def _sync_download_button(self) -> None:
        """下载中始终允许点“取消下载”，不被切换项目等刷新流程重新禁用。"""
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(self._can_download())

    def _target_mods_dir(self) -> Path:
        target = self._target_version_id or self.main.selected_version
        return self.main.config.mods_path(target)

    def _open_folder(self) -> None:
        path = self._target_mods_dir()
        try:
            path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建 mods 文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(path)

    def _open_forum_search(self) -> None:
        self._open_forum_for(self.search.text().strip())

    def _open_forum_for_selected(self) -> None:
        title = ""
        if self._project:
            title = str(self._project.get("title") or "")
        if not title and self._hit:
            title = str(self._hit.get("title") or "")
        self._open_forum_for(title or self.search.text().strip())

    @staticmethod
    def _open_forum_for(query: str) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(forum_search_url(query)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 搜索与分页

    def _search(self, page: int = 0) -> None:
        if self._polling:
            return
        mc = self.mc_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not mc:
            self.status_label.setText("请先填写 MC 版本")
            return
        page = max(0, int(page))
        loader = self.loader_tabs.current()
        offset = page * self._page_size
        self._polling = True
        self.search_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self._update_pager()
        self.status_label.setText(f"正在搜索 {self._source_name()}…")
        self.status_label.setToolTip("")
        if page == 0:
            self._render_results(loading=True)

        worker = ModSearchWorker(
            self.search.text().strip(),
            loader,
            mc,
            offset,
            self._page_size,
            self,
            source=self._source,
        )
        self._search_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, used, w=worker: self._search_ready(
                w, data, error, used
            )
        )
        worker.start()

    def _search_ready(
        self, worker: ModSearchWorker, data, error: str, offset: int
    ) -> None:
        if worker is not self._search_worker:
            return
        self._polling = False
        self.search_btn.setEnabled(True)
        current_mc = self.mc_combo.currentText().strip()
        if (
            worker.loader != self.loader_tabs.current()
            or worker.game_version != current_mc
            or worker.source != self._source
        ):
            QTimer.singleShot(60, lambda: self._search(0))
            return
        if error or data is None:
            self.status_label.setText("搜索失败")
            self.status_label.setToolTip(error or "未知错误")
            if not self._hits:
                self._render_results(message=f"搜索失败：{_short(error, 60)}")
            else:
                self._update_pager()
            return
        hits = [hit for hit in data.get("hits") or [] if isinstance(hit, dict)]
        self._hits = hits
        self._page = offset // self._page_size
        self._total = int(data.get("total_hits") or len(hits))
        self.status_label.setText("")
        self.status_label.setToolTip("")
        self._render_results()
        if hits:
            first = str(hits[0].get("project_id") or hits[0].get("slug") or "")
            if first:
                self._select_project(first, hits[0])
        else:
            self._selected_project = ""
            self._project = None
            self._hit = None
            self._clear_detail("这一页没有可显示的项目。")

    def _render_results(self, loading: bool = False, message: str = "") -> None:
        while self.results_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.results_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.setParent(None)
                widget.deleteLater()
        self._rows.clear()

        if loading:
            hint = QLabel(f"正在搜索 {self._source_name()}…")
            hint.setObjectName("Tiny")
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.results_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
        elif message:
            hint = QLabel(message)
            hint.setObjectName("Muted")
            hint.setWordWrap(True)
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.results_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
        elif not self._hits:
            hint = QLabel("没有找到匹配的 Mod，换个关键词试试。\n也可以到苦力怕论坛搜索。")
            hint.setObjectName("Muted")
            hint.setWordWrap(True)
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.results_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
        else:
            loader = self.loader_tabs.current()
            for hit in self._hits:
                row = ModResultRow(
                    hit, loader, source_label=self._source_name()
                )
                row.clicked.connect(
                    lambda project_id, h=hit: self._select_project(project_id, h)
                )
                row.set_selected(
                    str(hit.get("project_id") or hit.get("slug") or "")
                    == self._selected_project
                )
                self.results_layout.insertWidget(self.results_layout.count() - 1, row)
                self._rows.append(row)
                icon_url = str(hit.get("icon_url") or "")
                if icon_url:
                    image = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(icon_url)
                    if image is not None:
                        row.set_icon(image)
                    else:
                        self._load_image(
                            icon_url,
                            lambda img, r=row: r.set_icon(img),
                        )
        self._sync_results_height()
        self._update_pager()

    def _sync_results_height(self) -> None:
        self.results_layout.activate()
        self.results_holder.setMinimumHeight(self.results_layout.sizeHint().height())

    def _update_pager(self) -> None:
        pages = max(1, (self._total + self._page_size - 1) // self._page_size)
        current = min(self._page + 1, pages)
        self.page_label.setText(f"第 {current} / {pages} 页" if self._total else "第 1 页")
        self.result_count.setText(f"共 {self._total} 个" if self._total else "")
        self.prev_btn.setEnabled(not self._polling and self._page > 0)
        self.next_btn.setEnabled(
            not self._polling and (self._page + 1) * self._page_size < self._total
        )

    def _prev_page(self) -> None:
        if self._page > 0 and not self._polling:
            self._search(self._page - 1)

    def _next_page(self) -> None:
        if not self._polling and (self._page + 1) * self._page_size < self._total:
            self._search(self._page + 1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 项目详情

    def _select_project(
        self, project_id: str, hit: dict, *, keep_nav: bool = False
    ) -> None:
        if not project_id:
            return
        if not keep_nav:
            # 直接点击搜索结果时结束前置导航，返回按钮随之消失。
            self._nav_stack.clear()
            self._pending_project_id = ""
            self._pending_version_id = ""
        self._selected_project = project_id
        self._hit = hit
        self.detail_scroll.verticalScrollBar().setValue(0)
        for row in self._rows:
            row.set_selected(row.project_id == project_id)
        same = self._project is not None and str(self._project.get("id") or "") == project_id

        self.detail_title.setText(str(hit.get("title") or hit.get("slug") or "Mod"))
        author = str(hit.get("author") or "")
        categories = ", ".join((hit.get("categories") or [])[:3])
        meta_parts = []
        if author:
            meta_parts.append(f"作者：{author}")
        if categories:
            meta_parts.append(f"分类：{categories}")
        self.detail_author.setText(" · ".join(meta_parts) or self._source_name())
        self.detail_desc.setText(str(hit.get("description") or ""))
        self.downloads_badge.setText(f"{_human_number(hit.get('downloads'))} 下载")
        self.followers_badge.setText(
            "0 收藏" if self._source == "curseforge" else "0 关注"
        )
        self.updated_label.setText("")
        self._update_badges()
        self.version_combo.clear()
        self.version_combo.setEnabled(False)
        self.version_combo.addItem(
            f"正在获取 {self._source_name()} 文件…", ""
        )
        self.download_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.dep_label.setText("")
        self.dep_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self.dep_bar.set_state(
            [], show_back=bool(self._nav_stack), projects=self._dep_projects
        )
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.detail_note.setText("正在读取项目详情与预览图…")
        self.detail_note.setStyleSheet("")
        self._gallery = []
        self._gallery_index = 0
        self._gallery_url = ""
        self.gallery_count.setText("0 / 0")
        self.gallery_prev.setEnabled(False)
        self.gallery_next.setEnabled(False)
        self.gallery_flip.setEnabled(False)
        self.gallery_open_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.gallery_preview.set_message("正在加载项目详情…")
        self.gallery_caption_label.setText("")
        self.body_excerpt.setText("")
        for label in (
            self.meta_categories,
            self.meta_loaders,
            self.meta_versions,
            self.meta_license,
        ):
            label.setText("—")
        self._clear_links()
        if same:
            self._project_ready(project_id, self._project, "")
        else:
            fallback_url = str(hit.get("project_url") or "")
            if not fallback_url and hit.get("slug"):
                fallback_url = (
                    f"https://modrinth.com/mod/{hit.get('slug')}"
                    if self._source == "modrinth"
                    else ""
                )
            fallback_links: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
            if fallback_url:
                fallback_links.append((self._source_name(), fallback_url))
            fallback_title = str(hit.get("title") or "")
            if fallback_title:
                fallback_links.append(("论坛搜索", forum_search_url(fallback_title)))
            if fallback_links:
                self._set_links(fallback_links)
        icon_url = str(hit.get("icon_url") or "")
        self._set_detail_icon(icon_url)

        if not same:
            self._project = None
            worker = ModProjectWorker(
                project_id, self, source=self._source
            )
            self._project_worker = worker
            worker.ready.connect(self._project_ready)
            worker.start()

        versions_worker = ModVersionsWorker(
            project_id,
            self.loader_tabs.current(),
            self.mc_combo.currentText().strip(),
            self,
            source=self._source,
        )
        self._versions_worker = versions_worker
        versions_worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=versions_worker, pid=project_id: self._versions_ready(
                w, pid, data, error
            )
        )
        versions_worker.start()

    def _project_ready(self, project_id: str, data, error: str) -> None:
        if project_id != self._selected_project:
            return
        if error or not isinstance(data, dict):
            self.detail_note.setText(f"无法读取项目详情：{error}")
            self.detail_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['orange']};")
            return
        self._project = data
        self.detail_note.setText("")
        title = str(data.get("title") or self.detail_title.text())
        self.detail_title.setText(title)
        description = str(data.get("description") or "")
        if description:
            self.detail_desc.setText(description)
        author = str((self._hit or {}).get("author") or "")
        categories = [str(c) for c in data.get("categories") or [] if c]
        meta_parts = []
        if author:
            meta_parts.append(f"作者：{author}")
        if categories:
            meta_parts.append(f"分类：{', '.join(categories[:3])}")
        if meta_parts:
            self.detail_author.setText(" · ".join(meta_parts))
        downloads = data.get("downloads")
        followers = data.get("followers")
        self.downloads_badge.setText(f"{_human_number(downloads)} 下载")
        self.followers_badge.setText(
            f"{_human_number(followers)} 收藏"
            if self._source == "curseforge"
            else f"{_human_number(followers)} 关注"
        )
        updated = str(data.get("updated") or "")[:10]
        self.updated_label.setText(f"更新于 {updated}" if updated else "")
        self._update_badges()

        self.meta_categories.setText(" / ".join(categories[:5]) or "—")
        loaders = [str(item) for item in data.get("loaders") or [] if item]
        self.meta_loaders.setText(" / ".join(loaders[:4]) or "—")
        versions = [str(item) for item in data.get("game_versions") or [] if item]
        version_text = "、".join(versions[:8])
        if len(versions) > 8:
            version_text += f" 等 {len(versions)} 个"
        self.meta_versions.setText(version_text or "—")
        license_data = data.get("license")
        if isinstance(license_data, dict):
            license_text = str(license_data.get("name") or license_data.get("id") or "")
        else:
            license_text = str(license_data or "")
        self.meta_license.setText(license_text or "—")
        excerpt = _plain_excerpt(str(data.get("body") or ""), 280)
        self.body_excerpt.setText(excerpt)
        self.body_excerpt.setVisible(bool(excerpt))

        icon_url = str(data.get("icon_url") or (self._hit or {}).get("icon_url") or "")
        self._set_detail_icon(icon_url)
        self._set_links(self._project_links(data))
        self._set_gallery(data.get("gallery") or [])

    def _update_badges(self) -> None:
        repolish(self.downloads_badge)
        repolish(self.followers_badge)

    def _set_detail_icon(self, url: str) -> None:
        if not url:
            self.detail_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("cube", colors()["purple"], 28))
            return
        image = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(url)
        if image is not None:
            self.detail_icon.setPixmap(_cover_pixmap(image, 54, 11))
            return
        self.detail_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("cube", colors()["purple"], 28))
        self._load_image(
            url,
            lambda image, expected=url: self._set_detail_icon_image(expected, image),
        )

    def _set_detail_icon_image(self, url: str, image: QImage | None) -> None:
        if url != str((self._project or {}).get("icon_url") or (self._hit or {}).get("icon_url") or ""):
            if url not in (
                str((self._hit or {}).get("icon_url") or ""),
                str((self._project or {}).get("icon_url") or ""),
            ):
                return
        if image is not None and not image.isNull():
            self.detail_icon.setPixmap(_cover_pixmap(image, 54, 11))

    def _project_links(self, data: dict) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        links: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        project_url = str(data.get("project_url") or "").strip()
        if project_url:
            links.append(
                (
                    str(data.get("source_label") or self._source_name()),
                    project_url,
                )
            )
        else:
            slug = str(data.get("slug") or "")
            if slug:
                links.append(("Modrinth", f"https://modrinth.com/mod/{slug}"))
        for key, label in (
            ("source_url", "源码"),
            ("issues_url", "问题"),
            ("wiki_url", "Wiki"),
            ("discord_url", "Discord"),
        ):
            value = str(data.get(key) or "").strip()
            if value:
                links.append((label, value))
        title = str(data.get("title") or (self._hit or {}).get("title") or "")
        links.append(("论坛搜索", forum_search_url(title)))
        return links[:5]

    def _clear_links(self) -> None:
        while self.links_layout.count():
            item = self.links_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.deleteLater()

    def _set_links(self, links: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
        self._clear_links()
        for label, url in links:
            button = QPushButton(label)
            button.setObjectName("Ghost")
            button.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
            button.setIcon(icons.icon("external", colors()["text2"], 12))
            button.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 7px;")
            button.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, target=url: QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(target)))
            self.links_layout.addWidget(button)
        self.links_layout.addStretch(1)

    def _clear_detail(self, message: str = "") -> None:
        self.detail_scroll.verticalScrollBar().setValue(0)
        self.detail_title.setText("选择一个 Mod 查看详细信息")
        self.detail_author.setText("从左侧搜索结果中选择项目。")
        self.detail_desc.setText(message)
        self.downloads_badge.setText("0 下载")
        self.followers_badge.setText(
            "0 收藏" if self._source == "curseforge" else "0 关注"
        )
        self.updated_label.setText("")
        self._update_badges()
        self.version_combo.clear()
        self.version_combo.setEnabled(False)
        self.version_combo.addItem("请选择一个 Mod", "")
        self._sync_download_button()
        self.dep_label.setText("")
        self._nav_stack.clear()
        self._pending_project_id = ""
        self._pending_version_id = ""
        self.dep_bar.clear()
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.detail_note.setText("")
        self._gallery = []
        self._gallery_index = 0
        self._gallery_url = ""
        self.gallery_count.setText("0 / 0")
        self.gallery_prev.setEnabled(False)
        self.gallery_next.setEnabled(False)
        self.gallery_flip.setEnabled(False)
        self.gallery_open_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.gallery_preview.set_message("选择 Mod 后显示预览图")
        self.gallery_caption_label.setText("")
        self.body_excerpt.setText("")
        for label in (
            self.meta_categories,
            self.meta_loaders,
            self.meta_versions,
            self.meta_license,
        ):
            label.setText("—")
        self._clear_links()
        self.detail_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("cube", colors()["purple"], 28))

    def _set_gallery(self, gallery: list) -> None:
        self._gallery = [
            item if isinstance(item, dict) else {"url": str(item)}
            for item in gallery
            if (isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("url")) or isinstance(item, str)
        ]
        total = len(self._gallery)
        self.gallery_count.setText(f"1 / {total}" if total else "0 / 0")
        self.gallery_prev.setEnabled(False)
        self.gallery_next.setEnabled(total > 1)
        self.gallery_flip.setEnabled(total > 1)
        self.gallery_open_btn.setEnabled(bool(total))
        if not total:
            self.gallery_preview.set_message("该项目暂未提供预览图")
            self.gallery_caption_label.setText("可以前往苦力怕论坛查找玩家截图")
            return
        self._show_gallery(0)

    def _show_gallery(self, index: int) -> None:
        if not self._gallery:
            return
        index = max(0, min(len(self._gallery) - 1, int(index)))
        self._gallery_index = index
        item = self._gallery[index]
        url = str(item.get("url") or "")
        caption = str(item.get("title") or item.get("description") or "").strip()
        self._gallery_url = url
        self._gallery_caption = caption
        self.gallery_count.setText(f"{index + 1} / {len(self._gallery)}")
        self.gallery_prev.setEnabled(index > 0)
        self.gallery_next.setEnabled(index < len(self._gallery) - 1)
        self.gallery_flip.setEnabled(len(self._gallery) > 1)
        self.gallery_open_btn.setEnabled(bool(url))
        self.gallery_preview.set_message("正在加载预览图…")
        self.gallery_caption_label.setText(_short(caption, 42) if caption else "")
        self.gallery_caption_label.setToolTip(caption)
        if not url:
            self.gallery_preview.set_message("预览图地址无效")
            return
        cached = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(url)
        if cached is not None:
            self.gallery_preview.set_image(cached)
        else:
            self._load_image(
                url,
                lambda image, expected=url: self._gallery_image_ready(expected, image),
            )
        if index + 1 < len(self._gallery):
            next_url = str(self._gallery[index + 1].get("url") or "")
            if next_url and next_url not in _IMAGE_CACHE:
                self._load_image(next_url, lambda *_: None)

    def _flip_gallery(self) -> None:
        if len(self._gallery) <= 1:
            return
        self._show_gallery((self._gallery_index + 1) % len(self._gallery))

    def _gallery_image_ready(self, url: str, image: QImage | None) -> None:
        if url != self._gallery_url:
            return
        if image is None or image.isNull():
            self.gallery_preview.set_message("预览图加载失败")
        else:
            self.gallery_preview.set_image(image)

    def _open_gallery_current(self) -> None:
        if not self._gallery:
            return
        item = self._gallery[self._gallery_index]
        url = str(item.get("full_url") or self._gallery_url or "")
        if url:
            QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 异步图标

    def _load_image(self, url: str, callback) -> None:
        if not url:
            return
        cached = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(url)
        if cached is not None:
            try:
                callback(cached)
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
            return
        self._image_waiters.setdefault(url, []).append(callback)
        if url in self._image_workers:
            return
        worker = ImageFetchWorker(url, self)
        self._image_workers[url] = worker
        worker.ready.connect(self._image_ready)
        worker.start()

    def _image_ready(self, url: str, image) -> None:
        self._image_workers.pop(url, None)
        if image is not None and not getattr(image, "isNull", lambda: True)():
            _cache_image(url, image)
        callbacks = self._image_waiters.pop(url, [])
        for callback in callbacks:
            try:
                callback(image)
            except RuntimeError:
                continue

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 版本文件与下载

    def _versions_ready(
        self, worker: ModVersionsWorker, project_id: str, data, error: str
    ) -> None:
        if worker is not self._versions_worker or project_id != self._selected_project:
            return
        preferred = (
            self._pending_version_id
            if project_id == self._pending_project_id
            else ""
        )
        self._pending_project_id = ""
        self._pending_version_id = ""

        self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            self.version_combo.clear()
            if error:
                self.version_combo.addItem("获取版本失败", "")
                self.dep_label.setText(error)
                self.dep_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']};")
                self._sync_download_button()
                return
            if not data:
                self.version_combo.addItem("没有适配当前版本的文件", "")
                self.dep_label.setText(
                    "该 Mod 没有同时适配所选 Minecraft 版本和加载器的文件，"
                    "可以尝试切换加载器或游戏版本。"
                )
                self.dep_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['orange']};")
                self._sync_download_button()
                return

            target_index = 0
            for index, version in enumerate(data):
                file = primary_file(version) or {}
                version_number = str(
                    version.get("version_number") or version.get("name") or ""
                )
                version_type = str(version.get("version_type") or "")
                filename = str(file.get("filename") or "")
                suffix = f" · {version_type}" if version_type else ""
                if not file.get("url"):
                    suffix += " · 仅网页下载"
                self.version_combo.addItem(
                    f"{_short(version_number, 30)}{suffix}", version
                )
                tip = f"{version_number}\n{filename}" if filename else version_number
                if not file.get("url"):
                    tip += "\n该文件未开放第三方下载，请打开 CurseForge 页面手动下载。"
                self.version_combo.setItemData(index, tip, Qt.ToolTipRole)
                if preferred and str(version.get("id") or "") == preferred:
                    target_index = index
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(target_index)
            self.version_combo.setEnabled(True)
        finally:
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self.dep_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._on_version_changed()

    def _on_version_changed(self) -> None:
        self._update_dependencies()
        self._sync_download_button()

    def _update_dependencies(self) -> None:
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if not isinstance(version, dict):
            self.dep_bar.set_state(
                [], show_back=bool(self._nav_stack), projects=self._dep_projects
            )
            return
        deps = required_dependencies(version)
        visible = [dep for dep in deps if str(dep.get("project_id") or "")]
        raw_file = next(
            (
                item
                for item in version.get("files") or []
                if isinstance(item, dict)
            ),
            {},
        )
        file = primary_file(version) or raw_file
        size = int(file.get("size") or 0)
        downloadable = bool(file.get("url"))
        parts = []
        if size:
            parts.append(f"{size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB")
        if not downloadable:
            parts.append(
                "该文件未开放第三方下载，请点击上方 CurseForge 页面手动下载"
            )
        if visible:
            parts.append(f"需要 {len(visible)} 个前置 Mod，点击下方按钮直接下载")
        elif deps:
            parts.append(f"声明了 {len(deps)} 个必需前置，请确认已安装")
        elif downloadable:
            parts.append("没有声明必需前置")
        self.dep_label.setText(" · ".join(parts))
        self.dep_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {colors()['orange']};"
            if deps or not downloadable
            else ""
        )
        if visible:
            self._request_dependency_projects(visible)
        self.dep_bar.set_state(
            visible,
            show_back=bool(self._nav_stack),
            projects=self._dep_projects,
        )

    def _request_dependency_projects(self, deps: list[dict]) -> None:
        ids = [
            str(dep.get("project_id") or "")
            for dep in deps
            if isinstance(dep, dict)
        ]
        ids = [
            project_id
            for project_id in dict.fromkeys(ids)
            if project_id
            and project_id not in self._dep_projects
            and project_id not in self._dep_projects_pending
        ]
        if not ids:
            return
        self._dep_projects_pending.update(ids)
        worker = ModProjectsWorker(ids, self, source=self._source)
        self._dep_projects_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=worker: self._dep_projects_ready(w, data, error)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _dep_projects_ready(
        self, worker: ModProjectsWorker, data, error: str
    ) -> None:
        self._dep_projects_pending.difference_update(worker.project_ids)
        if worker is self._dep_projects_worker:
            self._dep_projects_worker = None
        if isinstance(data, dict) and data:
            self._dep_projects.update(data)
            self.dep_bar.update_projects(data)

    def _current_version_id(self) -> str:
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if isinstance(version, dict):
            return str(version.get("id") or "")
        return ""

    def _dependency_hit(self, project_id: str, project: dict | None) -> dict:
        data = project if isinstance(project, dict) else {}
        return {
            "project_id": str(data.get("id") or project_id),
            "slug": str(data.get("slug") or ""),
            "title": str(data.get("title") or data.get("slug") or project_id),
            "description": str(data.get("description") or ""),
            "author": str(data.get("author") or ""),
            "downloads": data.get("downloads") or 0,
            "categories": data.get("categories") or [],
            "icon_url": str(data.get("icon_url") or ""),
            "project_url": str(data.get("project_url") or ""),
            "source": str(data.get("source") or self._source),
            "source_label": str(
                data.get("source_label") or self._source_name()
            ),
        }

    def _open_dependency(self, project_id: str, version_id: str) -> None:
        project_id = str(project_id or "")
        if not project_id:
            return
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast("请先等待当前下载结束，再查看前置 Mod", "info")
            return
        project = self._dep_projects.get(project_id) or {}
        canonical = str(project.get("id") or project_id)
        if canonical == self._selected_project:
            return
        self._nav_stack.append(
            (
                self._selected_project,
                dict(self._hit or {}),
                self._current_version_id(),
            )
        )
        self._pending_project_id = canonical
        self._pending_version_id = str(version_id or "")
        self._select_project(
            canonical, self._dependency_hit(canonical, project), keep_nav=True
        )

    def _go_back_dependency(self) -> None:
        if not self._nav_stack:
            return
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast("请先等待当前下载结束，再返回", "info")
            return
        project_id, hit, version_id = self._nav_stack.pop()
        if not project_id:
            self.dep_bar.set_state(
                [], show_back=False, projects=self._dep_projects
            )
            return
        self._pending_project_id = project_id
        self._pending_version_id = version_id
        self._select_project(project_id, hit, keep_nav=True)

    def _set_download_button(self, downloading: bool) -> None:
        if downloading:
            self.download_btn.setObjectName("Danger")
            self.download_btn.setText("取消下载")
            self.download_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("stop", colors()["red"], 15))
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.download_btn.setObjectName("Primary")
            self.download_btn.setText("下载到 mods")
            self.download_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("download", "#FFFFFF", 15))
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(self._can_download())
        repolish(self.download_btn)
        self.adjustSize()

    def _download(self) -> None:
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self._download_worker.cancel()
            self.download_btn.setText("正在取消…")
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if not isinstance(version, dict):
            return
        if not primary_file(version):
            self.main.toast(
                "该文件未开放第三方下载，请打开 CurseForge 页面手动下载",
                "error",
            )
            return
        if self.main.config.version_isolation and not self._target_version_id:
            self.main.toast("请先安装匹配版本的加载器，再下载 Mod", "error")
            return
        mods_dir = self._target_mods_dir()
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText(f"准备下载到 {mods_dir.parent.name}/mods…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.adjustSize()
        worker = ModDownloadWorker(
            version,
            mods_dir,
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            parent=self.main,
        )
        self._download_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_download_finished)
        self._set_download_button(True)
        worker.start()

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, percent)))
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_download_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, filename: str) -> None:
        self._download_worker = None
        self._set_download_button(False)
        if success:
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText(f"已保存 {filename}")
            self.main.toast(f"已下载 {filename}", "success")
            if hasattr(self.main, "mods_page"):
                self.main.mods_page.refresh_mods()
        elif "取消" in str(message):
            self.progress_text.setText("下载已取消")
            self.main.toast("已取消下载，临时文件已清理", "info")
        else:
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self.main.toast(f"下载失败：{message}", "error")

def _count_files(root: Path) -> int:
    if not root.is_dir():
        return 0
    count = 0
    try:
        for path in root.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file():
                count += 1
    except OSError:
        pass
    return count

        self.cancel_btn = self.add_button("取消", "Secondary", self._on_cancel)

    @staticmethod
    def _field_label(text: str) -> QLabel:
        label = QLabel(text)
        label.setObjectName("SegLabel")
        return label

    def _options(self) -> PackOptions:
        values = {key: box.isChecked() for key, box in self.option_boxes.items()}
        return PackOptions(**values)

    def _start_export(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if not self.name_edit.text().strip():
            self._show_error("给纸箱写个名字吧，空名字会被猫猫叼走。")
            return
        default_name = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text()) or self.version_id
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "保存 DKL 整合包",
            str(self.main.config.game_path / f"{default_name}{PACK_EXTENSION}"),
            f"Darkitten 整合包 (*{PACK_EXTENSION})",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        output = Path(path)
        if output.suffix.lower() != PACK_EXTENSION:
            output = output.with_suffix(PACK_EXTENSION)
        self._begin_busy()
        worker = PackExportWorker(
            self.main.config.game_path,
            self.version_id,
            output,
            name=self.name_edit.text().strip(),
            description=self.desc_edit.text().strip(),
            options=self._options(),
            isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.log_line.connect(self.main.log)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _begin_busy(self) -> None:
        self._busy = True
        self._hide_error()
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(False)
        self.desc_edit.setEnabled(False)
        for box in self.option_boxes.values():
            box.setEnabled(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.progress_text.setText("正在折纸箱…")
        self.pack_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消打包")

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, path: str) -> None:
        self._busy = False
        self._worker = None
        self.progress.setValue(100 if success else 0)
        if success:
            self._result_path = path
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self.pack_btn.setText("完成")
            self.pack_btn.setEnabled(True)
            try:
                self.pack_btn.clicked.disconnect()
            except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
                pass
            self.pack_btn.clicked.connect(self.accept)
            self.cancel_btn.setVisible(False)
            self.main.log(message)
            self.main.toast("整合包已经装进纸箱，喵。", "success")
            return
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(True)
        self.desc_edit.setEnabled(True)
        for box in self.option_boxes.values():
            box.setEnabled(True)
        self.pack_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.pack_btn.setText("重新打包")
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消")
        self._show_error(message or "打包失败")
        self.main.log(f"打包失败：{message}")

    def _show_error(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.error.setText(text)
        self.error.setVisible(True)

    def _hide_error(self) -> None:
        self.error.clear()
        self.error.setVisible(False)

    def _on_cancel(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            if not self._worker:
                return
            self._worker.cancel()
            self.progress_text.setText("正在把纸箱收回来…")
            self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self.reject()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "停止打包",
                "纸箱还没封好，现在离开会取消打包。确定吗？",
                primary_text="停止打包",
                secondary_text="继续",
                icon_name="warning",
                icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                return
            if self._worker:
                self._worker.cancel()
            self._busy = False
        super().reject()

    def result_path(self) -> str:
        return self._result_path

            self,

    def _load_pack(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self._info = None
        self._kind = ""
        dkl_error: Exception | None = None
        info: PackInfo | ModrinthPackInfo
        try:
            info = inspect_pack(path)
        except Exception as exc:
            dkl_error = exc
        else:
            self._kind = "dkl"

        if not self._kind:
            if looks_like_modrinth_pack(path):
                try:
                    info = inspect_modrinth_pack(path)
                except Exception as exc:
                    self._show_error(f"Modrinth 整合包无法导入：{exc}")
                    self.preview.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_options.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
                    return
                self._kind = "modrinth"
            else:
                self._show_error(str(dkl_error or "无法识别这个整合包"))
                self.preview.setVisible(False)
                self.import_options.setVisible(False)
                self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
                return

        self._info = info
        self._attempted_version_id = ""
        self.path_edit.setText(str(path))
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self._hide_error()
        self.preview.setVisible(True)
        self.import_options.setVisible(True)
        self.preview_name.setText(info.name)
        loader_text = info.loader or "原版"
        if info.loader and info.loader_version:
            loader_text += f" {info.loader_version}"
        self.preview_loader.setText(loader_text)
        self.preview_mc.setText(f"Minecraft {info.minecraft_version or '未知'}")
        self.preview_loader.setVisible(bool(info.loader))
        if self._kind == "modrinth":
            self.preview_meta.setText(
                f"来自 Modrinth · {info.total_files} 个文件 · "
                f"下载约 {human_size(info.total_bytes)} · "
                f"压缩包 {human_size(info.archive_bytes)}"
            )
        else:
            created = (
                info.created_at[:19].replace("T", " ")
                if info.created_at
                else "未知"
            )
            self.preview_meta.setText(
                f"来自 {info.created_with or 'DKL'} · {created} · "
                f"{info.total_files} 个文件 · 解压后 {human_size(info.total_bytes)} · "
                f"压缩包 {human_size(info.archive_bytes)}"
            )
        parts = []
        for key in ("mods", "config", "defaultconfigs", "resourcepacks", "shaderpacks", "saves"):
            count = int(info.counts.get(key) or 0)
            if count:
                parts.append(f"{CONTENT_LABELS.get(key, key)} {count}")
        self.preview_contents.setText("纸箱里装着：" + ("、".join(parts) or "只有版本信息"))
        self.preview_contents.setVisible(bool(parts))
        self.preview_desc.setText(info.description)
        self.preview_desc.setVisible(bool(info.description))

        default_id = unique_version_id(self.main.config.game_path, info.name)
        self.name_edit.setText(default_id)
        hint = "默认使用整合包名称；如果已存在同名版本会自动加序号。"
        if self._kind == "modrinth":
            hint += (
                f" 导入时会安装 Minecraft {info.minecraft_version}"
                + (
                    f" + {info.loader} {info.loader_version}"
                    if info.loader
                    else ""
                )
                + "，并下载清单里的文件。"
            )
        if not self.main.config.version_isolation:
            hint += "  版本隔离关闭，mods 会写入共享目录。"
        self.name_hint.setText(hint)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.import_btn.setText("导入猫窝")

    def _download_url(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle":
            return
        url = self.url_edit.text().strip()
        if not url:
            self._show_error("链接是空的，猫猫找不到纸箱。")
            return
        self._hide_error()
        self._begin_busy("fetch")
        worker = PackFetchWorker(
            url,
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            inspect_result=False,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_fetch_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _on_fetch_finished(self, path: str, error: str) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        self._mode = "idle"
        self._set_controls_enabled(True)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消")
        if error:
            self._show_error(error)
            return
        self.progress_text.setText("下载完成")
        self._load_pack(Path(path))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _start_import(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle" or not self._info:
            return
        target = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text())
        if not target:
            self._show_error("导入名称不能为空。")
            return
        version_dir = self.main.config.game_path / "versions" / target
        resume = bool(
            self._attempted_version_id
            and self._attempted_version_id == target
            and version_json_path(self.main.config.game_path, target).is_file()
        )
        if version_dir.exists() and not resume:
            suggestion = unique_version_id(self.main.config.game_path, target)
            self.name_edit.setText(suggestion)
            self._show_error(
                f"版本 {target} 已经存在。可以改用 {suggestion}，或先删除旧版本。"
            )
            return
        self._hide_error()
        self._begin_busy("import")
        if self._kind == "modrinth":
            worker: PackImportWorker | ModrinthPackImportWorker = (
                ModrinthPackImportWorker(
                    self._info.path,
                    self.main.config.game_path,
                    target,
                    java_path=self.main.config.java_path,
                    overwrite=self.overwrite.isChecked(),
                    resume=resume,
                    isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
                    source=self.main.config.download_source,
                    threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
                    parent=self,
                )
            )
        else:
            worker = PackImportWorker(
                self._info.path,
                self.main.config.game_path,
                target,
                overwrite=self.overwrite.isChecked(),
                resume=resume,
                isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
                source=self.main.config.download_source,
                threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
                parent=self,
            )
        self._worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.log_line.connect(self.main.log)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_import_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _on_import_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, version_id: str) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        self._mode = "idle"
        if success:
            self.imported_version = version_id
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self.main.refresh_versions()
            self.main.log(f"整合包导入完成：{version_id}")
            self.main.toast("猫窝已经搬好，去版本列表看看喵。", "success")
            self.accept()
            return

        self._set_controls_enabled(True)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消")
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.import_btn.setText("重新导入")
        exists = version_json_path(
            self.main.config.game_path,
            normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text()),
        ).is_file()
        if exists:
            self._attempted_version_id = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text())
            self.main.refresh_versions()
            message = (
                f"{message}\n已保留版本骨架，可以再次点击“重新导入”继续补全；"
                "已下载的文件不会重复下载。"
            )
        self._show_error(message or "导入失败")
        self.main.log(f"整合包导入失败：{message}")

    def _begin_busy(self, mode: str) -> None:
        self._mode = mode
        self._hide_error()
        self._set_controls_enabled(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.progress_text.setText(
            "正在下载纸箱…" if mode == "fetch" else "正在给猫窝腾位置…"
        )
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消下载" if mode == "fetch" else "取消导入")
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)

    def _set_controls_enabled(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        self.choose_btn.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.download_btn.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.url_edit.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.overwrite.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(enabled and self._info is not None)

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_cancel(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle" and self._worker:
            self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.progress_text.setText("正在收回猫爪…")
            self._worker.cancel()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            return
        self.reject()

    def _show_error(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.error.setText(text)
        self.error.setVisible(True)

    def _clear_error(self) -> None:
        self.error.clear()
        self.error.setVisible(False)

    def _hide_error(self) -> None:
        self._clear_error()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle":
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "停止当前任务",
                "猫猫还在搬纸箱，现在离开会中断操作。已下载的临时文件可能保留。"
                "确定停止吗？",
                primary_text="停止",
                secondary_text="继续",
                icon_name="warning",
                icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                return
            if self._worker:
                self._worker.cancel()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            self._mode = "idle"
        super().reject()

    "release": "正式版",
    "snapshot": "快照",
    "old_beta": "旧测试版",
    "old_alpha": "远古版",

def _date_text(value: str) -> str:
    if not value:
        return "未知时间"
    return value[:10]


class DownloadVersionRow(QFrame):
    clicked = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, entry: dict, installed: bool, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.entry = entry
        self.setObjectName("SelectRow")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFixedHeight(52)
        self.setProperty("selected", "false")

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(11, 6, 10, 6)
        layout.setSpacing(9)

        marker = QLabel()
        marker.setFixedSize(28, 28)
        marker.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        vtype = str(entry.get("type", "release"))
        color = colors()["green"] if vtype == "release" else (
            colors()["orange"] if vtype == "snapshot" else colors()["muted"]
        )
        marker.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("cube", color, 18))

        info = QVBoxLayout()
        info.setSpacing(1)
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.setSpacing(6)
        name = QLabel(str(entry.get("id", "")))
        name.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        top.addWidget(name)
        top.addWidget(
            badge(
                TYPE_LABELS.get(vtype, vtype),
                "green" if vtype == "release" else ("orange" if vtype == "snapshot" else "gray"),
            )
        )
        top.addStretch(1)
        if installed:
            top.addWidget(badge("已安装", "blue"))
        info.addLayout(top)

        meta = QLabel(_date_text(str(entry.get("releaseTime", ""))))
        meta.setObjectName("Tiny")
        info.addWidget(meta)

        layout.addWidget(marker)
        layout.addLayout(info, 1)
        chevron = QLabel()
        chevron.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("chevron-right", colors()["muted"], 15))
        layout.addWidget(chevron)
        transparent_children(self)

    def set_selected(self, selected: bool) -> None:
        self.setProperty("selected", "true" if selected else "false")
        repolish(self)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit(str(self.entry.get("id", "")))
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        actions.setSpacing(8)
        actions.addStretch(1)
        self.cancel_btn = QPushButton("取消安装")
        self.cancel_btn.setObjectName("Danger")
        self.cancel_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.cancel_btn.setMinimumSize(110, 42)
        self.cancel_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("stop", colors()["red"], 16))
        self.cancel_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.cancel_btn.clicked.connect(self._cancel_install)
        actions.addWidget(self.cancel_btn)
        self.install_btn = QPushButton("安装此版本")
        self.install_btn.setObjectName("Primary")
        self.install_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.install_btn.setMinimumSize(148, 42)
        self.install_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("download", "#FFFFFF", 17))
        self.install_btn.clicked.connect(self._install_selected)
        actions.addWidget(self.install_btn)
        detail_layout.addLayout(actions)

        layout.addWidget(self.detail, 1)
        self.detail.setVisible(False)
        return card

    @staticmethod
    def _info_column(layout: QHBoxLayout, title: str) -> QLabel:
        box = QVBoxLayout()
        box.setSpacing(2)
        label = QLabel(title)
        label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        value = QLabel("—")
        value.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700;")
        box.addWidget(label)
        box.addWidget(value)
        layout.addLayout(box)
        return value

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _source_text(self) -> str:
        source = self.main.config.download_source
        if source == "bmclapi":
            return "BMCLAPI 镜像"
        if source == "auto":
            return "智能加速"
        return "Mojang 官方"

    def _update_source_badge(self) -> None:
        source = self.main.config.download_source
        self.source_badge.setText(self._source_text())
        self.source_badge.setProperty(
            "badge", "purple" if source == "bmclapi" else ("green" if source == "auto" else "blue")
        )
        repolish(self.source_badge)

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self._update_source_badge()
        self._update_cancel_button()
        if not self._manifest and not self._loading:
            self.load_manifest()
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._ensure_selected_visible)

    def _ensure_selected_visible(self) -> None:
        row = self._rows.get(self._selected)
        if row:
            self.list_scroll.ensureWidgetVisible(row, 0, 8)

    def load_manifest(self, force: bool = False) -> None:
        if self._loading:
            return
        self._loading = True
        self.list_status.setText("正在获取版本清单…")
        self.list_status.setVisible(True)
        self.search.setEnabled(False)
        self.filters.setEnabled(False)
        self._worker = ManifestWorker(self.main.config.download_source, force)
        self._worker.ready.connect(self._manifest_ready)
        self._worker.start()

    def _manifest_ready(self, data, error: str) -> None:
        self._loading = False
        self.search.setEnabled(True)
        self.filters.setEnabled(True)
        if not data:
            self.list_status.setText(f"获取版本清单失败：{error}")
            self.list_status.setVisible(True)
            retry = self.load_more
            retry.setVisible(True)
            retry.setText("重试")
            try:
                retry.clicked.disconnect()
            except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
                pass
            retry.clicked.connect(lambda: self.load_manifest(force=True))
            return

        self._manifest = data
        raw = data.get("versions") or []
        self._entries = [v for v in raw if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("id")]
        self._limit = 70
        self._apply_filter()
        latest = data.get("latest") or {}
        preferred = latest.get("release") or (self._entries[0]["id"] if self._entries else "")
        if self.main.selected_version in {e.get("id") for e in self._entries}:
            preferred = self.main.selected_version
        if preferred:
            self.select_version(str(preferred), scroll=False)

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self._update_source_badge()
        if self._manifest:
            self._apply_filter()
            if self._selected:
                entry = next(
                    (e for e in self._entries if str(e.get("id")) == self._selected),
                    None,
                )
                if entry and not self.main.install_active:
                    self._update_detail(entry)
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self._ensure_selected_visible)

    def _on_search(self, _text: str) -> None:
        self._limit = 70
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_filter(self, value: str) -> None:
        self._filter = value
        self._limit = 70
        self._apply_filter()

    def _filtered(self) -> list[dict]:
        query = self.search.text().strip().lower()
        result = []
        for entry in self._entries:
            vtype = str(entry.get("type", ""))
            if self._filter == "release" and vtype != "release":
                continue
            if self._filter == "snapshot" and vtype != "snapshot":
                continue
            if query and query not in str(entry.get("id", "")).lower():
                continue
            result.append(entry)
        return result

    def _apply_filter(self) -> None:
        filtered = self._filtered()
        self.count_label.setText(f"{len(filtered)} 个")
        while self.list_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.list_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.deleteLater()
        self._rows.clear()

        if not filtered:
            self.list_status.setText("没有匹配的版本")
            self.list_status.setVisible(True)
            self.load_more.setVisible(False)
            return

        self.list_status.setVisible(False)
        installed = {v.id for v in self.main.versions}
        for entry in filtered[: self._limit]:
            row = DownloadVersionRow(entry, str(entry.get("id")) in installed)
            row.clicked.connect(self.select_version)
            row.set_selected(str(entry.get("id")) == self._selected)
            self._rows[str(entry.get("id"))] = row
            self.list_layout.insertWidget(self.list_layout.count() - 1, row)

        self.load_more.setText("加载更多版本")
        self.load_more.setVisible(len(filtered) > self._limit)
        try:
            self.load_more.clicked.disconnect()
        except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
            pass
        self.load_more.clicked.connect(self._more)

    def _more(self) -> None:
        self._limit += 90
        self._apply_filter()

    def select_version(self, version_id: str, scroll: bool = True) -> None:
        entry = next(
            (e for e in self._entries if str(e.get("id")) == version_id), None
        )
        if not entry:
            return
        self._selected = version_id
        for vid, row in self._rows.items():
            row.set_selected(vid == version_id)
        self._update_detail(entry)
        if scroll:
            row = self._rows.get(version_id)
            if row:
                self.list_scroll.ensureWidgetVisible(row)

    def _update_detail(self, entry: dict) -> None:
        self.empty.setVisible(False)
        self.detail.setVisible(True)
        version_id = str(entry.get("id", ""))
        vtype = str(entry.get("type", "release"))
        type_label = TYPE_LABELS.get(vtype, vtype)
        self.detail_title.setText(version_id)
        self.detail_badge.setText(type_label)
        self.detail_badge.setProperty(
            "badge", "green" if vtype == "release" else ("orange" if vtype == "snapshot" else "gray")
        )
        repolish(self.detail_badge)

        latest = (self._manifest or {}).get("latest") or {}
        tags = []
        if latest.get("release") == version_id:
            tags.append("最新正式版")
        if latest.get("snapshot") == version_id:
            tags.append("最新快照")
        sub = " · ".join(tags + [f"Minecraft Java Edition {type_label}"])
        self.detail_sub.setText(sub)

        self.info_type.setText(type_label)
        self.info_date.setText(_date_text(str(entry.get("releaseTime", ""))))
        self.info_source.setText(self._source_text())

        installed_ids = {v.id for v in self.main.versions}
        installed = version_id in installed_ids
        self.install_state.setText("已安装" if installed else "未安装")
        self.install_state.setProperty("badge", "green" if installed else "gray")
        repolish(self.install_state)
        self.install_btn.setText("补全 / 校验文件" if installed else "安装此版本")
        self.install_btn.setEnabled(not self.main.install_active)
        self._update_cancel_button()
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.log.clear()

    def _install_selected(self) -> None:
        if not self._selected:
            return
        if self.main.install_active:
            self.main.toast("已有安装任务正在进行", "info")
            return
        entry = next(
            (e for e in self._entries if str(e.get("id")) == self._selected), None
        )
        if not entry:
            return
        installed = self._selected in {v.id for v in self.main.versions}
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText("准备安装…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.log.clear()
        self.main.begin_install(
            str(entry.get("id")),
            version_url=str(entry.get("url", "")),
            verify=installed,
        )

    def _on_install_started(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if version_id == self._selected:
            self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
            self.progress.setValue(0)
            self.progress_text.setText("准备安装…")
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self._update_cancel_button()

    def _update_cancel_button(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "cancel_btn"):
            return
        installed = self.main.install_active
        self.cancel_btn.setVisible(bool(installed))
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(bool(installed) and not self.main._install_cancelling)
        self.cancel_btn.setText(
            "正在取消…" if installed and self.main._install_cancelling else "取消安装"
        )

    def _cancel_install(self) -> None:
        self.main.cancel_install()
        self.cancel_btn.setText("正在取消…")
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_install_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)
        worker = self.main.install_worker
        if worker and worker.installer:
            self.speed_text.setText(worker.installer.speed_text)

    def _on_task_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        if self.progress_box.isVisible():
            self.log.appendPlainText(line)
            bar = self.log.verticalScrollBar()
            bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _on_install_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, version_id: str) -> None:
        self._update_cancel_button()
        if version_id == self._selected:
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(True)
            if success:
                self.progress.setValue(100)
                self.progress_text.setText("安装完成")
                self.speed_text.setText("")
            else:
                self.progress_text.setText(message)
                self.speed_text.setText("")
            self.install_btn.setText("补全 / 校验文件")

    def _on_local_versions_changed(self) -> None:
        if not self._manifest:
            return
        self._apply_filter()
        if self._selected:
            entry = next(
                (e for e in self._entries if str(e.get("id")) == self._selected), None
            )
            if entry:
                installed = self._selected in {v.id for v in self.main.versions}
                self.install_state.setText("已安装" if installed else "未安装")
                self.install_state.setProperty(
                    "badge", "green" if installed else "gray"
                )
                repolish(self.install_state)
                self.install_btn.setText(
                    "补全 / 校验文件" if installed else "安装此版本"
                )

class QuickAction(QFrame):
    clicked = Signal()

    def __init__(
        self, icon_name: str, title: str, subtitle: str, accent: str, parent=None
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("SelectRow")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setMinimumHeight(66)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(8, 9, 8, 9)
        layout.setSpacing(8)

        icon_box = QLabel()
        icon_box.setFixedSize(30, 30)
        icon_box.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap(icon_name, accent, 18))
        color = QColor(accent)
        icon_box.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: rgba({color.red()},{color.green()},{color.blue()},26);"
            "border-radius: 8px;"
        )

        texts = QVBoxLayout()
        texts.setSpacing(1)
        name = QLabel(title)
        name.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        sub = QLabel(subtitle)
        sub.setObjectName("Tiny")
        sub.setToolTip(subtitle)
        for label in (name, sub):
            label.setMinimumWidth(0)
            label.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Preferred)
        texts.addWidget(name)
        texts.addWidget(sub)

        layout.addWidget(icon_box)
        layout.addLayout(texts, 1)
        transparent_children(self)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    def _build_account_card(self) -> QWidget:
        card = Card()
