        self.avatar = Avatar(48)
        row.addWidget(self.avatar)

        info = QVBoxLayout()
        info.setSpacing(2)
        self.account_name = QLabel("Steve")
        self.account_name.setStyleSheet("font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;")
        self.account_uuid = QLabel("")
        self.account_uuid.setObjectName("Tiny")
        info.addWidget(self.account_name)
        info.addWidget(self.account_uuid)
        row.addLayout(info, 1)

        self.account_btn = icon_button("edit", "修改玩家名称")
        self.account_btn.clicked.connect(self.edit_account)
        row.addWidget(self.account_btn)
        layout.addLayout(row)

        self.account_note = QLabel(
            "离线账户仅用于本地游戏，无法加入正版验证服务器。"
        )
        self.account_note.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.account_note.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.account_note)
        return card

    def _build_quick_card(self) -> QWidget:
        card = Card()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
        layout.setContentsMargins(18, 15, 18, 15)
        layout.setSpacing(9)
        title = QLabel("猫爪快捷方式")
        title.setObjectName("H2")
        layout.addWidget(title)

        grid = QHBoxLayout()
        grid.setSpacing(8)
        col1 = QVBoxLayout()
        col1.setSpacing(8)
        col2 = QVBoxLayout()
        col2.setSpacing(8)

        actions = [
            ("folder", "游戏目录", "打开游戏文件夹", "#E23A5E", self.main.open_game_dir),
            ("package", "导入版本包", "ZIP 版本或 DKL 整合包", "#E8683F", self.main.open_version_import),
            ("migrate", "版本迁移", "搬走存档与 Mod", "#3FB3AA", lambda: self.main.open_migration_dialog(self._selected)),
            ("users", "好友与联机", "邀请卡直达房间", "#3FB3AA", self.main.open_social_dialog),
            ("cube", "模组管理", "管理已装 Mod", "#B15BE0", lambda: self.main.switch_page("mods")),
            ("download", "补全文件", "修复缺失依赖", "#C98A4B", self.main.complete_selected),
        ]
        for index, (icon_name, title_text, sub, accent, callback) in enumerate(actions):
            action = QuickAction(icon_name, title_text, sub, accent)
            action.clicked.connect(callback)
            (col1 if index % 2 == 0 else col2).addWidget(action)

        grid.addLayout(col1, 1)
        grid.addLayout(col2, 1)
        layout.addLayout(grid, 1)
        return card

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def refresh_versions(self) -> None:
        versions: list[VersionSummary] = list(self.main.versions)
        self.version_count.setText(f"{len(versions)} 个版本")

        had_selection = self._selected
        while self.version_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.version_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.deleteLater()

        self._version_rows.clear()
        if not versions:
            self.empty_box.setVisible(True)
            self.version_scroll.setVisible(False)
            self._selected = ""
            self.main.selected_version = ""
            self.main.selection_changed.emit("")
            self.hero_sub.setText("还没有版本可玩，先去仓库叼一个回来吧。")
            self.hero_status.setText("● 猫窝是空的")
            self.hero_status.setStyleSheet(
                "color: rgba(255,220,180,220); background: rgba(255,255,255,26);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
            self.launch_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return

        self.empty_box.setVisible(False)
        self.version_scroll.setVisible(True)

        valid_ids = {v.id for v in versions}
        target = had_selection if had_selection in valid_ids else ""
        if not target and self.main.config.last_version in valid_ids:
            target = self.main.config.last_version
        if not target:
            target = versions[0].id
        self._selected = target
        self.main.selected_version = target

        row_widgets: list[VersionRow] = []
        for summary in versions:
            row = VersionRow(summary, selected=(summary.id == target))
            row.clicked.connect(self.select_version)
            row.double_clicked.connect(self._launch_version)
            row.delete_requested.connect(self.main.delete_version)
            row.export_requested.connect(self.main.export_version)
            row.migrate_requested.connect(
                lambda version_id: self.main.open_migration_dialog(version_id)
            )
            row_widgets.append(row)
            self._version_rows[summary.id] = row
            self.version_layout.insertWidget(self.version_layout.count() - 1, row)

        self._update_hero()
        self.main.config.last_version = target
        self.main.config.save()

    def _launch_version(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if version_id != self._selected:
            self.select_version(version_id)
        self.main.launch_selected()

    def select_version(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if version_id == self._selected:
            return
        self._selected = version_id
        self.main.selected_version = version_id
        self.main.config.last_version = version_id
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.selection_changed.emit(version_id)
        for vid, row in self._version_rows.items():
            row.setProperty("selected", "true" if vid == version_id else "false")
            row.style().unpolish(row)
            row.style().polish(row)
            row.update()
        self._update_hero()

    def _update_hero(self) -> None:
        summary = next((v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == self._selected), None)
        if not summary:
            return
        self.main.config.last_version = self._selected
        display_type = summary.loader or summary.type_name
        java_text = f" · Java {summary.java_major}+" if summary.java_major else ""
        self.hero_sub.setText(
            f"Minecraft {summary.id} · {display_type}{java_text}"
        )
        self.hero_title.setText(
            f"今天也要去捣乱吗，{self.main.display_name()}？"
        )
        self._refresh_status()

    def _refresh_status(self) -> None:
        if not self._selected:
            return
        try:
            resolved = resolve_version(self.main.config.game_path, self._selected)
            missing = check_installation(
                self.main.config.game_path, resolved, check_assets=False
            )
        except Exception:
            missing = ["版本文件异常"]

        self._refresh_launch_button()
        if self._closing:
            self.hero_status.setText("● 正在把猫猫拖回来…")
            style = (
                "color: #FFD9D9; background: rgba(255,110,110,45);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        elif self.main.launch_active:
            self.hero_status.setText("● 正在磨爪子…")
            style = (
                "color: #D8E6FF; background: rgba(120,170,255,50);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        elif self.main.game_running:
            self.hero_status.setText("● 在游戏里捣乱中")
            style = (
                "color: #C9F7D8; background: rgba(80,220,140,55);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        elif missing:
            self.hero_status.setText(f"● 还差 {len(missing)} 块拼图")
            style = (
                "color: #FFE1B8; background: rgba(255,190,90,45);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        else:
            self.hero_status.setText("● 猫爪已就绪")
            style = (
                "color: #C9F7D8; background: rgba(80,220,140,45);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        self.hero_status.setStyleSheet(style)

        account = self.main.current_account()
        self.hero_title.setText(
            f"今天也要去捣乱吗，{self.main.display_name()}？"
        )
        self.avatar.refresh()
        self.account_name.setText(self.main.display_name())
        if account.is_msa:
            uid = account.uuid
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"正版 · UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}" if uid else "正版账户"
            )
            self.account_badge.setText("微软正版")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.account_note.setText(
                "已通过 Microsoft 正版验证，可以进入正版验证服务器。"
            )
            self.account_btn.setToolTip("管理正版账户")
        else:
            uid = offline_uuid(self.main.config.player_name)
            self.account_uuid.setText(f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}")
            self.account_badge.setText("离线模式")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            self.account_note.setText(
                "离线账户仅用于本地游戏，无法加入正版验证服务器。"
            )
            self.account_btn.setToolTip("修改玩家名称")
        repolish(self.account_badge)

    def edit_account(self) -> None:
        if self.main.current_account().is_msa:
            self.main.switch_page("settings")
            return
        dialog = TextInputDialog(
            self.main,
            "修改玩家名称",
            "离线模式使用的游戏内名称。",
            self.main.config.player_name,
        )
        if dialog.exec():
            self.main.config.player_name = dialog.value()
            self.main.config.save()
            self.main.account_changed.emit()
            self._update_hero()
            self.main.toast("玩家名称已更新", "success")

    def _on_launch_click(self) -> None:
        if self.main.launch_active:
            self.main.cancel_launch()
        elif self.main.game_running:
            self.main.close_game()
        else:
            self.main.launch_selected()

    def _refresh_launch_button(self) -> None:
        if self._closing:
            text, icon_name, color, obj = "正在关闭…", "stop", colors()["red"], "Danger"
            enabled = False
        elif self.main.launch_active:
            text, icon_name, color, obj = "取消启动", "stop", colors()["red"], "Danger"
            enabled = True
        elif self.main.game_running:
            text, icon_name, color, obj = "关闭游戏", "stop", colors()["red"], "Danger"
            enabled = True
        else:
            text, icon_name, color, obj = "启动游戏", "play", "#3A0F1C", "Launch"
            enabled = bool(self._selected) and not self.main.install_active
        self.launch_btn.setObjectName(obj)
        self.launch_btn.setText(text)
        self.launch_btn.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.launch_btn.setIcon(icons.icon(icon_name, color, 19))
        repolish(self.launch_btn)

    def set_launching(self, launching: bool) -> None:
        if launching:
            self._closing = False
        self._refresh_status()

    def set_game_closing(self) -> None:
        self._closing = True
        self._refresh_status()

    def set_game_running(self, running: bool) -> None:
        if not running:
            self._closing = False
        self._refresh_status()

class ModRow(QFrame):
    toggled = Signal(object, bool)
    delete_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, mod: ModInfo, parent=None) -> None:

        self.setObjectName("SelectRow")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)

        layout.setContentsMargins(13, 8, 13, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(11)

        icon_box = QLabel()

            f"background: {colors()['purple_soft']}; border-radius: 9px;"
        )

        info = QVBoxLayout()
        info.setSpacing(2)
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.setSpacing(6)
        name = QLabel(mod.name)
        name.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        top.addWidget(name)
        if mod.version:
            version = QLabel(mod.version)
            version.setObjectName("Tiny")
            top.addWidget(version)
        if mod.loader:
            top.addWidget(badge(mod.loader, "purple" if mod.loader == "Fabric" else "orange"))

        top.addStretch(1)
        info.addLayout(top)

        meta = QLabel(f"{mod.filename} · {mod.size_text}")
        meta.setObjectName("Tiny")
        info.addWidget(meta)

        switch = Switch()
        switch.setChecked(mod.enabled)
        switch.setToolTip("启用或禁用此 Mod")
        switch.toggled.connect(lambda checked: self.toggled.emit(self.mod, checked))

        delete_btn = icon_button("trash", "删除此 Mod", colors()["muted"], 30, 15)
        delete_btn.clicked.connect(lambda _=False: self.delete_requested.emit(self.mod))

        layout.addWidget(icon_box)
        layout.addLayout(info, 1)
        layout.addWidget(switch)
        layout.addWidget(delete_btn)
        transparent_children(self)
        switch.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, False)
        delete_btn.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _mods_dir(self) -> Path:
        return self.main.config.mods_path(self.main.selected_version)

    def _update_version_label(self) -> None:
        version = self.main.selected_version or "未选择版本"
        isolated = bool(
            self.main.selected_version and self.main.config.version_isolation
        )
        self.version_label.setText(
            f"当前版本：{version} · {'独立目录' if isolated else '公共目录'}"
        )
        if self.main.selected_version:
            self.empty_title.setText(f"{self.main.selected_version} 的 mods 文件夹是空的")
        else:
            self.empty_title.setText("抽屉里还没有 Mod")
        self.sub.setText(
            "Mod 按游戏版本隔离存放在 versions/<版本>/mods。"
            if self.main.config.version_isolation
            else "版本隔离已关闭，所有版本共用游戏目录下的 mods 文件夹。"
        )

    def _on_selection_changed(self, _version_id: str = "") -> None:
        self._update_version_label()
        self.refresh_mods()

    def _on_filter(self, value: str) -> None:
        self._filter = value
        self.refresh_mods()

    def refresh_mods(self) -> None:
        self._mods = list_mods(self._mods_dir())
        query = self.search.text().strip().lower()
        visible = []
        for mod in self._mods:
            if self._filter == "enabled" and not mod.enabled:
                continue
            if self._filter == "disabled" and mod.enabled:
                continue
            if query and query not in mod.name.lower() and query not in mod.filename.lower():
                continue
            visible.append(mod)

        self.count_label.setText(f"{len(visible)} / {len(self._mods)}")
        while self.list_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.list_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.deleteLater()

        if not self._mods:
            self.empty.setVisible(True)
            self.scroll.setVisible(False)
            return
        self.empty.setVisible(False)
        self.scroll.setVisible(True)

        if not visible:
            hint = QLabel("没有匹配的 Mod")
            hint.setObjectName("Muted")
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.list_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
            return

        for mod in visible:
            row = ModRow(mod)
            row.toggled.connect(self._toggle_mod)
            row.delete_requested.connect(self._delete_mod)
            self.list_layout.insertWidget(self.list_layout.count() - 1, row)

    def _delete_mod(self, mod: ModInfo) -> None:
        if self._delete_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast("已有删除任务正在进行", "info")
            return
        if (
            self.main.game_running
            and self.main._running_version == self.main.selected_version
        ):
            self.main.toast("游戏正在运行，请先关闭游戏再删除 Mod", "error")
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "删除 Mod",
            f"确定删除 {mod.name} 吗？文件会移入系统回收站，可在回收站恢复。",
            primary_text="移入回收站",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="trash",
            icon_color=colors()["red"],
            details=f"文件：{mod.filename}\n位置：{mod.path.parent}",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self.main.set_status(f"正在删除 {mod.filename}…", "busy")
        worker = DeleteWorker(mod.path, self)
        self._delete_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(
            lambda ok, message, m=mod: self._on_mod_deleted(m, ok, message)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _on_mod_deleted(self, mod: ModInfo, success: bool, message: str) -> None:
        self._delete_worker = None
        if not success:
            self.main.set_status(f"删除失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"删除失败：{message}", "error")
            return
        self.main.set_status(f"已删除 {mod.filename}", "success")
        self.main.toast(f"{mod.name} 已移入回收站", "success")
        self.refresh_mods()

    def _toggle_mod(self, mod: ModInfo, enabled: bool) -> None:
        if enabled == mod.enabled:
            return
        try:
            new_path = toggle_mod(mod)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"修改失败：{exc}", "error")
            self.refresh_mods()
            return
        action = "已启用" if new_path.name.endswith(".jar") else "已禁用"
        self.main.toast(f"{action} {mod.name}", "success")
        self.refresh_mods()

    def open_folder(self) -> None:
        mods_dir = self._mods_dir()
        try:
            mods_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建 mods 文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(mods_dir)

    def add_mods(self) -> None:
        mods_dir = self._mods_dir()
        files, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames(
            self,
            "选择 Mod 文件",
            str(mods_dir),
            "Mod 文件 (*.jar *.jar.disabled)",
        )
        if not files:
            return
        try:
            mods_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建 mods 文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return

        added = 0
        skipped = 0
        for raw in files:
            src = Path(raw)
            dest = mods_dir / src.name
            if dest.exists():
                skipped += 1
                continue
            try:
                shutil.copy2(src, dest)
                added += 1
            except OSError:
                skipped += 1
        if added:
            self.main.toast(f"已添加 {added} 个 Mod" + (f"，跳过 {skipped} 个" if skipped else ""), "success")
        else:
            self.main.toast("没有添加新的 Mod（同名文件已存在）", "info")
        self.refresh_mods()

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self._update_version_label()
        self.refresh_mods()  # 版本或隔离设置可能在其他页面变化

        tunnel_btn = QPushButton("隧道规则")
        tunnel_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
        tunnel_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        tunnel_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._open_url(SAKURA_MC_DOCS))
        header.addWidget(tunnel_btn)
        layout.addLayout(header)

        self._step_numbers: list[QLabel] = []
        steps = QHBoxLayout()
        steps.setSpacing(10)
        step_data = [
            ("1", "房主开放世界", "进入单人游戏，按 Esc → 对局域网开放，记下端口。"),
            ("2", "创建房间", "连接樱花穿透，检测端口并创建，把房间号发给朋友。"),
            ("3", "朋友直接进入", "粘贴房间号，选择相同版本，启动后自动连接。"),
        ]
        for number, step_title, step_desc in step_data:
            box = QFrame()
            box.setObjectName("SoftCard")
            box.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
            box_layout = QVBoxLayout(box)
            box_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 10, 12, 10)
            box_layout.setSpacing(3)
            top = QHBoxLayout()
            top.setSpacing(7)
            number_label = QLabel(number)
            number_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            number_label.setFixedSize(20, 20)
            number_label.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; color: {colors()['accent']};"
                "border-radius: 10px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800;"
            )
            self._step_numbers.append(number_label)
            top.addWidget(number_label)
            step_name = QLabel(step_title)
            step_name.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
            top.addWidget(step_name)
            top.addStretch(1)
            box_layout.addLayout(top)
            desc = QLabel(step_desc)
            desc.setObjectName("Tiny")
            desc.setWordWrap(True)
            box_layout.addWidget(desc)
            steps.addWidget(box, 1)
        layout.addLayout(steps)

        warning_box = QFrame()
        warning_box.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        warning_box.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        warning_layout = QHBoxLayout(warning_box)
        warning_layout.setContentsMargins(11, 8, 11, 8)
        warning_layout.setSpacing(8)
        warn_icon = QLabel()
        warn_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("warning", colors()["orange"], 17))
        warning_layout.addWidget(warn_icon, 0, Qt.AlignTop)
        warning = QLabel(
            "房间号只适合朋友之间联机。若在论坛、群聊或视频平台公开宣传，"
            "必须使用带“多线”标记的公开游戏节点，否则可能被樱花穿透封号；"
            "免费账户还有流量、隧道数和实名认证限制。"
        )
        warning.setObjectName("Tiny")
        warning.setWordWrap(True)
        warning_layout.addWidget(warning, 1)
        layout.addWidget(warning_box)
        return card

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 状态与主题

    def _set_status(self, label: QLabel, text: str, kind: str = "muted") -> None:
        c = colors()
        key = STATUS_COLORS.get(kind, STATUS_COLORS["muted"])[0]
        label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {c[key]}; font-size: 11px; background: transparent;"
        )
        label.setText(text)
        if label is self.host_status:
            self._host_status_kind = kind
        elif label is self.guest_status:
            self._guest_status_kind = kind

    def _set_badge(self, label: QLabel, text: str, kind: str) -> None:
        label.setText(text)
        label.setProperty("badge", kind)
        repolish(label)

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, self.host_status.text(), self._host_status_kind
        )
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status, self.guest_status.text(), self._guest_status_kind
        )
        self.create_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("bolt", "#FFFFFF", 16))
        self.join_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("play", "#FFFFFF", 16))
        self.copy_code_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("copy", "#FFFFFF", 14))
        for button in (self.copy_address_btn, self.copy_decode_btn):
            button.setIcon(icons.icon("copy", colors()["text2"], 13))
        for label in getattr(self, "_step_numbers", []):
            label.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; color: {colors()['accent']};"
                "border-radius: 10px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800;"
            )
        for label in self.findChildren(QLabel):
            if label.property("badge"):
                repolish(label)

    def _restore_token(self) -> None:
        token = self.main.config.sakura_access_token
        if not token:
            return
        self._token = token
        self.token_edit.setText(token)
        self.token_edit.setCursorPosition(len(token))
        self.token_edit.setPlaceholderText("已保存访问密钥（已加密）")
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, "已保存访问密钥，切换到本页时自动连接。", "muted"
        )
        self.connect_btn.setText("重新验证")

    def _toggle_token_visibility(self) -> None:
        if self.token_edit.echoMode() == QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password:
            self.token_edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal)
            self.show_token_btn.setText("隐藏")
        else:
            self.token_edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
            self.show_token_btn.setText("显示")

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self._sync_versions()
        if (
            not self._auto_login_attempted
            and self._token
            and self._user is None
            and not self._busy
        ):
            self._auto_login_attempted = True
            QTimer.singleShot(120, lambda: self.login_sakura(silent=True))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 樱花账户

    def login_sakura(self, silent: bool = False) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._tunnel_process is not None:
            self.toast("请先关闭当前房间，再更换访问密钥。", "info")
            return
        token = self.token_edit.text().strip() or self._token
        if not token:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, "请先填写樱花穿透访问密钥。", "error"
            )
            return
        self._pending_token = token
        self._busy = True
        self.connect_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.connect_btn.setText("正在验证…")
        self.create_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.node_refresh.setEnabled(False)
        self._set_status(self.host_status, "正在验证访问密钥并读取节点…", "busy")
        worker = SakuraLoginWorker(token, self)
        self._login_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda payload, error, w=worker, s=silent: self._login_ready(
                w, payload, error, s
            )
        )
        worker.start()

    def _login_ready(
        self,
        worker: SakuraLoginWorker,
        payload,
        error: str,
        silent: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        if self._login_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._login_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self.connect_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.node_refresh.setEnabled(True)
        if error or not isinstance(payload, dict):
            self.connect_btn.setText("验证并连接")
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, error or "无法读取樱花穿透账户。", "error"
            )
            self.toast(error or "樱花穿透连接失败", "error")
            self._sync_controls()
            return

        user: SakuraUser = payload["user"]
        self._user = user
        self._nodes = payload["nodes"]
        self._tunnels = payload["tunnels"]
        self._token = self._pending_token
        old_token = self.main.config.sakura_access_token
        if old_token and old_token != self._token:
            self.main.config.sakura_tunnel_id = 0
        self.main.config.set_sakura_token(self._token)
        self.main.config.save()
        self.token_edit.setText(self._token)
        self.token_edit.setCursorPosition(len(self._token))
        self.token_edit.setPlaceholderText("已保存访问密钥（已加密）")
        self.connect_btn.setText("重新验证")
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "已连接", "green")
        self._populate_nodes()

        details = [
            f"已连接 · {user.name or '樱花账户'}",
            user.realname_text,
            user.traffic_text,
        ]
        if user.speed:
            details.append(f"限速 {user.speed}")
        if user.tunnel_limit:
            details.append(f"隧道 {len(self._tunnels)}/{user.tunnel_limit}")
        self.account_line.setText(" · ".join(details))
        if not user.realname:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "账户尚未实名认证，创建隧道可能被拒绝，请到樱花穿透面板完成认证。",
                "warning",
            )
        else:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, "账户已连接，可以创建房间。", "success"
            )
        self._sync_controls()
        if not silent:
            self.toast("樱花穿透账户已连接", "success")

    def _populate_nodes(self) -> None:
        current_id = self._selected_node_id()
        if not current_id:
            current_id = self.main.config.sakura_node_id
        preferred_tunnel = self._existing_room_tunnel()
        if preferred_tunnel and preferred_tunnel.node in self._nodes:
            current_id = preferred_tunnel.node

        self.node_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.node_combo.clear()
        self.node_combo.addItem("自动选择节点", 0)
        nodes = [
            node
            for node in self._nodes.values()
            if node.selectable and node.host
        ]
        nodes.sort(key=lambda node: (node.public_game, node.vip, not node.mainland, node.name))
        for node in nodes[:200]:
            self.node_combo.addItem(node.label, node.id)
            index = self.node_combo.count() - 1
            tip = node.description or ""
            if node.host:
                tip = (tip + "\n" if tip else "") + f"节点地址：{node.host}"
            self.node_combo.setItemData(index, tip, Qt.ToolTipRole)
        if current_id:
            index = self.node_combo.findData(current_id)
            if index >= 0:
                self.node_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.node_combo.blockSignals(False)
        if not nodes:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "没有可用节点，请稍后刷新，或到樱花穿透面板检查节点状态。",
                "error",
            )

    def _selected_node_id(self) -> int:
        data = self.node_combo.currentData()
        try:
            return int(data or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return 0

    def _existing_room_tunnel(self) -> SakuraTunnel | None:
        preferred = self.main.config.sakura_tunnel_id
        if preferred:
            for tunnel in self._tunnels:
                if tunnel.id == preferred and tunnel.type == "tcp":
                    return tunnel
        candidates = [
            tunnel
            for tunnel in self._tunnels
            if tunnel.name.startswith(ROOM_TUNNEL_NAME) and tunnel.type == "tcp"
        ]
        return max(candidates, key=lambda item: item.id) if candidates else None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 主机流程

    def detect_port(self) -> None:
        process = self.main.game_process
        pid = process.pid if process and self.main.game_running else 0
        if not pid:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "游戏还没有运行。请先启动游戏，并在单人游戏里“对局域网开放”。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        ports = detect_game_lan_ports(pid)
        if not ports:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "没有检测到游戏监听端口。请先在游戏里对局域网开放，再点一次检测。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        port = preferred_lan_port(ports)
        self.port_spin.setValue(port)
        others = [str(item) for item in ports if item != port]
        text = f"已检测到游戏端口 {port}，可以创建房间。"
        if others:
            text += f"（其他监听端口：{', '.join(others[:4])}）"
        self._set_status(self.host_status, text, "success")

    def create_room(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._user is None:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, "请先验证并连接樱花穿透访问密钥。", "error"
            )
            return
        if self.token_edit.text().strip() != self._token:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "访问密钥已修改，请先点击“验证并连接”再创建房间。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        if self._tunnel_process is not None or self._room_payload is not None:
            self.toast("房间已经开启，请先关闭当前房间。", "info")
            return
        port = int(self.port_spin.value())
        node_id = self._selected_node_id()
        if not self._notice_shown:
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "创建联机房间",
                "房间号适合朋友之间私下联机。创建后会占用一条樱花穿透隧道。",
                primary_text="仅熟人联机，继续",
                secondary_text="取消",
                icon_name="users",
                icon_color=colors()["green"],
                details=(
                    "如果你的服务器会发布到论坛、群聊、服务器列表或视频平台，"
                    "必须使用带“多线”标记的公开游戏节点，否则可能违反樱花穿透规则并被封号。"
                    "房主需要保持游戏、启动器和房间全程开启。"
                ),
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                return
            self._notice_shown = True

        self._busy = True
        self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress.setVisible(True)
        self.log_box.clear()
        self.log_box.setVisible(True)
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, "正在准备隧道与内置 frpc…", "busy"
        )
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "准备中", "blue")
        self._sync_controls()

        worker = SakuraRoomWorker(
            self._token,
            port,
            node_id=node_id,
            preferred_tunnel_id=self.main.config.sakura_tunnel_id,
            frpc_path=self.main.config.sakura_frpc_path,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._room_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(
            lambda value, message, w=worker: self._room_progress(w, value, message)
        )
        worker.log_line.connect(
            lambda line, w=worker: self._room_log(w, line)
        )
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda payload, error, w=worker: self._room_ready(w, payload, error)
        )
        worker.failed.connect(
            lambda error, w=worker: self._room_failed(w, error)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _room_progress(
        self, worker: SakuraRoomWorker, value: int, message: str
    ) -> None:
        if self._room_worker is not worker:
            return
        self.progress.setValue(value)
        self._set_status(self.host_status, message, "busy")

    def _room_log(self, worker: SakuraRoomWorker, line: str) -> None:
        if self._room_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._append_log(line)

    def _append_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        text = str(line or "")
        if not text:
            return
        if self._token:
            text = text.replace(self._token, "***")
        text = re.sub(
            r"(?i)((?:access[_ ]?)?token\s*[=:]\s*)\S+", r"\1***", text
        )
        if not self.log_box.isVisible():
            self.log_box.setVisible(True)
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)
        bar = self.log_box.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _room_ready(
        self, worker: SakuraRoomWorker, payload, error: str
    ) -> None:
        if self._room_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._room_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        if error or not isinstance(payload, dict):
            self.progress.setVisible(False)
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, error or "创建房间失败。", "error"
            )
            self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "已连接", "green")
            self.toast(error or "创建房间失败", "error")
            self._sync_controls()
            return

        self._room_payload = payload
        self.main.config.sakura_tunnel_id = int(payload.get("tunnel_id") or 0)
        self.main.config.sakura_node_id = int(payload.get("node_id") or 0)
        self.main.config.save()
        self.progress.setValue(100)
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, "隧道已准备，正在启动内置 frpc…", "busy"
        )
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "连接中", "blue")
        self._start_tunnel(payload)

    def _start_tunnel(self, payload: dict) -> None:
        process = SakuraTunnelProcess(
            payload.get("frpc_path", ""),
            payload.get("config_path", ""),
            self,
        )
        self._tunnel_process = process
        process.log_line.connect(self._append_log)
        process.ready.connect(self._tunnel_ready)
        process.failed.connect(self._tunnel_failed)
        process.finished.connect(self._tunnel_finished)
        process.start()
        self._sync_controls()

    def _tunnel_ready(self, message: str) -> None:
        if self._closing or self._room_payload is None:
            return
        payload = self._room_payload
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "房间开启", "green")
        code = str(payload.get("room_code") or "")
        if code:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                f"房间已开启（{message}）。把房间号发给朋友即可。",
                "success",
            )
        else:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "房间已开启，但房间号生成失败，请直接分享服务器地址。",
                "warning",
            )
        self._show_room_result(payload)
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._sync_controls()

    def _show_room_result(self, payload: dict) -> None:
        code = str(payload.get("room_code") or "")
        address = str(payload.get("address") or "")
        share = str(payload.get("share_address") or address)
        self.room_code_label.setText(code or "房间号不可用")
        if code:
            self.room_code_label.setStyleSheet(
                "font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 2px;"
            )
            self.copy_code_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.room_code_label.setStyleSheet(
                "font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700;"
            )
            self.copy_code_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.room_address_label.setText(f"服务器地址：{address}")
        detail = (
            f"隧道 #{payload.get('tunnel_id', '?')} · "
            f"{payload.get('node_name', '')} · "
            f"本地端口 {payload.get('local_port', '')} · "
            f"frpc {payload.get('frpc_version', '')}"
        )
        code_error = str(payload.get("code_error") or "")
        if code_error:
            detail += f"\n{code_error}"
        if share and share != address:
            detail += f"\n节点地址：{share}"
        self.room_detail_label.setText(detail)
        self.result_box.setVisible(True)
        self._sync_social_room(code or address)
        self._sync_controls()

    def _tunnel_failed(self, message: str) -> None:
        if self._closing:
            return
        process = self._tunnel_process
        if process is not None:
            try:
                process.blockSignals(True)
                process.stop()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._fail_room(message)

    def _tunnel_finished(self, code: int) -> None:
        if self._closing or self._tunnel_process is None:
            return
        self._tunnel_process = None
        if self._room_payload is not None:
            self._fail_room(f"内置 frpc 已退出（代码 {code}），房间已关闭。")

    def _fail_room(self, message: str) -> None:
        payload = self._room_payload
        if payload:
            remove_tunnel_config(payload.get("config_path"))
            self._clear_social_room()
        self._room_payload = None
        self._tunnel_process = None
        self._busy = False
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(
            self.host_badge, "已连接" if self._user else "未连接",
            "green" if self._user else "gray",
        )
        self._set_status(self.host_status, message, "error")
        self.result_box.setVisible(False)
        self.toast(message, "error")
        self._sync_controls()

    def close_room(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            worker = self._room_worker
            if worker:
                worker.cancel()
            self._room_worker = None
            self._busy = False
        process = self._tunnel_process
        self._closing = True
        self._tunnel_process = None
        if process is not None:
            process.blockSignals(True)
            process.stop()
        payload = self._room_payload
        if payload:
            remove_tunnel_config(payload.get("config_path"))
            self._clear_social_room()
        self._room_payload = None
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(
            self.host_badge, "已连接" if self._user else "未连接",
            "green" if self._user else "gray",
        )
        self._set_status(self.host_status, "房间已关闭。", "muted")
        self.result_box.setVisible(False)
        self._closing = False
        self._sync_controls()

    def _copy_room_code(self) -> None:
        code = self.room_code_label.text()
        if not code or code == "房间号不可用":
            self.toast("当前没有可复制的房间号", "info")
            return
        self._copy_text(code, "房间号")

    def _copy_host_address(self) -> None:
        if not self._room_payload:
            return
        self._copy_text(
            str(self._room_payload.get("address") or ""), "服务器地址"
        )

    def _sync_social_room(self, room_code: str) -> None:
        if not room_code:
            return
        try:
            self.main.social_store.set_room(
                room_code, str(self.main.selected_version or "")
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _clear_social_room(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.main.social_store.set_room("", "")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _copy_invite_card(self) -> None:
        payload = self._room_payload or {}
        code = str(payload.get("room_code") or payload.get("address") or "")
        if not code:
            self.toast("房间还没有准备好，稍等一下喵", "info")
            return
        try:
            profile = self.main.social_store.ensure_profile(
                self.main.display_name()
            )
            text = encode_invite(
                profile, code, str(self.main.selected_version or "")
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"生成邀请卡失败：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self._copy_text(text, "好友邀请卡")

    def join_friend_room(self, room_code: str, version_id: str = "") -> None:
        """从好友簿进入房间：填好房间号和版本，直接走客人启动流程。"""
        if self.main.game_running:
            self._copy_text(room_code, "好友房间地址")
            return
        text = str(room_code or "").strip()
        if not text:
            self.toast("好友还没有分享房间号", "info")
            return
        self.code_edit.setText(text)
        self._format_code_field()
        self._update_code_preview()
        if version_id:
            index = self.version_combo.findData(version_id)
            if index < 0:
                self._set_status(
                    self.guest_status,
                    f"好友房间使用 {version_id}，你还没有安装这个版本。"
                    "请先安装相同版本再加入。",
                    "error",
                )
                self.toast(f"缺少版本 {version_id}", "error")
                return
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        if not self._decoded_address:
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status, "好友房间号无效，请让对方重新发一张邀请卡。", "error"
            )
            return
        self.join_room()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 客机流程

    def _sync_versions(self) -> None:
        versions = list(self.main.versions)
        current = self.version_combo.currentData() if self.version_combo.count() else ""
        preferred = str(current or self.main.selected_version or "")
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.version_combo.clear()
        for summary in versions:
            kind = summary.loader or summary.type_name or ""
            label = f"{summary.id} · {kind}" if kind else summary.id
            if summary.error:
                label += "（文件异常）"
            self.version_combo.addItem(label, summary.id)
        if versions:
            index = self.version_combo.findData(preferred)
            if index < 0:
                index = 0
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        else:
            self.version_combo.addItem("未安装游戏版本", "")
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._sync_controls()

    def _sync_selection(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if not version_id:
            return
        index = self.version_combo.findData(version_id)
        if index >= 0 and index != self.version_combo.currentIndex():
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _update_code_preview(self) -> None:
        text = self.code_edit.text().strip()
        if not text:
            self._decoded_address = ""
            self.code_hint.setText(
                "也可以直接粘贴 host:port 形式的服务器地址。"
            )
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status, "房主创建房间后，把房间号发给你即可。", "muted"
            )
            self._sync_controls()
            return
        try:
            host, port = decode_room_input(text)
        except SakuraError as exc:
            self._decoded_address = ""
            if len(re.sub(r"[\s\-_]", "", text)) >= 8:
                self.code_hint.setText(str(exc))
                self._set_status(self.guest_status, str(exc), "error")
            else:
                self.code_hint.setText("继续输入完整的 13 位房间号…")
                self._set_status(self.guest_status, "正在读取房间号…", "muted")
            self._sync_controls()
            return
        self._decoded_address = f"{host}:{port}"
        self.code_hint.setText(f"将连接 {self._decoded_address}")
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status, "房间号有效，选择版本后即可启动。", "success"
        )
        self._sync_controls()

    def _format_code_field(self) -> None:
        text = self.code_edit.text().strip()
        if not text or ":" in text:
            return
        try:
            raw = normalize_room_code(text)
        except SakuraError:
            return
        formatted = f"{raw[:5]}-{raw[5:9]}-{raw[9:]}"
        if formatted != text:
            self.code_edit.setText(formatted)

    def _paste_code(self) -> None:
        text = QApplication.clipboard().text().strip()
        if not text:
            self.toast("剪贴板为空", "info")
            return
        self.code_edit.setText(text)
        self._format_code_field()
        self._update_code_preview()

    def _copy_guest_address(self) -> None:
        if not self._decoded_address:
            self._update_code_preview()
        if not self._decoded_address:
            self.toast("请先输入有效的房间号", "info")
            return
        self._copy_text(self._decoded_address, "服务器地址")

    def join_room(self) -> None:
        self._update_code_preview()
        if not self._decoded_address:
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status, "请先输入有效的房间号。", "error"
            )
            return
        address = self._decoded_address
        if self.main.game_running:
            self._copy_text(address, "服务器地址")
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status,
                "游戏已经在运行，地址已复制。请在多人游戏中添加服务器。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        if self.main.install_active:
            self.toast("正在安装游戏文件，请稍候", "info")
            return
        version_id = str(self.version_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not version_id:
            self.toast("请先安装一个游戏版本", "info")
            return
        if version_id != self.main.selected_version:
            self.main.home_page.select_version(version_id)
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status,
            f"正在启动 {version_id} 并连接 {address}…",
            "busy",
        )
        self.main.launch_selected(connect_address=address)
        if not self.main.game_running and not self.main.launch_active:
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status,
                "启动没有完成，请查看启动器提示或运行日志。",
                "error",
            )

    def _copy_text(self, text: str, label: str) -> None:
        if not text:
            self.toast(f"没有可复制的{label}", "info")
            return
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
        self.toast(f"{label}已复制", "success")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 其他

    def _on_game_state(self, running: bool) -> None:
        if running:
            self.join_btn.setText("游戏运行中 · 复制地址")
        else:
            self.join_btn.setText("启动游戏并进入")
        self.detect_btn.setEnabled(running)
        if hasattr(self, "join_btn"):
            self.join_btn.setIcon(
                icons.icon("copy" if running else "play", "#FFFFFF", 16)
            )
        self._sync_controls()

    def _sync_controls(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "create_btn"):
            return
        room_active = self._tunnel_process is not None or self._room_payload is not None
        self.create_btn.setEnabled(
            bool(self._user) and not self._busy and not room_active
        )
        self.close_btn.setVisible(
            room_active or self._room_worker is not None
        )
        self.connect_btn.setEnabled(not self._busy and not room_active)
        self.token_edit.setEnabled(not room_active)
        self.node_combo.setEnabled(not room_active and bool(self._nodes))
        self.node_refresh.setEnabled(not self._busy and not room_active)
        self.port_spin.setEnabled(not room_active)
        self.detect_btn.setEnabled(not room_active and self.main.game_running)
        has_version = bool(self.version_combo.currentData())
        self.join_btn.setEnabled(has_version and not self._busy)
        self.copy_decode_btn.setEnabled(has_version)

    def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        self.main.toast(text, kind)

    def _open_url(self, url: str) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        self._closing = True
        worker = self._room_worker
        if worker:
            worker.cancel()
            self._room_worker = None
        login = self._login_worker
        if login:
            self._login_worker = None
        process = self._tunnel_process
        self._tunnel_process = None
        if process is not None:
            process.blockSignals(True)
            process.stop()
        payload = self._room_payload
        if payload:
            remove_tunnel_config(payload.get("config_path"))
            self._clear_social_room()
        self._room_payload = None

class _ElidedLabel(QLabel):
    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._full_text = ""
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Preferred)
        self.setText(text)

    def setText(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._full_text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        self.setToolTip(self._full_text)
        self._refresh()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._refresh()

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        width = self.contentsRect().width()
        if width <= 0:
            return
        elided = self.fontMetrics().elidedText(
            self._full_text, Qt.ElideRight, width
        )
        if QLabel.text(self) != elided:
            QLabel.setText(self, elided)


class ServerRow(QFrame):
    clicked = Signal(str)

    def __init__(
        self,
        info: ServerInfo,

        selected: bool,

    ) -> None:

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(9, 7, 9, 7)
        layout.setSpacing(9)

        self.icon_label = QLabel()
        self.icon_label.setFixedSize(38, 38)
        self.icon_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        self.icon_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['card2']}; border-radius: 9px;"
        )
        layout.addWidget(self.icon_label)

        info_layout = QVBoxLayout()
        info_layout.setSpacing(2)
        self.name_label = _ElidedLabel(info.name)
        self.name_label.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        info_layout.addWidget(self.name_label)

        meta = QHBoxLayout()
        meta.setSpacing(5)
        self.type_badge = badge(
            info.type_name, SERVER_BADGE.get(info.kind, "gray")
        )
        meta.addWidget(self.type_badge)
        version = QLabel(info.mc_version)
        version.setObjectName("Tiny")
        meta.addWidget(version)
        meta.addStretch(1)
        self.state_dot = QLabel("●")
        self.state_dot.setStyleSheet("font-size: 8px;")
        self.state_text = QLabel("")
        self.state_text.setObjectName("Tiny")
        meta.addWidget(self.state_dot)
        meta.addWidget(self.state_text)
        info_layout.addLayout(meta)

        layout.addLayout(info_layout, 1)
        transparent_children(self)
        self.refresh_theme()

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        color = KIND_COLORS.get(self.info.kind, colors()["accent"])
        self.icon_label.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("server", color, 22))
        self.icon_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['card2']}; border-radius: 9px;"
        )
        self.set_state(self.state)
        repolish(self.type_badge)

    def set_state(self, state: str) -> None:
        self.state = state
        color_key = {
            "stopped": "muted",
            "starting": "accent",
            "running": "green",
            "stopping": "orange",
        }.get(state, "muted")
        self.state_dot.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {colors()[color_key]}; font-size: 8px;"
        )
        self.state_text.setText(STATE_TEXT.get(state, state))
        self.state_text.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {colors()[color_key]}; font-size: 11px;"
        )

    def set_selected(self, selected: bool) -> None:
        self.setProperty("selected", "true" if selected else "false")
        repolish(self)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit(self.info.folder)
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)
