    @staticmethod
    def _form_label(text: str) -> QLabel:
        label = QLabel(text)
        label.setFixedWidth(72)
        label.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px;")
        return label

    def _form_line(self, layout: QVBoxLayout, title: str) -> QLineEdit:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(8)
        row.addWidget(self._form_label(title))
        edit = QLineEdit()
        edit.setMaxLength(48)
        row.addWidget(edit, 1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return edit

    def _form_spin(
        self,
        layout: QVBoxLayout,
        title: str,
        minimum: int,
        maximum: int,
        step: int,
        suffix: str,
    ) -> QSpinBox:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(8)
        row.addWidget(self._form_label(title))
        spin = QSpinBox()
        spin.setRange(minimum, maximum)
        spin.setSingleStep(step)
        spin.setSuffix(suffix)
        spin.setFixedWidth(160)
        row.addWidget(spin)
        row.addStretch(1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return spin

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 列表 / 选择

    def _state_of(self, info: ServerInfo) -> str:
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        if process is not None:
            return process.state
        return "stopped"

    def refresh_servers(self, preferred_folder: str = "") -> None:
        preferred = preferred_folder or self._selected_folder
        self.servers = scan_servers()
        self.count_label.setText(f"{len(self.servers)} 个" if self.servers else "")

        while self.list_layout.count():
            item = self.list_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget is not None:
                widget.setParent(None)
                widget.deleteLater()
        self._rows = []

        if not self.servers:
            empty = QFrame()
            empty.setObjectName("SoftCard")
            empty.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
            empty_layout = QVBoxLayout(empty)
            empty_layout.setContentsMargins(14, 18, 14, 18)
            empty_layout.setSpacing(4)
            title = QLabel("还没有服务端")
            title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700;")
            empty_layout.addWidget(title)
            hint = QLabel("点击右上角“新建服务端”开始。")
            hint.setObjectName("Tiny")
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            hint.setWordWrap(True)
            empty_layout.addWidget(hint)
            self.list_layout.addWidget(empty)
            self.list_layout.addStretch(1)
            self._selected_folder = ""
            self.detail_placeholder.setVisible(True)
            self.detail_content.setVisible(False)
            self.empty_title.setText("还没有服务端")
            self.empty_sub.setText(
                "选择 Paper、Spigot 或模组服务端，启动器会自动下载并生成启动文件。"
            )
            self.empty_btn.setText("新建服务端")
            return

        target = preferred
        folders = {info.folder for info in self.servers}
        if target not in folders:
            target = self.servers[0].folder
        for info in self.servers:
            row = ServerRow(info, self._state_of(info), info.folder == target)
            row.clicked.connect(self._select)
            self.list_layout.addWidget(row)
            self._rows.append(row)
        self.list_layout.addStretch(1)

        self.detail_placeholder.setVisible(False)
        self.detail_content.setVisible(True)
        self._select(target, force=True)

    def _select(self, folder: str, force: bool = False) -> None:
        if not force and folder == self._selected_folder:
            self._load_console(folder)
            return
        info = next((item for item in self.servers if item.folder == folder), None)
        if info is None:
            return
        self._selected_folder = folder
        for row in self._rows:
            row.set_selected(row.info.folder == folder)
        self._show_detail(info)
        self._load_console(folder)
        self._load_settings(info)
        self.refresh_addons()
        self._update_controls()
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self.tabs.set_value("console")

    def _show_detail(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        self.detail_name.setText(info.name)
        self.type_badge.setText(info.type_name)
        self.type_badge.setProperty("badge", SERVER_BADGE.get(info.kind, "gray"))
        repolish(self.type_badge)
        self.version_badge.setText(info.display_version)
        self.path_label.setText(str(info.path))
        self.detail_icon.setPixmap(
            icons.pixmap(
                "server", KIND_COLORS.get(info.kind, colors()["accent"]), 26
            )
        )
        self.detail_icon.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 11px;"
        )
        self.tabs.set_item_text(
            "addons", "插件" if info.is_plugin_server else "Mod"
        )
        self.addon_download_btn.setText(
            "下载插件" if info.is_plugin_server else "下载 Mod"
        )
        self.addon_path_label.setText(str(addons_dir(info)))
        self.address_label.setText(f"localhost:{info.port}")
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 控制台

    def _load_console(self, folder: str) -> None:
        lines = self._buffers.get(folder, [])
        self.console.setPlainText("\n".join(lines))
        bar = self.console.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _append_console(self, folder: str, line: str) -> None:
        text = str(line or "").rstrip()
        if not text:
            return
        buffer = self._buffers.setdefault(folder, [])
        buffer.append(text)
        if len(buffer) > 2500:
            del buffer[:500]
        if folder == self._selected_folder:
            self.console.appendPlainText(text)
            bar = self.console.verticalScrollBar()
            bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _clear_console(self) -> None:
        if not self._selected_folder:
            return
        self._buffers[self._selected_folder] = []
        self.console.clear()

    def _quick_command(self, command: str) -> None:
        if command.endswith(" "):
            self.command_edit.setText(command)
            self.command_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self.command_edit.setText(command)
        self.send_command()

    def send_command(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        if process is None or not process.is_running:
            self.toast("服务端还没有运行", "info")
            return
        command = self.command_edit.text().strip()
        if not command:
            return
        if command.startswith("/"):
            command = command[1:]
        try:
            process.send(command)
        except ServerError as exc:
            self.toast(str(exc), "error")
            return
        self._append_console(info.folder, f"> {command}")
        self.command_edit.clear()

    def _copy_address(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(f"localhost:{info.port}")
        self.toast("服务器地址已复制", "success")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 启动 / 停止

    def start_server(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        if info.folder in self._processes:
            self.toast("服务端已经在运行", "info")
            return
        if self._install_worker is not None and self._install_folder == info.folder:
            self.toast("服务端仍在安装中，请稍候", "info")
            return
        if not info.installed:
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "服务端尚未安装完成",
                "这个服务端缺少可启动文件，请先在设置页重新安装。",
                button_text="知道了",
                icon_name="warning",
            ).exec()
            self.tabs.set_value("settings")
            self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(2)
            return

        required = required_java_major(info.mc_version)
        java = pick_java(
            self.main.java_installs,
            required,
            info.java_path or self.main.config.java_path,
        )
        if java is None or (java.major and java.major < required):
            self._java_problem(info, required, java)
            return

        if not info.eula:
            if not self._accept_eula(info, start_after=False):
                return

        if not check_port(info.port):
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "端口被占用",
                f"端口 {info.port} 已被其他程序占用，服务端将无法监听。",
                primary_text="修改端口",
                secondary_text="取消",
                icon_name="warning",
                icon_color=colors()["orange"],
                details="可以换一个端口（例如 25566），保存后重新启动。"
                "如果占用端口的是另一个 Minecraft 服务端，请先关闭它。",
            )
            if dialog.exec():
                self.tabs.set_value("settings")
                self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(2)
                self.settings_port.setFocus()
            return

        process = ServerProcess(info, java_path=java.path, parent=self)
        process.output.connect(
            lambda line, f=info.folder: self._append_console(f, line)
        )
        process.started.connect(
            lambda pid, f=info.folder: self._on_process_started(f, pid)
        )
        process.ready.connect(
            lambda f=info.folder: self._on_process_ready(f)
        )
        process.state_changed.connect(
            lambda state, f=info.folder: self._on_process_state(f, state)
        )
        process.stopped.connect(
            lambda code, f=info.folder: self._on_process_stopped(f, code)
        )

        try:
            process.start()
        except ServerError as exc:
            self.toast(str(exc), "error")
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "无法启动服务端",
                str(exc),
                button_text="知道了",
                icon_name="warning",
            ).exec()
            return

        self._processes[info.folder] = process
        self._expected_stop.discard(info.folder)
        self._buffers[info.folder] = []
        self.console.clear()
        self._append_console(info.folder, f"正在启动 {info.type_name} {info.mc_version}…")
        self._append_console(info.folder, f"Java：{java.path}")
        info.last_started = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        save_server(info)
        self.tabs.set_value("console")
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _java_problem(self, info: ServerInfo, required: int, java) -> None:
        found = (
            f"当前选择的是 Java {java.major or '?'}（{java.path}），"
            if java is not None
            else "没有检测到可用的 Java。"
        )
        dialog = NoticeDialog(
            self,
            "需要 Java",
            f"{info.type_name} {info.mc_version} 需要 Java {required} 或更高版本。"
            f"{found}请先在设置页配置合适的 Java。",
            button_text="打开设置",
            icon_name="warning",
            secondary_text="取消",
        )
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.action_clicked:
            self.main.switch_page("settings")

    def _accept_eula_clicked(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self._accept_eula(info, start_after=False)

    def _accept_eula(self, info: ServerInfo, start_after: bool = True) -> bool:
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "同意 Minecraft EULA",
            "启动服务端需要接受 Minecraft 最终用户许可协议（EULA）。",
            primary_text="同意 EULA",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="warning",
            details="点击“同意 EULA”会写入 eula=true。条款地址："
            + EULA_URL
            + "。请确认你已阅读并同意该协议。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return False
        try:
            write_eula(info)
            save_server(info)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法写入 EULA：{exc}", "error")
            return False
        self._update_eula_badge(info)
        self.toast("已同意 Minecraft EULA", "success")
        if start_after:
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self.start_server)
        return True

    def stop_server(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        if process is None or not process.is_running:
            self.toast("服务端没有在运行", "info")
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "停止服务端",
            f"确定停止 {info.name} 吗？",
            primary_text="停止服务端",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="stop",
            icon_color=colors()["red"],
            details="启动器会先发送 stop 命令让世界安全保存。"
            "如果 20 秒内没有退出，进程会被强制结束。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self._expected_stop.add(info.folder)
        self._append_console(info.folder, "> stop")
        process.stop(20)
        self.toast("正在停止服务端…", "info")
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _on_process_started(self, folder: str, pid: int) -> None:
        self._append_console(folder, f"服务端进程已启动（PID {pid}）")
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _on_process_ready(self, folder: str) -> None:
        info = next((item for item in self.servers if item.folder == folder), None)
        name = info.name if info else folder
        self._append_console(folder, "服务端已就绪")
        self.toast(f"{name} 已就绪，可以连接了", "success")
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _on_process_state(self, folder: str, state: str) -> None:
        if folder == self._selected_folder:
            self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _on_process_stopped(self, folder: str, code: int) -> None:
        info = next((item for item in self.servers if item.folder == folder), None)
        name = info.name if info else folder
        expected = folder in self._expected_stop
        self._expected_stop.discard(folder)
        self._processes.pop(folder, None)
        self._append_console(
            folder, f"服务端进程已结束（退出代码 {code}）"
        )
        if code == 0:
            self.toast(f"{name} 已停止", "info")
        elif expected:
            self.toast(f"{name} 已停止（代码 {code}）", "info")
        else:
            self.toast(f"{name} 异常退出（代码 {code}），请查看控制台", "error")
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()
        if info is not None:
            self._load_settings(info)

    def _refresh_rows_state(self) -> None:
        for row in self._rows:
            row.set_state(self._state_of(row.info))

    def _update_controls(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        state = process.state if process is not None else "stopped"
        self.state_badge.setText(STATE_TEXT.get(state, state))
        self.state_badge.setProperty("badge", STATE_BADGE.get(state, "gray"))
        repolish(self.state_badge)

        installing = (
            self._install_worker is not None and self._install_folder == info.folder
        )
        running = state in ("starting", "running", "stopping")
        self.start_btn.setVisible(state == "stopped")
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(not installing and info.installed)
        self.start_btn.setText("启动")
        self.stop_btn.setVisible(state != "stopped")
        self.stop_btn.setEnabled(state in ("starting", "running"))

        pid = ""
        if process is not None and process.process is not None:
            pid = f" · PID {process.process.pid}"
        hint = f"{info.type_name} {info.mc_version}"
        if state == "stopped":
            hint += " · 未启动"
        else:
            hint += f" · {STATE_TEXT.get(state, state)}{pid}"
        self.console_hint.setText(hint)
        self.address_label.setText(f"localhost:{info.port}")

        self.tab_hint.setText(
            "运行中修改的插件或设置需要重启后生效" if state != "stopped" else ""
        )
        self.command_edit.setEnabled(state == "running")
        self.send_btn.setEnabled(state == "running")
        self.eula_btn.setEnabled(not info.eula)
        self.settings_name.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.settings_memory.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.settings_port.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.settings_online.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.settings_java.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.save_btn.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.delete_btn.setEnabled(not running and not installing)
        self.reinstall_btn.setEnabled(not running and not installing)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 插件

    def refresh_addons(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if not hasattr(self, "addon_layout"):
            return
        while self.addon_layout.count():
            item = self.addon_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget is not None:
                widget.setParent(None)
                widget.deleteLater()
        self.addon_layout.addStretch(1)
        self.addon_holder.setMinimumHeight(0)
        if info is None:
            self.addon_empty.setText("")
            self.addon_empty.setVisible(False)
            return

        self.addon_path_label.setText(str(addons_dir(info)))
        addons = list_addons(info)
        if not addons:
            self.addon_empty.setText(
                f"还没有{info.addon_label}。点击右上角“下载{info.addon_label}”"
                f"从 Modrinth 获取适配 {info.mc_version} 的项目。"
            )
            self.addon_empty.setVisible(True)
            return
        self.addon_empty.setVisible(False)
        for addon in addons:
            row = AddonRow(addon, info.is_plugin_server)
            row.toggled.connect(
                lambda item, checked, i=info: self._toggle_addon(i, item, checked)
            )
            self.addon_layout.insertWidget(self.addon_layout.count() - 1, row)
        self.addon_layout.activate()
        self.addon_holder.setMinimumHeight(self.addon_layout.sizeHint().height())

    def _toggle_addon(
        self, info: ServerInfo, addon: AddonFile, checked: bool
    ) -> None:
        if addon.enabled == checked:
            return
        try:
            toggle_addon(addon)
        except (ServerError, OSError) as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法切换{info.addon_label}状态：{exc}", "error")
            self.refresh_addons()
            return
        state = "启用" if checked else "禁用"
        self.toast(f"{addon.name} 已{state}", "success")
        if info.folder in self._processes:
            self.toast("需要重启服务端后生效", "info")
        self.refresh_addons()

    def open_addon_dialog(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        dialog = ServerAddonDialog(self.main, info)
        dialog.installed.connect(lambda _: self.refresh_addons())
        dialog.exec()
        self.refresh_addons()

    def _open_addons_folder(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        path = addons_dir(info)
        try:
            path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法创建目录：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(path)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 设置

    def _refresh_java_sources(self, _installs=None) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self._populate_java_combo(info)

    def _populate_java_combo(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        current = self.settings_java.currentData() if self.settings_java.count() else ""
        preferred = current or info.java_path or ""
        self.settings_java.blockSignals(True)
        self.settings_java.clear()
        self.settings_java.addItem("自动选择（推荐）", "")
        paths = {str(item.path) for item in self.main.java_installs}
        for java in self.main.java_installs:
            self.settings_java.addItem(java.display, java.path)
        if preferred and preferred not in paths:
            self.settings_java.addItem(f"已配置：{preferred}", preferred)
        index = self.settings_java.findData(preferred)
        self.settings_java.setCurrentIndex(index if index >= 0 else 0)
        self.settings_java.blockSignals(False)
        self._update_java_hint(info)

    def _update_java_hint_for_current(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self._update_java_hint(info)

    def _update_java_hint(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        required = required_java_major(info.mc_version)
        chosen = pick_java(
            self.main.java_installs,
            required,
            self.settings_java.currentData() or "",
        )
        if chosen is None:
            self.java_hint.setText(f"需要 Java {required}+")
            self.java_hint.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )
        else:
            self.java_hint.setText(f"Java {chosen.major} · 需要 {required}+")
            color = colors()["green"] if chosen.major >= required else colors()["orange"]
            self.java_hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px;")

    def _load_settings(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        self.settings_name.setText(info.name)
        self.settings_memory.setValue(max(1024, min(32768, info.memory_mb)))
        self.settings_port.setValue(max(1024, min(65535, info.port)))
        self.settings_online.setChecked(info.online_mode)
        self._populate_java_combo(info)
        self._update_eula_badge(info)
        self._update_online_hint()
        self._update_port_hint()
        self.reinstall_btn.setVisible(not info.installed or bool(info.install_error))
        if info.install_error and not info.installed:
            self.install_error_label.setText(f"上次安装失败：{info.install_error}")
            self.install_error_label.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )
            self.install_error_label.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.install_error_label.setVisible(False)

    def save_settings(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        name = self.settings_name.text().strip()
        if not name:
            self.toast("名称不能为空", "error")
            self.settings_name.setFocus()
            return
        running = info.folder in self._processes
        info.name = name
        info.memory_mb = int(self.settings_memory.value())
        info.port = int(self.settings_port.value())
        info.online_mode = self.settings_online.isChecked()
        info.java_path = str(self.settings_java.currentData() or "")
        try:
            save_server(info)
            update_server_properties(info)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"保存失败：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.toast("服务端设置已保存", "success")
        if running:
            self.toast("设置会在重启服务端后生效", "info")
        self.refresh_servers(info.folder)
        self._update_online_hint()

    def _update_online_hint(self) -> None:
        if self.settings_online.isChecked():
            self.online_hint.setText("仅正版账户可进入")
        else:
            self.online_hint.setText("允许离线玩家进入")

    def _update_port_hint(self) -> None:
        port = int(self.settings_port.value())
        if check_port(port):
            self.port_hint.setText(f"端口 {port} 可用")
            self.port_hint.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['green']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )
        else:
            self.port_hint.setText(f"端口 {port} 已被占用，服务端可能无法启动")
            self.port_hint.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['orange']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )

    def _update_eula_badge(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        self.eula_badge.setText("已同意" if info.eula else "未同意")
        self.eula_badge.setProperty("badge", "green" if info.eula else "orange")
        repolish(self.eula_badge)
        self.eula_btn.setEnabled(not info.eula)

    def delete_server(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        if process is not None and process.is_running:
            self.toast("请先停止服务端再删除", "error")
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "删除服务端",
            f"确定删除 {info.name} 吗？",
            primary_text="删除",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="trash",
            icon_color=colors()["red"],
            details=f"整个服务端文件夹（包括世界存档、插件和配置）将移动到回收站：\n{info.path}",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        ok, message = send_to_recycle_bin(info.path)
        if not ok:
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "删除失败",
                f"无法移动服务端文件夹：{message}",
                button_text="知道了",
                icon_name="warning",
            ).exec()
            return
        self._buffers.pop(info.folder, None)
        self._selected_folder = ""
        self.toast(message, "success")
        self.refresh_servers()

    def _open_server_folder(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self.main.open_path(info.path)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 重新安装

    def _retry_install(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        if self._install_worker is not None:
            self.toast("已有服务端安装任务正在进行", "info")
            return
        required = required_java_major(info.mc_version)
        java = pick_java(
            self.main.java_installs,
            required,
            info.java_path or self.main.config.java_path,
        )
        if java is None:
            self.toast("没有可用的 Java，无法安装", "error")
            return
        if info.kind in ("spigot", "forge", "neoforge") and java.major < required:
            self.toast(f"安装需要 Java {required}+", "error")
            return

        worker = ServerInstallWorker(
            info,
            java_path=java.path,
            accept_eula=info.eula,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
        )
        self._install_worker = worker
        self._install_folder = info.folder
        self.install_box.setVisible(True)
        self.install_progress.setValue(0)
        self.install_note.setText("正在准备重新安装…")
        self.tabs.set_value("console")
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self._append_console(info.folder, "开始重新安装服务端…")
        worker.progress.connect(
            lambda percent, message, f=info.folder: self._on_install_progress(
                f, percent, message
            )
        )
        worker.log_line.connect(
            lambda line, f=info.folder: self._append_console(f, line)
        )
        worker.finished.connect(
            lambda success, message, f=info.folder, w=worker: self._on_install_finished(
                f, success, message, w
            )
        )
        self._update_controls()
        worker.start()

    def _on_install_progress(self, folder: str, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        if folder != self._install_folder:
            return
        self.install_progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, int(percent))))
        self.install_note.setText(message)

    def _on_install_finished(
        self,
        folder: str,
        success: bool,
        message: str,
        worker: ServerInstallWorker,
    ) -> None:
        if worker is not self._install_worker:
            return
        self._install_worker = None
        self._install_folder = ""
        self.install_box.setVisible(False)
        self.refresh_servers(folder)
        if success:
            self.toast("服务端重新安装完成", "success")
        else:
            self.toast(f"安装失败：{message}", "error")
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "服务端安装失败",
                message,
                button_text="知道了",
                icon_name="warning",
            ).exec()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 对话框 / 生命周期

    def open_create_dialog(self) -> None:
        if self._install_worker is not None:
            self.toast("已有服务端安装任务正在进行", "info")
            return
        dialog = ServerCreateDialog(self.main)
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.server is not None:
            self.refresh_servers(dialog.server.folder)

    def _current_info(self) -> ServerInfo | None:
        return next(
            (
                info
                for info in self.servers
                if info.folder == self._selected_folder
            ),
            None,
        )

    def _on_tab_changed(self, value: str) -> None:
        index = {"console": 0, "addons": 1, "settings": 2}.get(value, 0)
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(index)
        if value == "addons":
            self.refresh_addons()
        elif value == "settings":
            info = self._current_info()
            if info is not None:
                self._load_settings(info)
                self._update_port_hint()

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self.create_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("plus", "#FFFFFF", 15))
        self.empty_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("plus", "#FFFFFF", 15))
        self.empty_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("server", colors()["muted"], 46))
        self.start_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("play", "#FFFFFF", 15))
        self.stop_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("stop", "#FFFFFF", 13))
        self.addon_open_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("folder", colors()["text2"], 14))
        self.addon_download_btn.setIcon(
            icons.icon("download", colors()["accent"], 14)
        )
        for row in self._rows:
            row.refresh_theme()
        for label in self.findChildren(QLabel):
            if label.property("badge"):
                repolish(label)
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self.detail_icon.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 11px;"
            )
            self._update_online_hint()
            self._update_java_hint(info)
            self._update_port_hint()
            self._update_controls()

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self.main.ensure_java_detected()
        self.refresh_servers(self._selected_folder)
        self.refresh_addons()

    def running_server_names(self) -> list[str]:
        names: list[str] = []
        for info in self.servers:
            process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
            if process is not None and process.state != "stopped":
                names.append(info.name)
        return names

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        worker = self._install_worker
        if worker is not None:
            try:
                worker.cancel()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._install_worker = None
        processes = list(self._processes.values())
        if not processes:
            return
        for process in processes:
            try:
                process.stop(6)
            except Exception:
                pass
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 6
        for process in processes:
            remaining = max(0.2, deadline - time.monotonic())
            process.wait(remaining)
        for process in processes:
            proc = process.process
            if proc is None or proc.poll() is not None:
                continue
            try:
                proc.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                proc.wait(timeout=1)
            except Exception:
                try:
                    proc.kill()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        self._processes.clear()

    def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        self.main.toast(text, kind)

def _total_ram_mb() -> int:
    try:
        class MEMORYSTATUSEX(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_ = [
                ("dwLength", ctypes.c_ulong),
                ("dwMemoryLoad", ctypes.c_ulong),
                ("ullTotalPhys", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullAvailPhys", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullTotalPageFile", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullAvailPageFile", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullTotalVirtual", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullAvailVirtual", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullAvailExtendedVirtual", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
            ]

        stat = MEMORYSTATUSEX()
        stat.dwLength = ctypes.sizeof(MEMORYSTATUSEX)
        if ctypes.windll.kernel32.GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ctypes.byref(stat)):
            return int(stat.ullTotalPhys / 1024 / 1024)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return 16384

            bool(self.main.config.update_auto_check)

            self._row(

        layout.addWidget(
            self._row(
                "桌面快捷方式",
                "在桌面放一个带 DKL 图标的启动入口；第一次启动时也会询问一次。",
                self.shortcut_btn,

        )
        layout.addWidget(hline())

        auto_box = QWidget()
        auto_layout = QHBoxLayout(auto_box)

        self.auto_switch.setChecked(bool(self.main.config.auto_complete))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def refresh_account(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        self.client_edit.setText(self.main.config.microsoft_client_id)
        self.email_edit.setText(self.main.config.microsoft_email)
        if account.is_msa:
            self.account_badge.setText("微软正版")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.account_name.setText(account.name or "正版账户")
            uid = account.uuid or ""
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}" if uid else "已登录 Microsoft 账户"
            )
            self.login_btn.setText("重新登录")
            self.verify_btn.setVisible(False)
            self.logout_btn.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.account_badge.setText("离线模式")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            self.account_name.setText(f"离线账户 · {self.main.config.player_name}")
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                "未登录 Microsoft 账户，启动时使用上面的离线名称。"
            )
            self.login_btn.setText("邮箱登录")
            self.verify_btn.setVisible(True)
            self.logout_btn.setVisible(False)
        repolish(self.account_badge)

    def _save_client_id(self) -> None:
        value = self.client_edit.text().strip()
        if value == self.main.config.microsoft_client_id:
            return
        self.main.config.microsoft_client_id = value
        self.main.config.save()

    def _save_email(self) -> None:
        value = self.email_edit.text().strip()
        if value == self.main.config.microsoft_email:
            return
        self.main.config.microsoft_email = value
        self.main.config.save()

    def _open_azure_portal(self) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(
            QUrl(
                "https://portal.azure.com/#view/"
                "Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps/ApplicationsListBlade"
            )
        )

    def _login_microsoft(self) -> None:
        client_id = self.client_edit.text().strip()
        try:
            client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
        except MicrosoftAuthError as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            self.client_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self._save_client_id()
        self._save_email()
        dialog = BrowserLoginDialog(
            self.main, client_id, self.main.config.microsoft_email
        )
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.account is not None:
            self._apply_account(dialog.account)

    def _login_device_code(self) -> None:
        client_id = self.client_edit.text().strip()
        try:
            client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
        except MicrosoftAuthError as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            self.client_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self._save_client_id()
        dialog = MicrosoftLoginDialog(self.main, client_id)
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.account is not None:
            self._apply_account(dialog.account)

    def _apply_account(self, account) -> None:
        self.main.config.account = account.to_config()
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self.main.toast(f"已登录 Microsoft 账户：{account.name}", "success")

    def _logout_microsoft(self) -> None:
        if not self.main.current_account().is_msa:
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "退出正版账户",
            "退出后将以离线账户启动游戏，正版服务器将无法进入。确定退出吗？",
            primary_text="退出登录",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="warning",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self.main.config.account = {}
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self.main.toast("已退出正版账户", "info")

    def _save_isolation(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        checked = bool(checked)
        if checked == bool(self.main.config.version_isolation):
            return
        self.main.config.version_isolation = checked
        self.main.config.save()
        if hasattr(self.main, "mods_page"):
            self.main.mods_page.on_show()
        self.main.toast(
            "版本隔离已开启，新的 Mod 会进入版本目录"
            if checked
            else "版本隔离已关闭，将使用游戏目录下的公共 mods",
            "success",
        )

    def _browse_game_dir(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self, "选择 .minecraft 文件夹", str(self.main.config.game_path)
        )
        if not folder:
            return
        self.main.config.game_dir = folder
        self.main.config.save()
        self.game_dir.setText(folder)
        self.main.refresh_versions()
        self.main.toast("游戏目录已更新", "success")

    def _save_name(self) -> None:
        name = self.name_edit.text().strip()
        if name == self.main.config.player_name:
            return
        if not valid_player_name(name):
            self.main.toast("名称需为 3-16 位字母、数字或下划线", "error")
            self.name_edit.setText(self.main.config.player_name)
            return
        self.main.config.player_name = name
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self.main.toast("玩家名称已更新", "success")

    def _on_memory(self, value: int) -> None:
        value = int(round(value / 512) * 512)
        self.memory_value.setText(f"{value} MB · {value / 1024:.1f} GB")
        if value != self.main.config.memory_mb:
            self.main.config.memory_mb = value
            if hasattr(self, "_save_timer"):
                self._save_timer.start(350)

    def _populate_java(self, installs: list[JavaInfo]) -> None:
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.java_combo.clear()
        self.java_combo.addItem("自动选择（推荐）", "")
        paths: set[str] = set()
        for info in installs:
            self.java_combo.addItem(info.display, info.path)
            paths.add(info.path.lower())
        config_path = self.main.config.java_path
        if config_path and config_path.lower() not in paths:
            self.java_combo.addItem(
                f"手动指定 · {config_path}", config_path
            )
        if config_path:
            index = self.java_combo.findData(config_path)
            if index >= 0:
                self.java_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(False)

        if installs:
            self.java_hint.setText(
                f"已检测到 {len(installs)} 个 Java。"
                "启动时会自动选择满足版本要求的最低版本。"
            )
        else:
            self.java_hint.setText(
                "未检测到 Java。请安装 Java 运行环境，或手动选择 java.exe。"
            )
        self._update_java_requirement()

    def _update_java_requirement(self) -> None:
        summary = next(
            (v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == self.main.selected_version),
            None,
        )
        if summary and summary.java_major and self.main.java_installs:
            self.java_hint.setText(
                f"当前版本 {summary.id} 需要 Java {summary.java_major}+，"
                f"已检测到 {len(self.main.java_installs)} 个 Java。"
            )

    def _on_java_changed(self, _index: int) -> None:
        path = self.java_combo.currentData() or ""
        if path == self.main.config.java_path:
            return
        self.main.config.java_path = path
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast("Java 设置已保存", "success")

    def _browse_java(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "选择 java.exe", "", "Java 可执行文件 (java.exe);;所有文件 (*)"
        )
        if not path:
            return
        info = probe_java(path)
        if info is None:
            self.main.toast("无法运行该 Java，请确认路径是否正确", "error")
            return
        self.main.config.java_path = path
        self.main.config.save()
        self._populate_java(self.main.java_installs)
        self.main.toast(f"已选择 Java {info.version}", "success")

    def _rescan_java(self) -> None:
        self.java_hint.setText("正在检测 Java…")
        self.main.ensure_java_detected(force=True)

    def _save_jvm_args(self) -> None:
        text = self.jvm_edit.text().strip()
        if text != self.main.config.jvm_args:
            self.main.config.jvm_args = text
            self.main.config.save()
            self.main.toast("JVM 参数已保存", "success")

    def _save_source(self, _index: int) -> None:
        source = self.source_combo.currentData() or "official"
        if source == self.main.config.download_source:
            return
        self.main.config.download_source = source
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast("下载源已更新，下次安装生效", "success")

    def _save_threads(self, _index: int) -> None:
        value = int(self.thread_combo.currentData() or 8)
        value = max(1, min(16, value))
        if value == self.main.config.download_threads:
            return
        self.main.config.download_threads = value
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast(f"下载线程已设为 {value}，下次下载生效", "success")

    def refresh_shortcut_state(self) -> None:
        from ...shortcut import shortcut_exists

        exists = shortcut_exists()
        self.shortcut_btn.setText(
            "重新创建快捷方式" if exists else "创建桌面快捷方式"
        )
        self.shortcut_btn.setToolTip(
            "覆盖桌面上已有的同名快捷方式"
            if exists
            else "在桌面创建 Darkitten Launcher 快捷方式"
        )

    def _create_shortcut(self) -> None:
        self.main.create_desktop_shortcut()

    def _cleanup_partials(self) -> None:
        if self._cleanup_worker is not None:
            return
        if self.main.install_active:
            self.main.toast("有安装任务正在进行，请先完成或取消安装", "info")
            return
        root = self.main.config.game_path
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "清理下载残留",
            "将扫描游戏目录，删除未完成的 .part 分片临时文件。"
            "已下载完成的文件不会受影响。",
            primary_text="开始清理",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="trash",
            icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            details=f"扫描目录：{root}",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self.cleanup_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.cleanup_btn.setText("正在清理…")
        self.main.set_status("正在清理下载残留…", "busy")
        worker = CleanupWorker(root, self)
        self._cleanup_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_cleanup_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _on_cleanup_finished(self, removed: int, freed: int) -> None:
        self._cleanup_worker = None
        self.cleanup_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.cleanup_btn.setText("清理下载残留")
        if removed:
            size = (
                f"{freed / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
                if freed >= 1024 * 1024
                else f"{max(0, freed) / 1024:.0f} KB"
            )
            self.main.set_status(f"已清理 {removed} 个下载残留", "success")
            self.main.toast(f"已清理 {removed} 个临时文件（{size}）", "success")
        else:
            self.main.set_status("没有发现下载残留", "idle")
            self.main.toast("没有发现未完成的下载文件", "info")

    def _save_theme(self, theme_value: str) -> None:
        if theme_value == self.main.config.theme:
            return
        self.main.config.theme = theme_value
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.apply_theme(theme_value)

    def _save_auto(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        if bool(self.main.config.auto_complete) == bool(checked):
            return
        self.main.config.auto_complete = bool(checked)
        self.main.config.save()

    def refresh_update_state(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "update_status"):
            return
        palette = {
            "idle": colors()["muted"],
            "busy": colors()["accent"],
            "accent": colors()["accent"],
            "success": colors()["green"],
            "error": colors()["red"],
        }
        color = palette.get(self.main.update_state_kind, colors()["muted"])
        self.update_status.setText(self.main.update_state_text)
        self.update_status.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
        )
        last = str(self.main.config.update_last_check or "").strip()
        self.update_status.setToolTip(
            f"上次检查：{last}" if last else "还没有检查过更新"
        )
        busy = bool(getattr(self.main, "_update_busy", False))
        self.update_btn.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.update_btn.setText("正在检查…" if busy else "检查更新")
        self.update_auto_switch.setChecked(
            bool(self.main.config.update_auto_check)
        )
        self.update_url_edit.setText(self.main.config.update_url)

    def _check_updates(self) -> None:
        self.main.check_for_updates(manual=True)

    def _open_update_site(self) -> None:
        self.main.open_update_site()

    def _save_update_auto(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        if bool(self.main.config.update_auto_check) == bool(checked):
            return
        self.main.config.update_auto_check = bool(checked)
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast(
            "启动时会自动检查更新" if checked else "已关闭启动时自动检查更新",
            "success",
        )

    def _save_update_url(self) -> None:
        value = self.update_url_edit.text().strip() or DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL
        self.update_url_edit.setText(value)
        if value == self.main.config.update_url:
            return
        self.main.config.update_url = value
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.update_state_text = "更新源已修改，尚未检查"
        self.main.update_state_kind = "idle"
        self.refresh_update_state()
        self.main.toast("更新源已保存", "success")

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self.refresh_account()
        self.isolation_switch.setChecked(bool(self.main.config.version_isolation))
        source_index = self.source_combo.findData(self.main.config.download_source)
        self.source_combo.setCurrentIndex(max(0, source_index))
        thread_index = self.thread_combo.findData(self.main.config.download_threads)
        if thread_index >= 0:
            self.thread_combo.setCurrentIndex(thread_index)
        self._populate_java(self.main.java_installs)
        self.refresh_shortcut_state()
        self.refresh_update_state()
        self.main.ensure_java_detected()

def _rounded_face(image: QImage, size: int = 48) -> QPixmap:
    if image.isNull():
        image = default_skin()
    face = image.copy(8, 8, 8, 8)
    scaled = face.scaled(
        size, size, Qt.IgnoreAspectRatio, Qt.FastTransformation
    )
    canvas = QImage(size, size, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    canvas.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(canvas)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
    path = QPainterPath()
    path.addRoundedRect(0.5, 0.5, size - 1, size - 1, 11, 11)
    painter.setClipPath(path)
    painter.drawImage(0, 0, scaled)
    painter.end()
    return QPixmap.fromImage(canvas)


class SkinPage(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, main, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.main = main
        self._skin_file: SkinFile | None = None
        self._current_skin: CurrentSkin | None = None
        self._fetch_worker: SkinFetchWorker | None = None
        self._upload_worker: SkinUploadWorker | None = None
        self._reset_worker: SkinResetWorker | None = None
        self._busy = False
        self._auto_fetch_done: set[str] = set()
        self.setAcceptDrops(True)
        self._build()
        self._load_initial_skin()
        self.main.account_changed.connect(self.refresh_account)
        self.refresh_account()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _load_initial_skin(self) -> None:
        candidates: list[Path] = []
        configured = self.main.config.skin_path.strip()
        if configured:
            candidates.append(Path(configured))
        local = local_skin_path()
        if local not in candidates:
            candidates.append(local)

        for path in candidates:
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            try:
                skin = load_skin_file(path)
            except SkinError as exc:
                self._set_status(str(exc), "error")
                continue
            self._skin_file = skin
            if skin.legacy and self.variant_tabs.current() == "slim":
                self.variant_tabs.set_value("classic")
                self.main.config.skin_variant = "classic"
                self.main.config.save()
            self._show_skin(skin.image, skin.legacy)
            self.file_edit.setText(str(path))
            self.file_edit.setToolTip(str(path))
            return

        self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
        self.current_label.setText("使用默认皮肤预览。选择本地 PNG 即可开始。")

    def _show_skin(self, image: QImage, legacy: bool) -> None:
        self.preview.set_skin(image, legacy)
        self.preview.set_variant(self.main.config.skin_variant)
        self.size_badge.setText("64×32 · 旧版" if legacy else "64×64")
        self.size_badge.setProperty("badge", "orange" if legacy else "blue")
        self._update_model_badge()
        self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(image, 48))
        repolish(self.size_badge)

    def _update_model_badge(self) -> None:
        variant = self.variant_tabs.current()
        self.model_badge.setText("Slim" if variant == "slim" else "Classic")
        self.model_badge.setProperty("badge", "purple" if variant == "slim" else "gray")
        repolish(self.model_badge)

    def _apply_local_file(self, path: str | Path, *, original: str = "") -> None:
        try:
            skin = load_skin_file(path)
            saved = save_local_skin(skin)
        except SkinError as exc:
            self._set_status(str(exc), "error")
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            return
        self._skin_file = skin
        legacy_note = ""
        if skin.legacy:
            if self.variant_tabs.current() != "classic":
                self.variant_tabs.set_value("classic")
            legacy_note = " 旧版 64×32 皮肤只支持 Classic 模型。"
        self.main.config.skin_variant = "classic" if skin.legacy else self.variant_tabs.current()
        self.main.config.skin_path = str(saved)
        self.main.config.save()
        self._show_skin(skin.image, skin.legacy)
        self.file_edit.setText(original or str(Path(path)))
        self.file_edit.setToolTip(
            f"原始文件：{original or path}\n预览副本：{saved}"
        )
        self.current_label.setText(
            "本地皮肤已就绪，可以预览 3D 效果。"
            + ("点击“上传并使用”同步到正版账户。" if self.main.current_account().is_msa else "离线模式下只能预览。")
            + legacy_note
        )
        self._set_status(f"已加载皮肤：{Path(original or path).name}{legacy_note}", "success")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    def _choose_skin(self) -> None:
        start = str(Path.home() / "Pictures")
        configured = self.main.config.skin_path.strip()
        if configured:
            parent = Path(configured).parent
            if parent.is_dir():
                start = str(parent)
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "选择 Minecraft 皮肤",
            start,
            "Minecraft 皮肤 (*.png)",
        )
        if path:
            self._apply_local_file(path, original=path)

    def _on_variant_changed(self, value: str) -> None:
        if value == "slim" and self.preview.is_legacy():
            self.variant_tabs.set_value("classic")
            value = "classic"
            self._set_status(
                "64×32 旧版皮肤没有独立的细手臂纹理，已保持 Classic 模型。",
                "info",
            )
        self.main.config.skin_variant = "slim" if value == "slim" else "classic"
        self.main.config.save()
        self.preview.set_variant(value)
        self._update_model_badge()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _set_status(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        color = {
            "error": colors()["red"],
            "success": colors()["green"],
            "busy": colors()["accent"],
            "info": colors()["muted"],
        }.get(kind, colors()["muted"])
        self.status_label.setText(text)
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px;")

    def _update_buttons(self) -> None:
        online = self.main.current_account().is_msa
        available = not self._busy
        has_file = self._skin_file is not None
        self.refresh_skin_btn.setEnabled(online and available)
        self.reset_skin_btn.setEnabled(online and available)
        self.upload_btn.setEnabled(online and available and has_file)
        self.select_btn.setEnabled(available)
        if not online and available:
            self.upload_btn.setToolTip("登录 Microsoft 正版账户后才能上传皮肤")
        else:
            self.upload_btn.setToolTip(
                "" if has_file else "请先选择一张 64×64 或 64×32 的 PNG 皮肤"
            )

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool, text: str = "") -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        if text:
            self._set_status(text, "busy")
        self._update_buttons()

    def _save_account(self, account) -> None:
        self.main.config.account = account.to_config()
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    def _client_id(self, silent: bool = False) -> str | None:
        client_id = str(self.main.config.microsoft_client_id or "").strip()
        if not client_id:
            if not silent:
                self.main.toast("请先在设置中填写 Azure 客户端 ID", "error")
                self.main.switch_page("settings")
            return None
        return client_id

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _fetch_current_skin(self, silent: bool = False) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if not account.is_msa:
            if not silent:
                self.main.toast("请先登录 Microsoft 正版账户", "info")
            return
        if self._busy:
            return
        client_id = self._client_id(silent=silent)
        if client_id is None:
            return
        self._auto_fetch_done.add(account.uuid or account.name)
        self._set_busy(True, "正在读取正版皮肤…")
        worker = SkinFetchWorker(account, client_id, self)
        self._fetch_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(lambda text: self._set_status(text, "busy"))
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_skin_loaded)
        worker.start()

    def _on_skin_loaded(self, skin, account, error: str) -> None:
        self._fetch_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._save_account(account)
        if error:
            self._set_status(f"读取皮肤失败：{error}", "error")
            self._update_buttons()
            return
        if skin is None:
            self._current_skin = None
            self.current_label.setText("该正版账户目前使用默认皮肤（Steve/Alex）。")
            self._set_status("账户当前没有自定义皮肤。", "info")
            if self._skin_file is None:
                self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
            self._update_buttons()
            return
        self._current_skin = skin
        if skin.image.height() == 32:
            skin.variant = "classic"
        self.main.config.skin_variant = (
            "slim" if skin.variant == "slim" else "classic"
        )
        self.main.config.save()
        self.variant_tabs.set_value(self.main.config.skin_variant)
        if self._skin_file is None:
            self._show_skin(skin.image, skin.image.height() == 32)
        else:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(skin.image, 48))
            self._update_model_badge()
        self.current_label.setText(
            f"正版当前皮肤 · {variant_text(skin.variant)}"
            + (f" · {skin.alias}" if skin.alias else "")
        )
        if not self.main.config.skin_path.strip():
            try:
                local = local_skin_path()
                if skin.image.save(str(local), "PNG"):
                    self.main.config.skin_path = str(local)
                    self.main.config.save()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._set_status("已读取正版账户当前皮肤。", "success")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    def _upload_skin(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if not account.is_msa:
            self.main.toast("请先登录 Microsoft 正版账户", "error")
            return
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._skin_file is None:
            self.main.toast("请先选择一张本地 PNG 皮肤", "info")
            return
        client_id = self._client_id()
        if client_id is None:
            return
        variant = self.variant_tabs.current()
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "上传并更换皮肤",
            f"将把当前预览的皮肤上传到 {account.name or '正版账户'}，"
            "并立即替换该账户正在使用的 Minecraft 皮肤。",
            primary_text="上传并使用",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="shirt",
            details="上传后通常几秒内生效；其他玩家和皮肤站点的缓存可能需要更长时间同步。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return

        self._set_busy(True, "正在准备上传皮肤…")
        worker = SkinUploadWorker(
            account, client_id, self._skin_file.data, variant, self
        )
        self._upload_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(lambda text: self._set_status(text, "busy"))
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_skin_uploaded)
        worker.start()

    def _on_skin_uploaded(self, success: bool, message: str, account) -> None:
        self._upload_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._save_account(account)
        if success:
            if self._skin_file is not None:
                self._current_skin = CurrentSkin(
                    image=self._skin_file.image,
                    variant=self.variant_tabs.current(),
                )
                self.current_label.setText(
                    f"正版当前皮肤 · 刚刚上传 · {variant_text(self.variant_tabs.current())}"
                )
            self._set_status(message, "success")
            self.main.toast(message, "success")
        else:
            self._set_status(f"上传失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"皮肤上传失败：{message}", "error")
        self._update_buttons()

    def _reset_skin(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if not account.is_msa:
            self.main.toast("请先登录 Microsoft 正版账户", "error")
            return
        if self._busy:
            return
        client_id = self._client_id()
        if client_id is None:
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "恢复默认皮肤",
            f"将移除 {account.name or '该账户'} 当前的自定义皮肤，恢复为默认皮肤。",
            primary_text="恢复默认",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="warning",
            details="这个操作会修改正版账户皮肤，但不会删除启动器 skins 文件夹中的本地图片。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return

        self._set_busy(True, "正在恢复默认皮肤…")
        worker = SkinResetWorker(account, client_id, self)
        self._reset_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(lambda text: self._set_status(text, "busy"))
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_skin_reset)
        worker.start()

    def _on_skin_reset(self, success: bool, message: str, account) -> None:
        self._reset_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._save_account(account)
        if success:
            self._current_skin = None
            self._skin_file = None
            self.main.config.skin_path = ""
            self.main.config.save()
            self.file_edit.clear()
            self.file_edit.setToolTip("")
            self.current_label.setText("正版账户已恢复默认皮肤。")
            self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
            self._set_status(message, "success")
            self.main.toast(message, "success")
        else:
            self._set_status(f"恢复失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"恢复默认皮肤失败：{message}", "error")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def refresh_account(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        self.main.config.skin_variant = self.variant_tabs.current()
        if account.is_msa:
            self.account_badge.setText("微软正版")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.mode_badge.setText("正版账户")
            self.mode_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.account_name.setText(account.name or "正版账户")
            uid = account.uuid or ""
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}" if uid else "已登录 Microsoft 账户"
            )
        else:
            self.account_badge.setText("离线预览")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            self.mode_badge.setText("离线模式")
            self.mode_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            name = self.main.config.player_name
            self.account_name.setText(f"离线预览 · {name}")
            uid = offline_uuid(name)
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]} · 登录正版后可上传皮肤"
            )
        repolish(self.account_badge)
        repolish(self.mode_badge)
        if not self._busy:
            online = account.is_msa
            if self._current_skin is not None and online:
                self._set_status("正版账户已连接，可以上传或恢复皮肤。", "info")
            elif not online:
                self._set_status("离线模式仅支持本地预览，不会修改任何账户。", "info")
            elif self._skin_file is not None:
                self._set_status("本地皮肤已就绪，可以上传。", "info")
            else:
                self._set_status("可以点击“读取正版皮肤”查看账户当前效果。", "info")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.preview.update()

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self.refresh_account()
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if not account.is_msa:
            return
        key = account.uuid or account.name
        if self._skin_file is None and key not in self._auto_fetch_done:
            self._auto_fetch_done.add(key)
            self._fetch_current_skin(silent=True)

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self.preview.update()
        if self._skin_file is not None:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(self._skin_file.image, 48))
        elif self._current_skin is not None:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(self._current_skin.image, 48))
        else:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(default_skin(), 48))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _open_skin_folder(self) -> None:
        try:
            SKIN_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建皮肤文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(SKIN_DIR)

    @staticmethod
    def _open_url(url: str) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def dragEnterEvent(self, event) -> None:
        urls = event.mimeData().urls()
        if any(url.toLocalFile().lower().endswith(".png") for url in urls):
            event.acceptProposedAction()
            return
        super().dragEnterEvent(event)

    def dropEvent(self, event) -> None:
        for url in event.mimeData().urls():
            path = url.toLocalFile()
            if path.lower().endswith(".png"):
                self._apply_local_file(path, original=path)
                event.acceptProposedAction()
                return
        super().dropEvent(event)
